 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: UX/UI Designer with Frontend Development Skills
description:
At Evolution AB / Nolimit City, we create world-class gaming products with bold, uncompromising design and unmatched attention to detail. We're looking for a UX/UI Designer who doesn't just stop at the design phase — you also bring your ideas to life in code.
 



  





 You'll join a cross-functional product team with full ownership over the solutions you design, working on innovative and highly interactive user experiences seen by players around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers to bring your ideas to life—creating products that are both beautiful and usable. Depending on your experience, you might implement parts of the frontend yourself or work alongside developers to ensure your vision is realized in the final product.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Lead UX and UI design efforts for new and existing products — from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity mockups.
* Translate your designs into functional, responsive, and accessible frontend components using React (Next.js) and TypeScript.
* Partner with developers and stakeholders to iterate on solutions, run experiments, and refine interfaces based on user feedback and performance data.
* Build and maintain components in a shared design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across products.
* Advocate for user-centered design throughout the product development process.



  





**You Might Be a Great Fit If You** 



* Have a strong background in UX/UI design, with a portfolio showcasing thoughtful, elegant interfaces and interaction design.
* Are fluent in modern design tools like Figma, and enjoy prototyping and testing user flows.
* Know how to write clean, maintainable frontend code using React and TypeScript.
* Are comfortable working with developers and understand how design decisions impact performance and implementation.
* Care deeply about usability, accessibility, and the overall user experience.
* Enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Experience with Next.js, Redux Toolkit, or Headless CMSs like Strapi.
* Familiarity with A/B testing, analytics, and data-driven design decisions.
* An understanding of game or entertainment product design patterns.



  





**Technologies You'll Touch** 



* Figma (or other tools you prefer) / Design Systems
* React / Next.js
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* Redux Toolkit
* CSS / Tailwind CSS
* Strapi (Headless CMS)

**Who we are** 




 You don't need to know everything from day one. If you're a designer who loves to get your hands dirty in code, and you're passionate about crafting exceptional user experiences, we'd love to meet you.
 



  





 Join one of Sweden's fastest-growing companies and help shape the future of interactive entertainment.
 



  





 Nolimit City, Stockholm based development team. We provide you with your choice of OS and IDE.
 



 Apply on LinkedIn, or send your application to hr-sweden@nolimitcity.com
 



 http://www.nolimitcity.com

title: IT Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 We're looking for an IT Engineer who treats every manual ticket as a bug. You'll automate the company's IT operations end-to-end with AI agents, so 250+ Lovables can move at terminal velocity.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years in IT engineering, corporate engineering, or platform IT at a high-growth tech company.
* Fluent with identity, MDM, SaaS lifecycle, and zero-trust networking (Okta/Entra, Jamf/Intune/Kandji, Tailscale/Cloudflare, Google Workspace).
* You write real code - Python, TypeScript, or Go - and ship automations as production systems, not scripts.
* Hands-on with AI agents and LLM tooling (Lovable, Claude, function-calling, MCP, internal copilots) and a clear point of view on where humans should stay in the loop.
* Bias toward eliminating work over optimising it. You measure success in tickets that never need to be opened.
* Bonus: experience building internal developer/employee portals, or running IT for a fast-scaling org through 10x growth.


**What You'll Do**
* Optimise all aspects of Lovable's IT stack: identity, devices, SaaS, networking, and access reviews.
* Build AI agents that resolve tier-1 and tier-2 IT requests automatically - onboarding, access, lost devices, app provisioning.
* Replace runbooks with automated workflows and self-serve tooling our team actually loves using.
* Partner with Security and GRC to make least-privilege the default and auditability free.
* Configure integrations , build templates and default tooling that lowers thresholds for people to work AI-natively and speed up onboarding and processes.
* Set the bar for how a modern, AI-native IT function looks - and write the playbook the rest of the industry will copy.
* Oversee DNS records, email deliverability and manage our domains.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend:React and Typescript.
* Backend:Golang and Rust.
* Cloud:Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling:GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data:Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Plattformsspecialist Kafka
description:
Svenska kraftnät är en nyckelaktör i energiomställningen. Vår IT-division växer för att möjliggöra en fördubblad elproduktion och en fossilfri framtid. Med ny teknik ökar vi både infrastrukturens kapacitet och utvecklingstakten inom digitalisering och processer.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som
 **plattformsspecialist Kafka** 
 förvaltar och utvecklar du system som är avgörande för den svenska elmarknaden. Du blir del av Integrationsenheten som ansvarar för Svenska kraftnäts integrationsplattformar och kommunikationslösningar för elbranschen. Tillsammans säkerställer ni att landet varken slocknar eller stannar och skapar förutsättningar för Sveriges framtida elektrifiering och möjliggörandet av grön el.
   

  

 Integrationsplattformarna har höga krav på säkerhet, prestanda och tillgänglighet. Det är en modern arkitektur med mikrotjänster och ni har tillsammans ett operationellt ansvar för system i hög förändringstakt.
   

  

 Svenska kraftnät är i en stark tillväxtfas och moderniserar både teknik och processer. Du erbjuds goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, såväl genom samarbete med erfarna kollegor som genom fördjupning i ny teknik inom integrationsområdet. Vi ser även intern rotation som ett viktigt sätt att bredda kompetens och stärka sammanhållningen i organisationen. Du får möjlighet att vara med på en spännande förflyttningsresa och forma framtidens integrationslösningar.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Vidareutveckla våra integrationsförmågor: Ta ansvar för utvecklingen av Kafka-plattformen och bidra med expertis inom arkitektur, säkerhet, skalbarhet och integration.
* Incidenthantering och problemlösning: I nära samarbete med 24/7-systemövervakningsfunktionen, analysera, lösa och dokumentera incidenter och problem.
* Agera specialist: Vara primär kontaktväg för systemspecifika frågor och dela din expertis internt.
* Stötta verksamheten: Ge viktig support till verksamheten och externa partners.
* Genomföra ändringar och förbättringar: Hantera beställningar, underhåll och uppgraderingar.
* Dokumentera och specificera tekniska krav: Arbeta med teamet för att säkra effektiv dokumentation och långsiktig förvaltning.
* Säkerställa IT-säkerhet, hög tillgänglighet och kvalitet.


**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra och som har en naturlig förmåga att samarbeta – inom teamet, med angränsande team och med olika intressenter. Du kommunicerar tydligt, skapar tillit och anpassar dig efter situationen för att nå gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Du är resultatorienterad och tar ansvar för dina uppgifter, arbetar målmedvetet och strävar efter att leverera kvalitet inom givna ramar. När du stöter på en utmaning är du lösningsorienterad och hittar vägar framåt. Vidare är du nyfiken, har ett genuint intresse för teknik, för att lära dig nya saker och för att utvecklas i din roll. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

**Du har också:**
* Examen inom systemvetenskap eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt, t.ex. genom utbildning på yrkeshögskola eller arbete inom området.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med Kafka.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av applikationsförvaltning på Linux/Unix-baserade system (installation, konfiguration, drift och felsökning).
* Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift.


**Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**
* Arbete med Kafka i on-premmiljöer.
* Containerteknologi (Docker, Podman) och orkestrering (Kubernetesplattformar, t.ex. OpenShift).
* Kafka Streams, t.ex. Schema Registry och Mirror Maker.
* Automatisering genom CI/CD-lösningar och DevOps-verktyg.
* Säkerhetsmekanismer i Kafka.
* Certifiering inom Kafka eller relaterade teknologier.
* Hantering av hög tillgänglighet och skalbarhet i distribuerade system, t.ex. genom KRaft och dess roll i Kafka-kluster.


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm (Sundbyberg)
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %
* Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-21. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i samband med din ansökan.
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Sex månaders provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.
* Istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev till din ansökan besvarar du ett antal frågor i ansökningsformuläret.
* Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T.
* Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät


**Vid frågor:**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Svenska kraftnät med Computer Sweden Recruitment. För frågor kring tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen, välkommen att kontakta huvudansvarig rekryteringskonsult Alexandra Tihinen, telefon 070-447 92 24 eller alexandra.tihinen@csrecruitment.se.
   

  

**Fackliga representanter är:**
* Annika Ingeborn, SACO, 010 475 87 72
* Erica Midfjäll, ST, 010 475 87 31


 Du når oss också via e-post: Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se.
   

  

 Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare i samband med rekrytering, vi har upphandlade avtal som gäller för Svenska kraftnät som statlig myndighet.
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretess-medvetenhet. Inför anställning genomförs säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) vilket innefattar grundutredning och om anställningen avser befattning i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövningen även att innefatta en registerkontroll. För anställning på Svenska kraftnät kan det vara ett krav på svenskt medborgarskap i vissa befattningar. Med anställningen följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. För mer information om personalsäkerhet på svenska kraftnät. https://www.svk.se/sakerhet-och-beredskap/sakerhetsskydd/personalsakerhet

title: Principal Tech Lead
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 



  





**The opportunity** 




 Are you an experienced Principal Tech Lead looking to make a broader technical impact across multiple engineering teams? Do you enjoy solving the most complex technical challenges while mentoring other technical leaders and driving engineering excellence at scale? If you're passionate about modern software architecture, hands-on technical leadership, and delivering resilient, enterprise-grade platforms, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 In this position, you will be based in Stockholm and report to the Head of Engineering. As a Principal Tech Lead, you will provide technical leadership across multiple squads, ensuring architectural vision is translated into high-quality, production-ready solutions. Working closely with Mission Architects, Squad Tech Leads, DevSecOps, QA, Security, and Product teams, you will play a pivotal role in enabling the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives that support Worldline's payment platforms across Europe.
 



  





**Day-to-Day Responsibilities** 



* Lead the technical design and implementation of complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering squads
* Partner with Squad Tech Leads to solve high-risk and high-complexity technical challenges and accelerate delivery
* Act as a hands-on technical contributor where deep expertise is required, contributing to critical solution design and software implementation
* Translate architectural guidance into practical engineering patterns, reusable frameworks, and reference implementations
* Drive architectural modernization initiatives, supporting platform evolution, cloud adoption, and technology transformation
* Collaborate closely with Mission Architects, DevSecOps, QA, Security, and Product teams to ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements
* Identify systemic engineering challenges and improvement opportunities, escalating recommendations to Guild Leads and Architects
* Champion engineering best practices, technical quality, and operational excellence across multiple squads
* Support technical decision-making, risk management, and cross-team dependency planning
* Mentor Tech Leads and senior engineers, fostering technical growth and knowledge sharing throughout the engineering organization



  





**Who Are We Looking For** 




 You are an experienced technical leader who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges while enabling teams to deliver their best work. You combine deep technical expertise with strong collaboration skills and have a proven ability to influence engineering direction across multiple teams. You thrive in fast-paced environments, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
 



  





**On Top Of That, You Have** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Full working proficiency in English
* Extensive experience as a Principal Engineer, Principal Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, or similar senior technical leadership role
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-team software delivery in enterprise environments
* Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native applications, and modern engineering practices
* Experience driving architecture modernization, platform transformation, and technical strategy
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve high-impact technical risks
* Strong experience mentoring technical leaders and influencing engineering practices across multiple teams
* Deep understanding of DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, security, scalability, resilience, and performance engineering
* Experience working within Agile product development organizations
* Knowledge of the payments industry is considered a strong advantage



  





**Perks & Benefits** 




 At Worldline, you'll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also enjoy:
 


* Health contribution
* Health check – Every 2nd year
* Private Health Care Insurance (EuroAccident)
* Parental pay and 12 months pension during parental leave
* Opportunity for hybrid working according to company standard
* Benefit portal with many great offers, plus more



  





**Shape the evolution** 




 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 



 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
 



  





 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Data Science Pod Lead
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 We are looking for a Data Science Pod Lead to join our Data Science team - a senior technical leader who combines deep hands-on expertise with a passion for growing people and teams. This is a dual-track role: approximately 75% of your time will be spent as an individual contributor, developing and delivering production-ready algorithms and ML models from novel sensor data, while approximately 25% will be dedicated to people leadership, serving as the direct line manager and mentor for a pod of data scientists.
   

  

 You will work across projects such as Laser Speckle Imaging, contactless ECG, Skin imaging, Thermal Imaging, Cardiovascular Algorithms, and Tissue Imaging - turning complex health data into validated, clinically impactful decision support. You will also shape the technical direction and quality standards of your pod, contribute to the broader Data Science leadership team, and collaborate closely with engineers, clinicians, and researchers to bring algorithms and models from prototype to production.
   

  

 If you are motivated by the intersection of cutting-edge machine learning and preventative healthcare, and you want to lead a team while staying close to the technical work, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months**
* Develop, verify, validate, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms for clinical decision support, contributing to new product features or research breakthroughs that improve member outcomes (Member-first, always).
* Build and lead a high-performing pod of data scientists — providing line management, mentorship, regular feedback, and career development support to help each team member thrive (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
* Set and uphold technical standards, code quality, and best practices within the pod, and deliver production-quality code integrated into Neko’s backend infrastructure, raising the bar for technical excellence across the Data Science team (Chase 10X, not 10%).
* Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware engineers, firmware engineers, software engineers, medical doctors, and clinical researchers to develop and validate clinical use-cases, and support the regulatory readiness of algorithms and models (Optimistic truth seeking)
* Contribute to the Data Science leadership team — shaping area-wide strategy, best practices, common tooling, and ways of working alongside other Pod Leads and the Area Lead.


**Requirements**
* MSc or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 5+ years of relevant industry experience in a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist role, or 2+ years post-PhD in a comparable position.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping algorithms or ML models to production in a real-world product or clinical environment.
* Deep expertise in machine learning, signal processing, or computer vision, with hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle.
* Strong software engineering skills: production-level coding, version control, testing, and integration with backend systems.
* Experience working with sensor data, time-series analysis, or medical imaging in cross-functional R&D environments.
* People leadership experience (e.g. line management, team lead, or equivalent), with the ability to inspire and develop a technical team.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with comfort operating under uncertainty, making pragmatic trade-offs, and driving clarity in ambiguous situations.
* Motivated to apply cutting-edge science to improve preventative and early-detection healthcare.


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. medical devices, IVD, or equivalent) and familiarity with regulatory requirements for medical algorithms.
* Prior experience in AI-enabled healthcare, medtech, or biotech.
* Systems thinking: ability to design and reason about end-to-end ML systems that are observable, safe, and scalable.
* Demonstrated success mentoring engineers or researchers in high-growth, mission-driven organisations.

title: Platform Engineer, Aspia Group
description:
**Platform Engineer, DevOps and Developer Enablement**
 At Aspia, we stand with the leaders, teams and companies who dare to grow. Growth requires clarity, courage and partnership – and we are committed to creating the space where ambition can thrive.
   

  

 As our cloud platform and developer enablement capabilities continue to evolve, we are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join us in building secure, scalable, and well-governed platform services that help development teams deliver and operate solutions efficiently across Aspia Group.
   

  

 Aspia is an international group specializing in finance, payroll and HR outsourcing, powered by modern technology and deep human expertise. Across the Nordics, we help organizations simplify complexity so they can focus their energy on what truly drives progress.
   

  

**Role Description**
 As a Platform Engineer at Aspia, you will work at the interface between platform operations, DevOps practices, and development teams. The role combines platform engineering, operational support, automation, and developer enablement. You will help create and improve the standardized capabilities, tools, guardrails, and ways of working that enable development teams to deploy, integrate, and operate solutions in a secure, scalable, and efficient way.
   

  

 A significant part of the role is to support development teams both when adopting platform services and when resolving production-related issues. In practice, this means providing hands-on guidance, troubleshooting support, and practical recommendations for deployment pipelines, integrations, access patterns, operational readiness, and platform-related incidents. You will also take operational responsibility for GitHub Enterprise, including administration, maintenance, access management, governance support, and continuous improvement of the developer experience.
   

  

 You will work as part of the skilled Group IT Cloud and Operations team and collaborate closely with development teams, architects, security specialists, and other stakeholders across the organization. The team consists of professionals based in Sweden and Finland. You will report to the infrastructure team Manager. This is a permanent position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support development teams in adopting platform services, DevOps practices, deployment patterns, and operational ways of working
* Provide hands-on troubleshooting and guidance for production-related issues where platform services, integrations, CI/CD pipelines, access, or cloud foundations are involved
* Develop, maintain, and improve reusable platform capabilities, standards, and automation that make solution delivery more secure, consistent, and efficient
* Take operational responsibility for GitHub Enterprise, including administration, maintenance, access management, repository governance support, and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with development teams, architects, security teams, and operations stakeholders to align platform solutions with business, security, and governance requirements
* Contribute to documentation, onboarding material, support models, and practical guidance that help teams use platform capabilities effectively
* Promote DevOps principles, standardization, automation, and operational excellence across the platform and developer community


**What We Expect From You**
* Solid experience in a platform engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or similar technical role
* Good understanding of modern software delivery, CI/CD practices, operational support models, and developer enablement
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise or similar source control and DevOps platforms, including administration or operational support
* Experience supporting development teams in solution onboarding, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and production-related technical issues
* Good understanding of Microsoft Azure, cloud platform services, security principles, access management, and automation
* Ability to work in a structured, service-minded, and proactive way while collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with infrastructure as code, scripting, or automation is an advantage
* Good written and spoken English; Finnish or Swedish is an advantage
* Relevant education or equivalent practical experience


**We want you to thrive**
 At Aspia, you will join a collaborative environment where curiosity, trust, and continuous improvement are central. You will work alongside skilled colleagues across the Nordics and play an important role in improving the platform capabilities and developer experience that support our growth. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on technical work, operational responsibility, and close collaboration with development teams in an international environment where your expertise will make a visible impact.
   

  

 We work in a hybrid model with flexible working hours, and we hope to see you a few days per week at our Stockholm office. We also offer employee benefits that support health and wellbeing.
   

  

**This is Aspia**
 Aspia is an industry leader in accounting, payroll, tax, and business‑related advisory services. Together within Aspia Group, we are more than 3,100 employees across over 160 offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Ukraine.
   

  

**The best time in your career**
 Opportunities are endless and ambitions run high – with us, your development possibilities are extensive. Through the work you do and the responsibility you take on, through dialogue with your clients and knowledgeable colleagues, and through clear development and training plans.
   

  

 Our way of working is at the forefront, and we continuously develop our digital services to ensure that working with us feels modern, enjoyable, and efficient. You’ll be part of a market‑leading growth company with great opportunities for an exciting future, shared expertise in entrepreneurship, and access to wide-ranging skills and specialists.
   

  

 We put people at the center and give you the chance to realize your ambitions. We want you, as an employee, to have the best time in your career at Aspia, and we care deeply about ensuring that work and private life are well balanced so that we, as individuals and as a company, can grow side by side.
   

  

**Aspia. Dare to Grow.**

title: CTO
description:
Medgrundare / CTO – Bygg framtidens plattform för TV- och filmutveckling
 



 Om Startupet
 



  





 Startupet utvecklar nästa generations verktyg för utveckling av TV- och filmprojekt. Tänk "Figma för TV- och filmberättelser" – en plattform där produktionsbolag kan testa, utveckla och förbättra en berättelses struktur innan ett manus skrivs.
 



  





 Bakom bolaget finns en metod som utvecklats under 14 år och som har använts i projekt för bland annat BBC och Amazon. En pilotgrupp med produktionsbolag i Norden och Storbritannien är redan på plats och dialog pågår med några av Sveriges största produktionsbolag.
 



  





 Nu söker vi vår tekniska medgrundare.
 



  





 Rollen
 



  





 Som CTO blir du en av företagets medgrundare och ansvarar för den tekniska visionen och utvecklingen.
 



  





 Du kommer att:
 



  





 Äga den tekniska arkitekturen
 



 Bygga och vidareutveckla vår SaaS-plattform
 



 Arbeta med både frontend och backend
 



 Designa en lösning som kan skalas från Norden till hela Europa
 



 Vara med och rekrytera framtida utvecklare
 



 Sätta tekniska processer och utvecklingsmetoder
 



 Vara en strategisk partner i bolagets fortsatta utveckling
 



  





 Vi letar inte efter någon som bara vill skriva kod – vi söker någon som vill bygga ett företag.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som
 



 Har minst 5 års erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling
 



 Är bekväm inom både frontend och backend
 



 Har erfarenhet av systemarkitektur och skalbara SaaS-lösningar
 



 Tycker om att lösa komplexa tekniska problem
 



 Har ett entreprenöriellt driv
 



 Vill vara med från början och bygga något stort
 



 Trivs i en miljö där beslut fattas snabbt
 



  





 Meriterande:
 



  





 Erfarenhet av filformat, editorer eller avancerade webbapplikationer
 



 Erfarenhet av AI eller produktutveckling
 



 Intresse för film, TV eller den kreativa industrin
 



 Erfarenhet av att leda utvecklingsteam
 



 Vad erbjuder vi?
 



  





 Det här är en medgrundarroll.
 



  





 Initialt erbjuder vi:
 



  





 Aktieägande (equity)
 



 Möjlighet till EU-finansiering och startupbidrag
 



 Låg eller ingen lön tills extern finansiering finns på plats
 



  





 Målet är att samtliga i teamet ska kunna arbeta heltid med marknadsmässig lön när bolaget finansieras.

 Grundaren har över 14 års erfarenhet av utveckling inom TV- och filmbranschen och har byggt en metod som används för att minska riskerna i utvecklingsprocessen.
 



  





 Filosofin är enkel:
 



  





 Förberedelser är billigare än misstag.
 



 Feedback tidigt sparar månader senare.
 



 Olika åsikter leder ofta till bättre lösningar.
 



  





 Det är den kulturen vi vill bygga vidare på.
 



  





 Ansökan
 



  





 Vi har ingen stress att rekrytera.
 



  





 Vi söker hellre rätt person än den snabbaste lösningen.
 



  





 Om du vill vara med och bygga nästa stora verktyg för den internationella film- och TV-branschen vill vi gärna höra från dig.

title: Security Engineer, Solna/Hybrid
description:
Do you want to be part of a dynamic and challenging environment at the number one logistics services provider in Scandinavia? If you have a passion for cyber security and are interested in solving complex problems, join us in protecting our infrastructure that serves millions across the Nordics.
   

  

 If you have a passion for security and are interested in developing our platforms and solving complex problems, come and join us as our Security Engineer at PostNord in Solna.
   

  

**Join us**
 The CISO Office at PostNord Group houses is responsible for protecting the business, enabling digital transformation and earning trust. We work very closely with the enterprise architects, network and system administrators, developers, privacy officers and production engineers to name a few; on a journey to further expand our information security capabilities. Our information security program is driven by a risk-based approach, rather than a compliance-based approach followed by highly regulated industries.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 In the role of Security Engineer, you will work within our Security Operations team to ensure effective operation of cyber security incident logging & monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management.
   

  

**You Will Work With, Among Other Things**
* Assist in effective operation of cybersecurity incident response process and streamline response to common attacks.
* Coordinate cybersecurity incident response within the PostNord Group.
* Implement and maintain modern SIEM (Azure Sentinel) to unify visibility across PostNord Group.
* Reduce manual effort by using automated investigation, remediation and response playbooks.
* Ensure alert quality, design and implement proactive threat hunting processes.
* Perform / assist in threat hunting, forensic investigations, analysing alerts and assessing vulnerabilities.
* Prioritize vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation efforts.


 ,
   

  

 Several years of experience as an IT security specialist in a medium to large enterprise company. You have been driving changes and projects and understand how it is done within a larger organisation.
   

  

 Open minded person that is curious and social and finds it natural to share knowledge with your fellowcolleagues. Can visualise problems and present them both in a technical and executive way.
   

  

**Requirements And Technical Skills**
* Hands-on experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems and Security Operations Centres (SOC).
* In-depth understanding of IT Security principles with strong capabilities in investigating and resolving security incidents.
* Ability to visualize complex problems and present solutions both technically and to executive stakeholders.
* Proficiency in various security tools and technologies, including Microsoft Defender suite and Microsoft Purview.
* Knowledge of vulnerability management principles and severity ratings.
* Experience with regulatory compliance and cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach to tasks.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and discretion.
* Familiarity with incident response procedures and disaster recovery planning.


 We believe you are a person that is thorough, analytical, and easy to get acquainted with and learn new systems. You have a structured, responsible, and inclusive way of working. You need to be able to handle stressful situations and prioritize job tasks independently. You are communicative and easy to collaborate with and are unpretentious in your ways of creating and nurturing long-term relationships.
   

  

**We offer you**
**Benefits**
 We offer a variety of work in an international environment with constantly new challenges and quick decisions. Here you have opportunities to develop creative solutions and work in a prestige-free group where we jointly help to reach our goals. PostNord is one of Sweden's largest workplaces and we offer safe employment conditions and benefits. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
   

  

* Hybrid workplace with a Nordic and dynamic environment. Watch the video about our office.
* Great development opportunities
* Great insurance and occupational pension terms
* Wellness allowance & opportunity to train at Arken's gym and indoor swimming pool
* Employee benefits through PostNord Plus - PostNord´s own personnel foundation


**We make everyday life easier**
 PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We ensure the provision of a postal service to households and businesses in Sweden and Denmark. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordic region. We are in a constant transformation and work consistently to develop both our offer and our employees, all to achieve our vision of being The favorite carrier of the Nordics. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at postnord.com
   

  

**Apply**
 We look forward to receive your application!
   

  

 Don't wait to submit your application as we go through the applications on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 For union representatives, visit: www.postnord.com/fackliga
   

  

 We are looking forward to hear from you!

title: Engineering Manager – Monetisation
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 As an Engineering Manager at Voi, you will lead and grow a cross-functional product team while staying close to the code. This role is ideal for a strong technical lead ready to take a first step into people management – someone who wants to shape team culture, support engineers’ growth, and drive delivery without leaving their technical roots behind.
   

  

 The Monetisation team owns Voi’s core payment flows, subscriptions, upsell and in-app advertising. The technical scope spans core backend systems, payment integrations, native mobile client views and more. This is an excellent opportunity to grow into leadership while having a tangible impact on the micromobility industry.
   

  

* Be a present, hands-on leader for a team of 4–5 engineers: run 1:1s, support growth and create a safe, collaborative environment where people do their best work.
* Partner closely with the Product Manager and Designer to align on priorities, shape the roadmap and drive high-quality delivery.
* Lead by doing: write code, review PRs and engage deeply in technical decisions across backend, web and mobile.
* Champion engineering excellence by guiding architectural decisions, fostering good development practices and promoting continuous improvement – enabling sustainably rapid delivery in a complex micromobility business.
* Coach and develop engineers through feedback, mentorship and clear expectations – with support from us if this is your first formal people management role.
* Lead the team in adopting agentic engineering practices: actively use and encourage AI-assisted development and help engineers build the habits and judgement to get the most out of these tools.
* Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture aligned with Voi’s values, and be a driver for inclusion and psychological safety within your team.


**What You Need To Embark**
 You are a hands-on, collaborative engineer with a passion for both technology and people. You enjoy working across domains, take ownership of delivery and are curious about how AI can elevate the way teams build software.
   

  

* 4+ years of hands-on experience as an engineer in modern tech stacks, building reliable software in a fast-paced environment.
* A generalist mindset with experience in backend, web and/or mobile development.
* 2+ years of experience in a tech lead, senior or informal leadership capacity – you have guided others technically, even if you have not held a management title.
* No prior people management experience required – this is a growth area we will support you in.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools (for example modern code assistants) and a genuine interest in agentic engineering workflows. You lean into these tools and help your team build the skillset to use them effectively.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to navigate both technical and cross-functional conversations with ease.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.


*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*
**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale-ups.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: BI Specialist - Digital Commercial (10 months temporary contract)
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 As a BI Specialist within Digital Commercial at H&M, you will play a key role in transforming digital performance data into accessible, impactful insights for commercial teams across the organization. Working close to the digital business, you will help shape and scale H&M’s digital commercial reporting toolbox by building intuitive, reliable and business-relevant BI solutions that support better, faster decisions.
   

  





 In this role, you combine strong technical BI skills with a genuine curiosity for digital commerce and customer behaviour. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across global and local teams to understand their analytical needs and translate them into clear reporting solutions that help teams understand performance, identify opportunities and take relevant commercial action.
   

  





 To succeed in this role, you will:
   

  




* Build, maintain and continuously improve BI reports, dashboards and data models, primarily using Microsoft Power BI.
* Translate business questions into clear BI solutions across areas such as traffic, customer journey, funnel performance, conversion, product visibility and sales performance.
* Transform large and complex datasets into user-friendly visualizations, data stories and actionable insights.
* Collaborate with commercial stakeholders, analysts and data teams to ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable and business-relevant.
* Contribute to modernizing H&M’s digital commercial reporting toolbox, including exploring how AI-supported capabilities can improve reporting and decision support.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You will be part of the Digital Commercial team, working closely with global and local commercial stakeholders, analysts, data teams and digital functions. The team’s mission is to enable stronger digital commercial performance by making insights more accessible, actionable and connected to business decisions.
   

  





 The role reports to the Digital Commercial Manager.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for people with…
   

  




* Experience in business intelligence, analytics, digital reporting or a similar role, in-house or as a consultant.
* Strong skills in Power BI or similar BI tools, including data modelling and visualization.
* Good knowledge of SQL for querying, transforming and validating data.
* A genuine interest in creating business value through data, analytics and digital commerce.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate business needs into scalable BI solutions and clear data stories.
* Experience from digital commerce, retail, consumer goods or another B2C environment is meriting.
* Experience in applying AI-supported capabilities to improve BI, reporting or decision-making.



 This is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of digital commercial BI at H&M — moving from reporting what happened to helping teams understand what matters, where to focus and how to create value.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**WHO WE ARE** 
 ​
   

  





 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 ​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





**​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
 ​
   

  





 We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
   

  





 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.
   

  





**JOIN US​** 
  

  





 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
   

  





 ​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
   

  





 ​
 *\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​*

title: Technical Director
description:
We are now seeking a Technical Director to take the reins of our new project’s technical vision, a project moving from the prototyping phase into pre-production.
   

  

 As the TD for this specific title, you will transition the project from a proven prototype into a scalable, high-performance production. You will be responsible for defining the technical architecture, establishing the long-term engineering roadmap, and ensuring the team has the robust tools and systems needed to bring this ground-breaking experience to market.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build the Foundation: Transform a successful prototype into a stable, production-ready system, ensuring the technical foundation is scalable for full-scale development.
* Lead the Transition: Guide the engineering team through the shift from experimentation to pre-production, balancing rapid iteration with long-term code health.
* Unreal Engine Stewardship: Set the standard for Unreal Engine development on the project, overseeing everything from core systems to performance optimization and multiplayer stability.
* Strategic Roadmap: Own the technical roadmap, aligning engineering milestones with creative goals and go-to-market timelines.
* Mentor & Grow: Lead and support a dedicated team of engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.
* Cross-Discipline Partnership: Work closely with Art, Design, and Production Directors to ensure technical feasibility and high-performance execution of the game’s creative pillars.


**Who You Are**
* You have a proven track record of taking projects through the full lifecycle, from early concept/pre-production to a successful global launch.
* Extensive experience in Unreal Engine development is a must, specifically regarding how to structure large-scale projects for performance and maintainability.
* You have shipped at least one major title in Unreal Engine, ultimately we are seeking someone with multiplayer experience.
* While you appreciate experimentation, you thrive on bringing order to chaos. You know when to "hack" a prototype and when to "build" a system.
* You are a strong communicator who can mentor senior engineers while clearly explaining technical risks and opportunities to non-technical stakeholders.
* You possess broad technical skills across the game stack and aren't afraid to dive into the code to solve complex architectural challenges.


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Chief Expert / Information Architect in LC&I
description:
**Job ID: 5661**
 Data is the foundation of our business and confidence in data is key for serving our customers in the right way in Large Corporates and Institutions (LC&I). Are you passionate about information architecture and would you like to build deep insight into the LC&I data landscape? We are now looking for an Information Architect who will play a pivotal part in driving strategic deliveries in our Data & AI transformation and ensure reliable and high quality data both for business processes and regulatory purposes.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Welcome to LC&I Data Management. We collaborate closely with the LC&I business and help implementing clever data management practises, often in a complex data landscape. Data is the backbone of everything we do, and the team adds value by ensuring the data meet the business needs and regulatory requirements across the LC&I business value chain. If you are a strategic thinker with passion for information architecture, and have a proven track record of driving complex initiatives through influence and collaboration, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Leading cross-organizational collaboration: Independently collaborate with diverse stakeholders including Service Area/Domain Business Leads, Technology Leads, Architects, Data SMEs etc. to develop comprehensive metadata and information models to enable business objectives
* Driving results through influencing: Drive relevant Data Product deliveries without formal authority by effectively influencing stakeholders and building consensus across the organization
* Stakeholder engagement: Interact with internal stakeholders in LC&I, and coordinate alignment across other Business Areas and Group Functions including Group Technology, GDM and Group Architecture
* AI-powered automation: Develop and implement AI agents to automate manual-heavy processes, enhancing efficiency and reducing operational overhead
* Data Domain expertise: Leverage deep technical and conceptual understanding of LC&I data domains to design robust information architectures that support business objectives
* Data Standards development: Develop data standards and build business information models for Markets data subject areas while ensuring cross data domain alignment and regulatory compliance
* Change leadership: Support business stakeholders in adopting new tools, technologies and methodologies while managing key initiatives under tight timelines and pressure


**Who You Are**
**This is the right role for you if you possess:**
* Data Product Expertise: Strong understanding of data product development, data reference architecture, and data architecture principles
* Information Architecture Competence: Proven ability to independently collaborate across organizations with different stakeholders to develop comprehensive information models
* Influence and Leadership: Demonstrated track record of driving results through effective stakeholder influence, particularly with senior leadership
* AI and Automation Expertise: Strong competence in developing AI agents and automated solutions to streamline manual-heavy processes and resolve bottlenecks in information architecture workflows
* Data Domain Knowledge: Strong technical and conceptual understanding of key financial data domains, including (but not limited to) market risk & valuation data, trade data, instrument data, and custody & safekeeping data
* Risk & regulatory expertise: Deep understanding of data-related banking regulations (e.g., BCBS 239, CRR/CRD, GDPR, ECB supervisory expectations), with the ability to identify data-related risk exposures, navigate complex regulatory requirements, and translate them into practical controls to ensure robust and sustainable compliance
* Communication and Change Management: Exceptional communication skills with proven change management capabilities and a development-oriented mindset
* Performance Under Pressure: Ability to work effectively under pressure while managing tight timelines and competing priorities


**Your background and skills include:**
* Strong background in data management and governance, with expertise in leveraging advanced analytics and automation
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to lead by example and foster collaborative environments
* Fluent in English (professional level)
* Master’s degree preferred in Finance, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Relevant qualifications in data management, information modelling, or AI/ML are considered an advantage


**What We Offer**
**People**

title: Master's thesis: Federated Self-Supervised Learning for Scalable Autonomous Driving
description:
**Background And Project Description**
 Autonomous vehicles generate massive amounts of multi-modal sensor data, including camera images, lidar point clouds, radar measurements, GPS information, and vehicle control signals. These heterogeneous data sources provide complementary information that is essential for robust perception, localization, and decision-making. However, transferring such large volumes of data to centralized servers is often impractical due to bandwidth limitations, storage costs, privacy concerns, and regulatory constraints. Federated Learning (FL) offers a distributed and privacy-preserving framework that enables multiple vehicles, fleets, or organizations to collaboratively train machine learning models without sharing their raw data. While FL has shown significant promise for autonomous driving applications, its effectiveness is often limited by the availability of high-quality labeled data. Deep learning-based perception modules require high-quality annotations, which are costly and complex to obtain. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a solution by leveraging mostly unlabeled data with minimal labels. Early studies show that federated self-supervised training can achieve performance comparable to centralized approaches, with potential improvements as larger unlabeled datasets are used.
   

  

 This thesis project aims to advance federated learning for autonomous vehicles by integrating self-supervised methods with robust aggregation techniques to develop models that are efficient, generalizable, and capable of handling both common and rare driving scenarios, while reducing reliance on manual annotation and avoiding the costs of central data storage.
   

  

 The thesis is part of the research project DREAM – Distributed, Robust and Efficient AI for Autonomous Vehicles. The topic is highly relevant for enabling scalable and efficient AI development in next-generation autonomous driving systems.
   

  

**Main Tasks**
* In this master thesis project, you will focus on:
* A novel self-supervised learning approach to exploit all available data on the central server, even with limited labels
* A hybrid federated learning scheme combining self-supervised and supervised techniques, adapted to local and global learning rounds
* Validation through extensive comparisons with fully supervised learning within the same federated scheme.
* Demonstration of the efficacy of combining self-supervised and supervised learning on the Zenseact Open Dataset (ZoD) under various federated scenarios.
* Present findings to the project partners


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for one or two highly motivated students with a good general background in machine learning and computer vision. The following skills would be essential:
   

  

* Deep learning
* Computer vision
* Python programming
* Reading scientific papers
* Handling complex systems
* Federated learning (would be a bonus)


**Conditions**

* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, apply as soon as possible, but no later than August 31st, 2026.
* Starting date: As soon as possible, not later than September 1st, 2026.
* Credits: 30 points

title: Cloud Platform Product Owner, Aspia Group
description:
**Cloud Platform Product Owner**
 At Aspia, we stand with the leaders, teams and companies who dare to grow. Growth requires clarity, courage and partnership – and we are committed to creating the space where ambition can thrive.
   

  

 As our cloud platform capabilities continue to evolve, we are looking for an experienced Cloud Platform Product Owner to lead the development and continuous improvement of our Azure Landing Zone platform and GitHub Enterprise capabilities for Aspia Group.
   

  

 Aspia is an international group specializing in finance, payroll and HR outsourcing, powered by modern technology and deep human expertise. Across the Nordics, we help organizations simplify complexity so they can focus their energy on what truly drives progress.
   

  

**Role Description**
 As a Cloud Platform Product Owner at Aspia, you will take end-to-end product ownership of our Azure Landing Zone platform and ensure that it continues to enable secure, scalable, and efficient cloud adoption across the group. You will translate business, security, architectural, and application team needs into a clear platform roadmap, priorities, and ways of working.
   

  

 You will lead a skilled platform team of five experienced platform engineers, creating clarity around priorities, backlog, delivery, and stakeholder expectations. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, team leadership, and platform governance. You will also own GitHub Enterprise as a strategic developer platform capability, driving its adoption, governance, lifecycle management, and alignment with our broader cloud and DevOps strategy.
   

  

 You will be part of Group IT Cloud and Operations and work closely with architects, security, application teams, and business stakeholders across the Nordics. The position is based in Stockholm and follows Aspia’s hybrid working model. You will report to the Head of Cloud and Operations. This is a permanent position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the Azure Landing Zone platform as a product, including roadmap, backlog, priorities, lifecycle management, and stakeholder communication
* Lead and support a five-person platform engineering team, ensuring focus, clarity, and effective delivery against agreed priorities
* Drive the continuous development of platform capabilities, standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns that enable secure workload onboarding at scale
* Own GitHub Enterprise as an enterprise platform capability, including governance, adoption, operating model, and alignment with developer and DevOps needs
* Collaborate with architects, security, application teams, and business stakeholders to translate needs into actionable platform improvements
* Define and improve intake, prioritization, and ways of working for platform requests, ensuring transparency and predictable delivery
* Promote a product-oriented platform mindset that improves developer experience, governance, resilience, and long-term maintainability


**What We Expect From You**
* Experience in a Product Owner, Platform Owner, Technical Lead, Engineering Manager, or similar role within cloud platforms or enterprise IT
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, cloud governance, and enterprise-scale platform foundations
* Ability to lead skilled engineers through clear priorities, structured backlog management, and effective stakeholder communication
* Understanding of developer platforms, DevOps practices, and GitHub Enterprise or similar tooling
* Ability to balance technical depth with product thinking, governance, business value, and long-term platform strategy
* Good written and spoken English; Swedish is an advantage
* Relevant education or equivalent practical experience


**We want you to thrive**
 At Aspia, you will join a collaborative environment where curiosity, trust, and continuous improvement are central. You will lead a skilled platform team and play a key role in shaping the cloud and developer platform capabilities that support our growth. This is an opportunity to combine product ownership, team leadership, and platform strategy in an international environment where your work will have a visible impact.
   

  

 We work in a hybrid model with flexible working hours, and we hope to see you a few days per week at our Stockholm office. We also offer employee benefits that support health and wellbeing.
   

  

**This is Aspia**
 Aspia is an industry leader in accounting, payroll, tax, and business‑related advisory services. Together within Aspia Group, we are more than 3,100 employees across over 160 offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Ukraine.
   

  

**The best time in your career**
 Opportunities are endless and ambitions run high – with us, your development possibilities are extensive. Through the work you do and the responsibility you take on, through dialogue with your clients and knowledgeable colleagues, and through clear development and training plans.
   

  

 Our way of working is at the forefront, and we continuously develop our digital services to ensure that working with us feels modern, enjoyable, and efficient. You’ll be part of a market‑leading growth company with great opportunities for an exciting future, shared expertise in entrepreneurship, and access to wide-ranging skills and specialists.
   

  

 We put people at the center and give you the chance to realize your ambitions. We want you, as an employee, to have the best time in your career at Aspia, and we care deeply about ensuring that work and private life are well balanced so that we, as individuals and as a company, can grow side by side.
   

  

**Aspia. Dare to Grow.**

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
**Join Readly!**
 Readly was built on a simple but powerful idea: that curious people should never have to choose between the publications they love and the ones they haven't discovered yet. One subscription. Thousands of titles. Journalism, culture, lifestyle, science, sport, and ideas from around the world, available on any screen, at any moment.
   

  

 Readly is now part of Cafeyn Group. With the acquisition of Readly's non-Nordic operations, Cafeyn further strengthens its position as the European leader in access to information – combining scale, technology, and deep local market expertise.
   

  

 Together, the Group now operates across 15 markets, serves 2.5 million users, and provides access to more than 5,200 publications from 1,100 partner publishers.
   

  

 Our mission?
   

  

 To empower individuals with access to trusted, high-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn & Readly, the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn Group stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join our team and sit at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.
   

  

 In this role, you will own and analyse our key B2C marketing data, helping Marketing teams better understand performance, identify growth opportunities and make data-driven decisions. You’ll go beyond reporting: from analysing the acquisition funnel and running advanced measurement studies to improving attribution, tracking and marketing performance.
   

  

 You’ll also play a key role in making our Marketing teams more autonomous by building self-serve reporting and AI-powered data products, while ensuring that our tracking and data infrastructure remain accurate, compliant and up to date.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills in SQL and Python with a genuine understanding of B2C marketing, strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product and Data stakeholders, making this a highly cross-functional role with a direct impact on our growth strategy.
   

  

**Missions**
* Own B2C marketing KPIs from a data perspective, ensuring that key performance indicators and supporting data points are accurate, reliable and available within a reasonable timeframe for weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Support Marketing teams with reporting, helping them define relevant dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance indicators to answer their business questions.
* Analyse the acquisition funnel, from awareness through to conversion, to identify growth levers and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing teams.
* Run advanced marketing analyses to support strategic decision-making, including initiatives such as Geo-Lift studies, attribution analyses and other measurement approaches. Translate findings into concrete recommendations around budgets, channels and acquisition strategy.
* Implement algorithms and analytical solutions to support Marketing Operations, particularly around attribution and marketing measurement.
* Improve Marketing team autonomy through self-serve data products, enabling stakeholders to answer their day-to-day data questions without relying systematically on an analyst.
* Develop and deploy AI-powered data products and insights, using AI to make marketing stakeholders more autonomous and accelerate access to actionable insights.
* Own and maintain marketing tracking, ensuring that implementation remains compliant with regulations and aligned with changes across advertising platforms and the wider tracking ecosystem.
* Act as a bridge between Marketing and Product to ensure tracking remains up to date, follows best practices and provides the data and signals required for effective acquisition.
* Activate relevant data points within marketing platforms to improve acquisition performance and maximise the value of available customer and behavioural data.


**Requirements**
 We are looking for a data-driven and commercially minded Data Analyst who sits at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.
   

  

 You are naturally curious and enjoy going beyond reporting to understand why performance is changing, identify growth opportunities and turn data into concrete business decisions. You are comfortable owning B2C marketing KPIs and ensuring that the underlying data is accurate, reliable and available when stakeholders need it.
   

  

**Must-have**
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to independently query, analyse and manipulate data.
* Experience working with B2C marketing data, ideally within a subscription-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as acquisition, conversion, trials and churn.
* Proven experience in marketing analytics and reporting, including the ability to translate business questions into relevant analyses and actionable insights.
* Experience with marketing tracking and measurement, including familiarity with GDPR, SKAN, DMA and the broader digital tracking ecosystem.
* Strong analytical storytelling skills, with the ability to identify meaningful insights and clearly communicate recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product and Data teams.


**Nice-to-have**
* Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, Segment, GTM and Amplitude
* Experience with advanced B2C marketing analytics methodologies such as Geo-Lift studies, Multi-Touch Attribution or Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM).
* Experience optimising acquisition strategies through A/B testing, particularly across the upper funnel.
* Experience activating and sharing data points with advertising platforms to improve acquisition performance.
* Experience developing self-serve reporting tools or AI-powered data products that enable business stakeholders to work more independently.


 Hiring process
   

  

* HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)
* Hiring manager Interview with our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement
* Case study that you will present to our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement and Data Analyst Product & Growth
* Last Interview with our Chief of Staff and Head of Marketing


 Perks & benefits of working at Cafeyn
   

  

* 🏥 Private health insurance – Euro Accident coverage with a SEK 750 deductible per claim
* 💰 Pension plan – 4.5% employer contribution on base salary up to 7.5 income base amounts, plus 30% on salary above this threshold
* 🛡️ Life insurance – Coverage of up to SEK 355,200 (2026)
* ⚕️ Disability insurance – Coverage of up to 30 Price Base Amounts (SEK 1,776,000 in 2026)
* 🌍 Easy access – All benefits and work contract are provided through Globalization Partners


***You don’t have to match all the requirements, if you feel this offer could be a great opportunity for you, reach out anyways! We hire based on talent and we promote inclusivity inside Cafeyn and strongly believe that our culture is strongest when it is the most diverse.***

title: BIM- och Datasamordnare
description:
