title: Tech Lead till Apotek Hjärtat
description:
En strategisk roll med tydligt mjukvaru- och lösningsarkitekt fokus inom e‑handel och omnichannel.
   

  

**Så här jobbar du som Tech Lead på Hjärtat** 
  

  

 Som Tech Lead inom E-handel på Apotek Hjärtat har du ett övergripande ansvar för arkitektur och teknisk riktning inom vårt e-handelsområde. Fokus ligger på mjukvaru- och lösningsarkitektur i en composable och integrationsintensiv miljö, där du säkerställer att våra lösningar är skalbara, hållbara och stödjer både affären och kundupplevelsen över tid.
   

  

 Även om titeln är Tech Lead är rollen i praktiken nära en arkitektroll, där du arbetar strategiskt med målbild, principer och tekniska vägval snarare än operativ utveckling.
   

  

 Utvecklingen sker primärt genom externa team, där du sätter riktning, kvalitetssäkrar lösningar och säkerställer att arkitekturen håller ihop över tid. Du samarbetar nära produktägare, service managers, arkitekter och andra nyckelfunktioner inom tech och verksamheten, och omsätter affärsbehov till tekniska beslut och prioriteringar.
   

  

 Rollen är en viktig del av vår digitalisering och AI-transformation, där du omsätter strategi till konkret utveckling. Du säkerställer att teamen har rätt förutsättningar att arbeta datadrivet och med AI – på ett effektivt, hållbart och säkert sätt.
   

  

**Dina Huvudsakliga Ansvarsområden**
* Sätta, utveckla och förvalta teknisk riktning och arkitektur för e-handeln inom domänen Commerce
* Driva tekniska vägval och prioriteringar tillsammans med produkt och tech
* Säkerställa kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet – från designprinciper till förvaltning
* Bidra till driftsäkerhet genom förståelse för CI/CD, monitorering och observability
* Vara tekniskt bollplank och mentor, och bidra till kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring
* Bidra aktivt i domänforum och tvärfunktionella initiativ med andra tech leads och arkitekter


**Är du den vi söker?** 
  

  

 Vi söker dig som har en gedigen teknisk bakgrund och trivs i en strategisk roll med helhetsansvar. Du har förmågan att se samband i komplexa systemlandskap, fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut och kommunicera dessa tydligt till olika målgrupper.
   

  

 Du är van att arbeta nära både affär och tech och känner dig trygg i att leda genom riktning snarare än genom operativt utvecklingsarbete. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Vi Ser Att Du Har**
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaru- och lösningsarkitektur i komplexa, integrationsintensiva miljöer, gärna inom e-handel eller retail
* God förståelse för composable/headless‑arkitektur, mikrotjänster och integrationslandskap
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar och DevOps-arbetssätt
* Förmåga att använda AI- och datadrivna lösningar för att skapa affärsvärde och påverka arkitekturval


 Har du dessutom erfarenhet av e‑handelsplattformar som commercetools, CMS‑ eller integrationsplattformar ser vi det som ett stort plus.
   

  

**Hitta hem hos oss**
 På Hjärtat har vi ett fantastiskt uppdrag: vi hjälper människor att må bättre. Vi finns för alla i Sverige – för de sjuka och för de friska, genom livets alla faser. Med 400 apotek i hela landet och en e-handel som aldrig stänger, finns vi alltid nära. Vi är över 4000 kollegor som tillsammans möter våra kunder med omtanke, var de än befinner sig. Tillsammans bygger vi en kultur där vi är ett lag som litar på varandra, ser varandras förmågor och där alla kan bidra och påverka. Där vi alltid utgår från vårt samhällsuppdrag och där det finns plats för nya idéer och innovation. För oss är det viktigt att ta vara på våra medarbetares kunskap och tankar och vår hemvist i ICA Gruppen ger stora möjligheter till både personlig och yrkesmässig utveckling. Här finns en plats för dig med Hjärtat på rätt ställe.
   

  

  

  

**Din ansökan**
 På Hjärtat strävar vi efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund! Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag 20/8, skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå arbetspsykologiskatester och bakgrundskontroller innan anställning. All extern hjälp med rekrytering undanbedes.
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid eller enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Tillträde till tjänsten sker enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Har du frågor om tjänsten kontakta Anna Spångberg, anna.spangberg@apotekhjartat.se
   

  

 För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Klara Himmelstrand, klara.himmelstrand@apotekhjartat.se.
   

  

  

  

**Välkommen till oss - ett apotek med Hjärtat på rätt ställe!**

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ANALYST
description:
**Data Analyst, Customer Service**
 With millions of interactions each year, SAS Customer Service plays a fundamental role in shaping our passenger experience. We are now undertaking a significant transformation - leveraging digitalization, automation, and continuous process innovation to elevate service standards at every stage of the journey. To support us on this journey, we are seeking a Customer Service Data Analyst.
   

  

**Challenges You Will Work On**
 In this role, you will work closely with development teams, process experts, business developers, and leaders to ensure that SAS Customer Service has access to clear, structured, and actionable data. Your insights will guide operational decisions, strengthen performance management, and directly support our strategic ambitions.
   

  

 You will also play a key role in shaping our future data roadmap, helping SAS Customer Service become increasingly insight-driven, predictive, and proactive in how we serve passengers.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses in Power BI
* Continuously develop and improve our BI setup
* Support metric development and performance tracking
* Contribute to business case development
* Analyze long-term trends and provide actionable recommendations
* Lead initiatives to make customer service data accessible and actionable across the organization
* Identify opportunities to use automation, AI, and predictive analytics to make Customer Service more proactive, efficient, and insight-driven
* Engage and train business users to generate insights from data


**To be successful we believe you have**
* A degree or relevant professional experience in statistics, data science, engineering, finance, or a related field
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including building data models and creating actionable reports and dashboards
* Proven ability to analyze structured data from multiple sources and communicate insights clearly and effectively
* Solid understanding of data modeling principles
* Fluency in English
* Curiosity and hands-on interest in using AI and automation to improve analytics, reporting, and business decision-making, combined with the ability to critically validate AI-generated insights


**Nice-to-haves**
* Experience working with data from customer service, CRM, contact center, or digital channels
* Experience with predictive analytics, forecasting, or anomaly detection
* Familiarity with working in agile, cross-functional teams


 As a person, we believe you are highly analytical, curious, and comfortable working with complex data sets. You are skilled at transforming data into clear, actionable insights and can communicate your findings in a pedagogical and accessible way, adapting your message to different stakeholders across the organization. You are proactive, self-motivated, and take ownership of your responsibilities. You also have a strong interest in how AI, automation, and new technologies can improve analytics, decision-making, and customer service. Strong collaboration skills are essential for success in this role, as you will work closely with teams across the business to drive continuous improvement and support our transformation journey.
   

  

**Why SAS?**
**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and
* Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Deadline for application: 30/08/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Desired start date: Asap
* Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite.


 If you have questions about this position, you are welcome to contact Andreas Broberg Henning, Head of Digital Customer Service & Analytics at andreas.henning@sas.se . Please note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email due to the GDPR regulations.
   

  

 Come and fly with us!

title: Social Content Creator
description:
**Established in 1986 in the Swedish mountains, our love for skiing in untouched terrain and embarking on adventures in the wild run deep. Our purpose is simple: to bring this freeride spirit to the world. With our products, we aim to make adventures possible 365 days a year.** 




  





**We are driven by passion, togetherhood, responsibility and winning spirit. We know that an inspiring spread of unique abilities and personalities contribute to our dynamic culture and our success. Now, we are looking for a new talent to join our team.** 




  





 As Social Content Creator, you will bring Peak Performance to life across our social channels through engaging, platform-native content. Working closely with athletes, creators and cross-functional teams, you create, publish and optimize content that strengthens our community, grows engagement and supports our brand and business goals. With a strong understanding of social trends, culture and storytelling, you ensure our content remains relevant, authentic and impactful.
 



 This is a unique opportunity to work closely with professional athletes, create content in outdoor environments and help shape how Peak Performance shows up across social media.
 



  





 This role can be based at our HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, or remotely within the UK or central Europe.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Drive day-to-day management of Peak Performance’s social media channels, regularly developing platform-native content that resonates with our audience and enhances brand storytelling.
* Production of social-first content ideas and able to execute and quickly turnaround high-quality content with consideration of storyline and platform needs (sound design/ motion graphics/subtitles). Highly skilled in capturing premium content using professional cameras and mobile phones.
* Recommendation of new content formats, themes and trends relevant for strengthening our social media channels.



  





**Who we think you are:** 



* A highly creative and culturally-attuned social media enthusiast with strong communications and storytelling skills. Curious about new technology, formats and creative techniques.
* Proactive and highly organized – capable of managing footage, file structures, backups and content delivery
* Confident working with athletes, creators and production teams, able to build trust and capture authentic moments in live environments without disruption.



  





**Job Requirements:** 



* High level understanding of social media platform functionality, including sound design, motion graphics, subtitles, and platform-specific formatting.
* Confident producing photography, short-form video, interviews, BTS content and longer-form storytelling.
* Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop and Lightroom.
* Strong and confident skier, capable of capturing content and working safely alongside professional athletes in challenging mountain environments. Avalanche safety training / mountain qualifications are highly desirable.
* The ability to travel regularly and attend productions and shoots is integral to the role.
* Full driving license with confidence driving in winter conditions.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.



  





**What we offer:** 




 We offer you an inspiring work environment where our values of Passion, Togetherhood, Responsibility and Winning Spirit are at the core of everything we do, promoting creativity, teamwork, accountability, and progress. You get the opportunity to work with a great team that shares your passion for sports and outdoor life. We are on a growth journey, finding our line and building our future success. That provides interesting challenges and possibilities in all roles for the person who is curious and likes to get things done. We’re small enough for you to play a key role regardless of your position, but big enough to have a global presence. At Peak Performance, you get the best of both worlds.
 



  





 If our values inspire you and you share our passion for outdoor sports and products that combines style and performance, we want you to join our winning team. Apply now and unlock your freeride spirit!

title: HR Business Partner, Nordics
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 It's an exciting time at Netflix as we continue to expand our business globally. We are revolutionizing the way people watch their favorite shows and movies, and building our own library of original Netflix content for our members to enjoy. Visit our Culture Memo and Long-Term View to learn more about our unique Netflix culture and our bold goals for the future.
   

  

 As Netflix continues to evolve, we are looking for a HR Business Partner (HRBP) for the Nordics. Our HRBPs are the primary partners providing guidance, coaching and advice to people leaders and teams. A key area of focus for the HRBP is to help increase leadership impact and capabilities as well as enhance organizational health that help drive high performance across the organisation in an inclusive way.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as a strategic talent partner for the Country Leadership Teams in Nordics. Collaborating with them to translate business goals into clear people strategies and priorities.
* Work in collaboration with other HRBPs and Global Business Practices (“GBPs”) - Talent Acquisition, Inclusion Strategy, Talent Management, Compensation & Employee Programs, and Talent Operations & Technology to ensure a consistent and cohesive employee experience across the Nordics.
* Collaborate closely with EMEA Functional HRBPs and GBPs to plan and execute strategic talent initiatives across the region.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders in EMEA. Ability to navigate complexity and influence stakeholders effectively to drive HR initiatives.
* Develop a deep understanding of the Netflix business and culture, serving as a role model and advocate for the company's values including our focus on inclusion and diversity.
* Drive talent management programs focused on enhancing leadership and management capabilities, increasing talent density, and promoting inclusion and diversity in line with our global practices.
* Develop and support top regional leaders, including succession planning for critical roles.
* Partner with leaders on org design decisions, ensuring structure and roles keep pace as the business evolves and that designs support diverse teams and equitable opportunities.
* Evaluate employee sentiment and provide guidance and coaching to people leaders to improve overall team effectiveness and organizational health.
* Take the lead in managing employee relations matters, including performance management, terminations, and leaves of absence, in partnership with the Employment Legal and Employee Services team ensuring practices are fair, non‑discriminatory, and compliant with local regulations


**Profile / Experience**
* 6 or more years of relevant Human Resources experience in a multinational corporation.
* Strong understanding of both business and HR concepts, including problem-solving skills, judgment, critical thinking, and analytical capabilities.
* Proficiency in Inclusion and Diversity and the ability to apply it effectively within the organization including partnering across cultures and accommodating different needs where required.
* Possesses intellectual curiosity to bring insight into the team and business.
* Capability to influence stakeholders and prioritize tasks and initiatives effectively..
* Experience working in a highly matrixed, global organization, with the ability to navigate complex structures.
* Proficiency in project management and execution skills to drive HR initiatives.
* Demonstrable experience in coaching and consulting within a high-performance culture.


 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
   

  

 We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: Verksamhetssamordnare - Fastighetsavdelningen
description:
Är du vår näste verksamhetssamordnare?
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I takt med att Svenska kraftnät växer, så växer också behovet av stöd till fastighetsavdelningens ledningsgrupp för att omsätta strategi och mål till genomförande.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter som verksamhetssamordnare är därför att skapa struktur i avdelningens planering, uppföljning och rapportering och driva verksamhetsutveckling som stärker avdelningens leveransförmåga, effektivitet och kvalitet.
   

  

 I arbetet ingår bl.a. följande arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Samordna avdelningens verksamhetsplanering.
* Driva och stödja prioriterade verksamhetsutvecklingsinitiativ.
* Ta fram analyser, beslutsunderlag och presentationer till avdelningschef och ledningsgrupp.
* Utveckla, dokumentera och implementera effektiva processer, värdeflöden, arbetssätt och styrande rutiner.
* Samordna avdelningens budget- och prognosprocess.
* Förbereda och delta i ledningsgruppsmöten.


 Uppdraget spänner över hela Fastighetsavdelningen och innebär nära samarbete med avdelningschef, enhetschefer, koordinator, controllers, sakkunniga och andra verksamhetssamordnare inom divisionen.
   

  

 Rollen deltar i ledningsgruppens arbete och behöver kunna växla mellan strategiska frågor, analys, samordning och praktiskt genomförande.
   

  

 De största utmaningarna i tjänsten kommer att vara att skapa fokus och framdrift när flera viktiga initiativ konkurrerar om samma tid, kompetenser och resurser. Att driva förändring och följa upp leveranser utan direkt linjemandat samt ha förmågan att navigera i en stor och komplex organisation.
   

  

 Du kommer att tillhöra Fastighetsavdelningen på Svenska kraftnät, och vara delaktig i enhetens arbete med att utveckla organisationen samt bedriva förändrings- och förbättringsarbeten.
   

  

 Avdelningen består av cirka 50 anställda och konsulter. Verksamhetssamordnaren rapporterar till avdelningschef Fastighet och deltar i avdelningens ledningsgrupp. Rollen arbetar nära avdelningens enhetschefer och koordinatorer samt samverkar med bland annat ekonomi, HR, inköp, säkerhet, hållbarhet, IT och andra verksamhetssamordnare inom organisationen.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Personliga egenskaper:
   

  

 För att ta dig an och lyckas bra i denna roll är det även viktigt att du är en trygg och stabil person som har förmågan att bygga tillit och förtroende. Det är viktigt att du kan samarbeta, skapa goda relationer och nätverk över hela verksamheten samtidigt som du driver dina projekt med god framdrift.
   

  

 Det är viktigt att du tar dig an dina uppgifter på ett strukturerat sätt och trivs i en miljö där allt inte alla gånger är på plats, men där du får möjlighet att påverka och tycka till. Din prioriteringsförmåga är god och du känner dig trygg i din kompetens och litar på ditt eget omdöme när du dagligen behöver prioritera och fatta beslut i ditt arbete.
   

  

 I arbetet som verksamhetsutvecklare kommer du att behöva hantera säkerhetsskyddsklassificerade uppgifter. Vi ställer därför krav på hög integritet, att du är riskmedveten, noggrann och strukturerad.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Utbildning:
   

  

 Relevant akademisk eller annan eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis verksamhetsutveckling, organisation, ekonomi, teknik eller motsvarande kompetens som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Minst tre års aktuell erfarenhet av kvalificerat arbete inom verksamhets-utveckling, strategisk samordning, verksamhetsstyrning, PMO eller liknande.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt driva förbättrings- eller förändringsinitiativ från identifierat behov och analys till implementering och uppföljning av resultat.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag samt presentera dessa för chefer eller ledningsgrupp.
* Erfarenhet av att koordinera verksamhetsplanering, måluppföljning och rapportering samt av att samordna flera intressenter och beroenden.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet från en större eller komplex organisation, gärna statlig myndighet, annan offentlig verksamhet eller samhällsviktig verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av fastighets-, lokal-, service- eller säkerhetsrelaterad verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av processkartläggning, värdeflödesanalys, Lean eller annan etablerad metod för kontinuerliga förbättringar.
* Erfarenhet av budget-, prognos- eller ekonomisk uppföljning i nära samarbete med chefer och ekonomifunktion.
* Erfarenhet av digitalisering, BI- och visualiseringsverktyg, automatisering eller verksamhetsnära tillämpning av AI.


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg.
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter.
* Resor förekommer i begränsad omfattning i denna tjänst.
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, utan provanställning.
* Sista ansökningsdag är den 10 september 2026.
* Vi har avskaffat det personliga brevet så när du ansöker behöver du istället besvara ett antal frågor.
* Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T.
* Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät


**Vid frågor, kontakta gärna följande personer:**
* Christoffer Denkert, Rekryterande chef, 010-350 90 80.
* Lennart Jansson, Ansvarig rekryterare, 010-350 91 49.
* Annika Ingeborn, facklig representant SACO, 010 475 87 72
* Erica Midfjäll, facklig representant ST, 010 475 87 31


 Du når oss också via e-post: Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se.
   

  

 Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare i samband med rekrytering, vi har upphandlade avtal som gäller för Svenska kraftnät som statlig myndighet.
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretess-medvetenhet. Inför anställning genomförs säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) vilket innefattar grundutredning och om anställningen avser befattning i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövningen även att innefatta en registerkontroll. För anställning på Svenska kraftnät kan det vara ett krav på svenskt medborgarskap i vissa befattningar. Med anställningen följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. För mer information om personalsäkerhet på svenska kraftnät. https://www.svk.se/sakerhet-och-beredskap/sakerhetsskydd/personalsakerhet

title: Product Manager
description:
At TRATON Group, we work with our brands to make transportation more sustainable. Join us and help shape the future of mobility.
   

  

 Within Group Product management we solve strategic challenges in a collaborative, international environment where ideas and expertise are openly shared.
   

  

 With Scania, MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, TRATON Group is a global leader in commercial vehicles. Across light-duty vehicles, trucks, and buses, we combine scale, expertise, and brand strength to drive the shift to sustainable transport.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Product Manager to shape TRATON Group’s portfolio for charging and power distribution within E-mobility. In this role, you will define cross-brand product direction and turn market needs into scalable, competitive solutions.
   

  

 You will lead product strategy and roadmaps across brands, working closely with engineering, brand organizations, and senior stakeholders in a fast-moving international setting.
   

  

 The role is based at TRATON GPM in Södertälje or Munich with global impact across all TRATON brands.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own the group product portfolio for charging, ePTO and power distribution system, including lifecycle management and feature prioritization across brands.
* Prioritize requirements based on market demand, customer value, technology maturity, and business impact.
* Sponsor cross-brand product initiatives from opportunity definition to Start of Project, ensuring needs are matured, aligned, and initiated according to ONE PDP.
* Lead the strategy and roadmap for charging, ePTO and power distribution ensuring the group’s solutions are aligned with long-term business objectives and customer needs.
* Drive alignment across brands, commercial planning and industrial operations.
* Manage budget and bucket processes for the product area.
* Apply modularization and user-factor principles to define scalable, harmonized solutions.
* Act as business owner for Value Creation Teams in the flow landscape, driving effective governance, stakeholder alignment, and continuous development of ways of working.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams, brand organizations, and key stakeholders such as TRATON Charging Solutions and ERINION.
* Contribute to the wider TRATON Group E-mobility roadmap by identifying strategic opportunities, market trends, technology developments, and cross-functional synergies.
* Prepare decision material, analysis, and presentations for senior stakeholders.
* Provide input to process improvement initiatives across the Group Product Management organization, increasing efficiency, transparency, and cross-brand collaboration.


**Who You Are**
* Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical field.
* 3–7 years of experience in product management, product planning, project management, or charging infrastructure within automotive or mobility.
* Technical or commercial experience in the charging infrastructure ecosystem, ideally in customer-facing projects.
* Strong understanding of vehicle architecture and E-mobility systems.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and build alignment across stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with experience preparing material for senior leadership.
* Adaptable, curious, and comfortable working in an international environment.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.


**TRATON AB Offers**
 We offer a flexible, hybrid workplace and opportunities for local and international career growth through structured development and training.
   

  

 Benefits include wellness support, bonus, flexible working hours, company car leasing, and employee events.
   

  

**Application**
 Please submit your CV and relevant certificates and upload your CV in English. We cannot accept applications by email due to GDPR. We welcome all applicants and are committed to a diverse recruitment process.
   

  

 For questions about the role, contact Hiring Manager Anders Lampinen, Head of E-mobility, at anders.lampinen@se.traton.com. For questions about the recruitment process, please contact the Talent Acquisition Specialist, Magdalena Bąk magdalena.bak@scania.com.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, and no later than 2026-08-15. Screening will be conducted continuously. Logical and personality tests may be part of the selection process, and a background check may be required.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Anyfin is building the next generation of consumer finance. We’re profitable, scaling quickly and now operating with a banking license which opens up a lot of technical complexity.
   

  

 We’re looking for a senior cloud engineer who enjoys moving fast, taking real ownership and building systems that actually have an impact.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.
   

  

 This isn’t a place where you disappear into a big org. If you join, you’ll have real influence on what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Designing, deploying and operating cloud infrastructure and services on GCP to support scalable and reliable systems.
* Building, optimizing and scaling backend systems with a cloud-first mindset, using Node.js and SQL (Postgres).
* Contributing to system architecture to ensure cloud scalability, reliability and maintainability of financial systems.
* Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to shape both product direction and business strategy.
* Sharing cloud and infrastructure expertise with the team while promoting best practices.


 Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, React, React Native running on Google Cloud Platform.
   

  

**How We Think About Building**
 We’re pragmatic. We like speed, but we also care about building things that last.
   

  

 AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s embedded in how we work helping engineers move faster, reduce friction and focus on solving meaningful problems.
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers who are curious about that shift and want to be part of it, rather than people who feel like good engineering means doing everything the hard way.
   

  

 No ego. Just good judgment and high output.
   

  

**You’ll thrive here if you…**
* Have solid experience building backend systems with cloud-first practices and working with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
* Care about craftsmanship, performance and reliability in the systems you build.
* Take responsibility naturally and don’t wait to be told what to do.
* Enjoy messy problems and figuring things out as you go.
* Like being in an ambitious and collaborative team.
* Want to build, not just maintain.


**You’re Comfortable With Things Like**
* Strong background in cloud infrastructure and backend development with Node.js and SQL databases (preferably Postgres).
* Experience in designing, deploying and monitoring solutions on major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
* At least 5 years of professional experience, ideally in high-stakes environments like finance.
* Passionate about solving complex backend and cloud problems with clean, pragmatic solutions.
* Solid understanding of system design and architecture.
* Bonus if you’ve worked with React, Python, Go, GraphQL, Kubernetes, or DevOps with Github Actions.


**A few practical notes**
* Stockholm based.
* EU work authorization required


**Why Anyfin?**
 Because this is one of those moments where a company is about to level up: Banking license secured, expansion ahead and a lot to build.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a small, high-trust team doing meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you want the responsibility that comes with real impact.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Är du en ingenjör som brinner för:**
**Utveckling?**
**Underhåll?**
**Struktur?**
**Då är du vår nya Reliability Engineer** 
**på Sherwin-Williams!**
*Sherwin-Williams söker nu dig som vill vara en del av arbetet med underhåll och leda det framåt på världens största färgföretag!*
**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som
 **Reliability Engineer** 
 kommer du ansvara för driftsäkerhet, underhåll och utveckling av maskinparken på fabriken i Märsta.
   

  

 Du kommer leda arbetet med att digitalisera och utveckla vårt underhållsarbete. Ett nytt systemstöd skall på plats och där till både processer och rutiner.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är under ständig utveckling och du kommer få både initiera och driva mindre projekt. Du tillhör underhållsavdelningen där också elektriker och mekaniker ingår. Vi jobbar med kemiska produkter och i din roll är det av största vikt att se till att vi följer de lagar och regler som finns inom ditt ansvarsområde. Du kommer rapportera till vår Engnieering Manager.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Ansvarsområden
   

  

* Hantera och granska underhålls-KPI:er, analysera data och presentera möjligheter till förbättringar inom områden som tillförlitlighet, hälsa och säkerhet, kvalitet, kostnadsminskning, cykeltid och driftsförbättringar.
* Ansvarig för att planera och stödja alla underhållsaktiviteter och hantera tillgängligheten


 av utrustningen.
   

  

* Ansvarig för att boka in och följa upp externa företag som kommer till fabriken för service och underhåll.
* Hantera det datoriserade underhållshanteringssystemet (CMMS), vilket ger superanvändarkapacitet med avseende på vårt Reliability Excellence-program
* Säkerställa att alla kritiska reservdelar är identifierade och har uppdaterad Min-Max-nivå.
* Deltaga och leda processer, som: Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM),
* Se över och utveckla vår underhållsstrategi tillsammans med Engineering Manager.


**Qualifications**
**Din profil**
 Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid dig som person, då denna roll kommer att samarbeta tätt med andra grupperingar internt som externt.
   

  

 Vi tror att du som söker tjänsten har arbetat med liknande arbetsuppgifter eller motsvarande idag. Kanske är du underhållsingenjör eller Processingenjör och vill ta nästa steg i karriären.
   

  

 Du kommer själv göra bedömningen om vilka åtgärder som är lämpliga för att maskinerna ska fungera på bästa sätt så din tekniska kunskap och kompetens är viktig för oss.
   

  

 Du skulle beskriva dig själv som strukturerad med bra organisationsförmåga, händig och en person med god datavana. Du har inga bekymmer med ritningsläsning.
   

  

**Utbildning**
 Vi vill att du minst har en kandidatexamen i ett teknikrelaterat område, gärna inom mekanik, elektronik eller produktion.
   

  

 Hos Sherwin-Williams trivs du som gillar att arbeta med ständiga förbättringar och som lockas av möjligheten att utvecklas i ett globalt företag.
   

  

 Du arbetar dagtid, utgår ifrån Märsta och blir anställd direkt av Sherwin-Williams.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent and passion make it possible to live this purpose, and for customers and our business to achieve great results. Sherwin-Williams is a place that takes its stability, growth and momentum and translates it to possibility for our people. Our people are behind the strength of our success, and we invest and support you in:
   

  

 Life … with rewards, benefits and the flexibility to enhance your health and well-being
   

  

 Career … with opportunities to learn, develop new skills and grow your contribution
   

  

 Connection … with an inclusive team and commitment to our own and broader communities
   

  

 It's all here for you... let's Create Your
 **Possible**
 Eligibility to Work
   

  

 You will need to provide proof of right to work. It is a condition of any offer of employment we make to you that you have the permission to work in the country for the role for which you are applying for.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 An equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, colour, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnic or national origin, disability, age pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, or any other protected characteristic prohibited by law.
   

  

 Please be aware, Sherwin-Williams recruiting team members will never request a candidate to provide a payment, ask for financial information, or sensitive personal information like national identification numbers, date of birth, or bank account numbers during the application process.

title: Implema & Friends
description:
**Är du giggare? Bli en Implema Friend.** 




  





 Tillsammans är alltid starkare. Vi anlitar gärna dig som har senior kompetens. För vi vet att det blir bra när våra konsulter, underkonsulter och kunder samarbetar.
 



 För dig som är underkonsult finns det goda möjligheter till olika uppdrag inom spännande projekt hos oss. Vi har starka relationer till våra underkonsulter och vill nu växa vårt nätverk.

title: Solution Architect – Infor S21 Finance
description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and technology, where every architectural decision helps create stable, scalable, and future-ready business solutions? Here, your expertise helps ensure that finance processes and platforms remain secure, compliant, and ready for the future.
   

  

**Why Sandvik?**
 This is an opportunity to shape and govern the finance architecture of a complex global ERP landscape while working closely with business and technology stakeholders. You play a key role in ensuring that finance solutions remain secure, compliant, and ready for future transformation.
   

  

* Drive the architecture direction for core finance solutions and processes.
* Work across finance, IT, vendors, and global stakeholders.
* Influence long-term platform sustainability, standardization, and continuous improvement.


**About The Job**
 You’re accountable for the end-to-end finance solution architecture within the Aurora/Infor System21 landscape. You ensure that finance processes, integrations, data flows, controls, and reporting solutions support business priorities while aligning enterprise architecture principles. You proactively identify, manage, and mitigate risks. This position combines architecture ownership with hands-on collaboration across finance and technology communities. Through experience in similar roles, you have developed a strong understanding of the full software development and product lifecycle.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and maintain the Infor S21 finance solution architecture, including target-state roadmap and design principles.
* Govern solution design decisions for enhancements, projects, upgrades, and ongoing improvements.
* Drive standardization of the financial solution and actively manage technical debt.
* Design and oversee finance integrations, data flows, and reporting interfaces across connected platforms.
* Plan, coordinate, and manage testing activities.
* Support Internal and External Audits.
* Analyze, identify, and resolve application issues.
* Safeguard data integrity, security, auditability, and compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities for automation, reporting improvements, and AI-enabled efficiencies while collaborating with stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors, and partners.


**Location and flexibility**
 The position is intended for candidates within the Nordics or the UK. For internal candidates, global flexibility may be considered.
   

  

**Your profile**
 Success in this position comes from combining strong finance process knowledge with solid ERP architecture expertise. You’ve worked with complex application landscapes and understand how to balance business requirements, governance, compliance, and long-term solution sustainability.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* Experience as an ERP or application architect with strong finance domain expertise.
* Experience supporting finance applications and processes such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Bank Accounting, Asset Accounting, tax determination, and reporting.
* Experience with Infor System21 or similar ERP platforms such as Infor M3, JD Edwards,or other IBMi based business applications
* Experience designing and governing integrations, reporting solutions, and data flows across enterprise environments.
* Experience working with global organizations as well as vendors, application management providers, and implementation partners.


 Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable working across finance, architecture, delivery, and vendor teams. A thoughtful and analytical approach helps you solve complex challenges, while strong communication skills allow you to explain technical decisions clearly to both business and IT audiences. You’re confident in challenging unnecessary customization and advocating for sustainable, standardized solutions that create long-term value.
   

  

**Our culture**
 At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

 For further information about this position, please contact Sumita Sukumaran, hiring manager, sumita.sukumaran@sandvik.com.

title: MEMS Design Engineer
description:
Join Silex Microsystems as a MEMS Design Engineer and play a key role in enabling the manufacturing of cutting-edge MEMS products for leading global customers. In this position, you will work at the intersection of design and production, ensuring that innovative concepts are translated into manufacturable solutions. The role offers a mix of technical challenges, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to influence both new and existing product designs.
   

  

 Would you like to know more about Silex and what we do? Read more here.
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Be responsible for setup of wafer layouts in CAD tool for both new and existing customers entering production
* Optimize and propose modifications to customer designs based on design rules to ensure manufacturability
* Maintain and define design guidelines and related documentation
* Participate in customer dialogues regarding design-related topics
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers to ensure product specifications are met


**We are looking for someone who has:**
* A Master’s degree in a relevant field
* Professional experience in designing MEMS or closely related disciplines such as IC design or PCB design
* Professional experience in MEMS production is considered a strong merit
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Swedish is considered a plus
* A structured way of working and a strong willingness to learn and develop within Silex


**What we offer you:**
* The chance to work closely with fantastic colleagues
* The opportunity to work with the latest technology in MEMS
* To be part of a leading company driving technology development in the industry
* Strong knowledge exchange with the world's foremost experts in process integration and process development of MEMS


**About Silex**
 Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
   

  

 The Silex team brings together talented, curious, visionary, and determined individuals to break new ground in the industry alongside customers, developing the latest process technology within MEMS for global applications. As part of this team, you will work with some of the world’s largest technology giants and innovation leaders in industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.
   

  

 We look forward to your application and to welcoming you on this exciting journey!

title: NEW - Principal Safety Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Principal Safety Engineer / Architect to join our Autonomous Driving team in Europe. You will serve as the primary technical authority for safety integrity across our SAE Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS), owning the end-to-end safety argument—from hazard identification and system architecture through to regulatory approval and commercial robotaxi deployment.
   

  

**About Bolt**
 Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.
   

  

 From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.
   

  

 And we're just getting started.
   

  

**Why join Bolt?**
* Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
* Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
* Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
* Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


**About The Role**
 As a Principal Safety Engineer, you will be the guardian of safety integrity across our SAE Level 4 Autonomous Product and the broader robotaxi ecosystem. You will own the complete, end-to-end L4 safety case—from hazard analysis (HARA) and operational design domain (ODD) definition through to system design, verification, and regulatory approval. Crucially, you will ensure that L4 product safety requirements and rigor extend throughout the entire lifecycle of robotaxi operations, guaranteeing seamless safety continuity from initial product development to live, on-road fleet service.
   

  

 This is not a compliance checkbox role; you will carry accountability that matters. You will shape how safety is embedded across the organisation and the robotaxi ecosystem, influencing fail-operational system architecture, operational workflows, engineering practices, and decision-making at every level. You will work closely with engineering, product, fleet operations, and regulatory stakeholders to define what "safe enough" means for autonomous urban mobility—and ensure it is rigorously achieved, defended, and maintained across ongoing fleet operations.
   

  

**Main Tasks And Responsibilities**
* Own, structure, and maintain the system-level GSN/CAE safety case for the L4 ADS across the entire robotaxi operational lifecycle, ensuring full compliance and alignment with key L4 standards and regulations, including Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426, UN Regulation No. 185 (ADS), ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO/SAE 21434, and UN R155/R156 SUMS.
* Lead hazard analysis (HARA), ODD definition, and safety architecture across different products.
* Define and drive verification and validation strategies for different deployments.
* Define and drive verification and validation strategies for different deployments, establishing lifecycle safety metrics and monitoring to ensure continued operational safety across active robotaxi fleets.
* Drive L4 homologation pathways and compliance validation against regulatory frameworks (including Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426, UN Regulation No. 185, UN WP.29, EU AV legislation, and national frameworks) to secure type approval readiness for commercial L4 robotaxi deployments.
* Collaborate across teams to embed safety principles into system design, development, and deployment.


**About You**
* Extensive experience (10-12+ years) in automotive, robotics, or aerospace systems engineering, with proven technical leadership in safety-critical L4 autonomous driving domains.
* Strong expertise in functional safety (ISO 26262), SOTIF (ISO 21448), and automotive cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434).
* Proven track record delivering auditable safety cases (using GSN or CAE) and supporting L4 homologation, certification, or type approval for complex automated driving systems.
* Deep understanding of autonomous driving system architecture (perception, sensor fusion, planning, control).
* Deep expertise in fail-operational system architectures (redundant steering, braking, power), minimum risk maneuvers (MRM), and safety conformity for ML-based perception (e.g. ISO/PAS 8800).
* Familiarity with tools such as DOORS, Polarion, Codebeamer, or similar requirements and safety tooling.


 Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don't tick every box, please consider applying if you feel you're the kind of person described above!
   

  

**Why you'll love it here**
* Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
* Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
* Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
* Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
* Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
* Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


 Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.
   

  

 At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there's a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You're still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.
   

  

 Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don't tick every box, please consider applying!
   

  

**Everyone is welcome**
 Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

title: FoUUi-ansvarig inom Diagnostik och teknik
description:
**Vi söker FoUU-ansvarig till område Diagnostik och Teknik**




**Vill du utveckla framtidens forskning, utbildning och innovation på Södersjukhuset? Nu söker vi en FoUUi-ansvarig till område Diagnostik och teknik.**




 Inom område Diagnostik och Teknik arbetar cirka 350 medarbetare inom radiologi, klinisk fysiologi, bröstradiologi, medicinsk teknik, IT och sjukhusfysik. Området präglas av hög teknisk utveckling, modern maskinpark, ett växande fokus på artificiell intelligens och ett starkt engagemang för innovation. Vi har idag 10–15 disputerade medarbetare inom olika yrkeskategorier och en stor potential att utveckla forsknings- och utbildningsverksamheten ytterligare.  
   

  





 Nu söker vi dig som vill skapa förutsättningar för fler att forska, utvecklas och omsätta idéer till verklighet. Du skapar strukturer som gör det enkelt för medarbetare att omsätta idéer och förbättringsinitiativ i systematiskt utvecklings- och forskningsarbete. Genom att inspirera, stödja och samordna bidrar du till att fler medarbetare engagerar sig i forskning. I uppdraget som FoUUi-ansvarig har du en central roll i att utveckla och samordna FoUUi-arbetet inom området i nära samverkan med områdets omvårdnadsansvariga (OVA) och fungerar som områdets företrädare inom FoUUi.  
   

  





 Målet är att skapa en hållbar FoUUi-struktur där forskning, innovation och utbildning är en naturlig del av verksamheten, där fler medarbetare engagerar sig i forsknings- och utvecklingsarbete och där området fortsätter att vara en ledande miljö för diagnostik, teknik och AI. 
   

  





**Kompetenskrav:** 



* Leg läkare
* Disputerad med fördjupad vetenskaplig kompetens och dokumenterad erfarenhet av forskning och innovation
* Klinisk kompetens inom relevant specialitet
* Erfarenhet av lednings- eller samordningsuppdrag



**Uppdrag och organisatorisk placering**




 Som FoUUi-ansvarig har du ett strategiskt och operativt ansvar för att utveckla områdets förutsättningar för forskning, utbildning, utveckling och innovation. En viktig del av uppdraget är att bidra till en kultur där forskning ses som en naturlig del av verksamhetsutvecklingen och där förbättringsarbete, teknisk utveckling och implementering av nya arbetssätt också leder till vetenskaplig kunskapsutveckling. Du driver områdets FoUUi-arbete genom att skapa strukturer, samordna initiativ och stärka kopplingen mellan klinik, forskning, utbildning och innovation.  
   

  





 Rollen har klinisk förankring och bedrivs i nära samverkan med områdets ledning, sjukhusets FoUUi-ledning samt externa aktörer. 
   

  





 Du är ett stöd till områdeschefen och FoUUi-direktören på Södersjukhuset. Du leder områdets FoUUi-grupp, som har som uppdrag att stärka, samordna och följa upp FoUUi-verksamheten inom Diagnostik och Teknik. Du stödjer och samordnar befintliga strukturer för områdets utbildningsuppdrag för läkare, från läkarprogrammet till AT, BT och ST. 
   

  





**Uppdraget är ett tidsbegränsat förordnande på tre år med en omfattning om 30 %. Resterande arbetstid, 70 %, avser ordinarie arbete som läkare inom ditt specialistområde. Din grundanställning blir en tillsvidareanställning.** 
 Du ingår i områdets ledningsgrupp samt är adjungerad till den sjukhusövergripande FoUUi-ledningen. 
   

  





**Välkommen med din ansökan!**




 När du söker jobb hos Region Stockholm behandlar vi personuppgifter som du lämnar i din ansökan, exempelvis kontaktuppgifter, CV och andra relevanta dokument. Uppgifterna används för att kunna hantera rekryteringsprocessen och bedöma din ansökan.
   

  





  

 Vi följer dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR) och har rutiner för att skydda dina uppgifter. I vissa fall kan personuppgifter komma att behandlas i tredje land (utanför EU/EES), exempelvis om vi använder tjänsteleverantörer med system eller servrar placerade där. Vid sådan behandling säkerställer vi att lämpliga skyddsåtgärder finns, till exempel genom standardavtalsklausuler eller andra godkända mekanismer.
   

  





  

 Mer information om hur vi behandlar personuppgifter och dina rättigheter hittar du i vår integritetspolicy.
   

  





  

 Södersjukhuset är ett av Nordens största akutsjukhus, vi finns i hjärtat av samhället, dag som natt för våra patienter. Hos oss står akutsjukvården i centrum och utgör tillsammans med de stora folksjukdomarna vår specialitet. Vi bedriver omfattande klinisk forskning och utbildning, för oss är det viktigt att kombinera det stora sjukhusets möjligheter med den nära och personliga patientkontakten. På Södersjukhuset är alla en del i en större helhet där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens vård.
   

  





****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Junior Consultant | CFO Insights & Analytics
description:
At PwC, you’ll join a global network where expertise, innovation and collaboration come together to create impact. Whether your interests are sustainability, AI or financial analysis, we offer an environment where you can grow and reach your full potential. Our shared ambition is clear: to build trust, drive meaningful change and deliver long-term value. By combining cutting-edge technology with diverse perspectives, we solve complex challenges and help shape the businesses and organisations of tomorrow.
   

  

**Become a part of PwC:s CFO Insights & Analytics team**
 CFO Insights & Analytics supports our clients in reaching more profound and faster business insight by improving and automating reporting processes. We do this by working closely and directly with the clients and their data to understand their business, finances, and strategies, using market-leading software such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Alteryx and sometimes more traditional tools like Excel.
   

  

 Many of our clients have relied on reporting solutions requiring extensive manual effort with low granularity or relevance to their strategy. CFO Insights & Analytics services were initiated to meet clients' needs to improve and streamline their reporting and optimise their use of their data. Since then, we have helped many clients, and our business continues to grow rapidly.
   

  

 The team is a part of Finance Consulting within PwC Consulting & Strategy. Finance Consulting is a team of around 30 consultants, supporting a broad range of clients in the private equity, corporate and public sector. The team is divided into three different focus areas where CFO Insights & Analytics is one of them. The other areas are Finance Strategy & Operating model and ERP & Performance Management. Together we help our clients enhance their finance function by supporting them with different development initiatives to create a ‘fit for purpose’ finance function.
   

  

 You will be able to work with a broad range of industries, sectors, and counterparties, such as the Board of Directors, owners, and Management teams. This role is well-suited for individuals interested in exploring diverse industries and metrics, understanding how organisations monitor their strategies, and showcasing creativity in problem-solving by leveraging data and technology as their primary tools. You will get the opportunity to work closely on client projects and help in developing their new reporting solutions.
   

  

 We support your career growth by encouraging continuous learning and by providing a framework for you to acquire new skills at the right time. At PwC, we offer coaching, tailored training programs, and various fun and challenging learning opportunities.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Develop and implement automated internal reporting solutions, which require a deep understanding of structuring and defining large data sets between a multitude of financial and operational systems, as well as the connection between the companies' strategy and their data
* Participate in workshops with Board representatives, management, and members of the finance function to identify value-adding analyses and KPIs
* Visualise and communicate complex business concepts based on the client's data in BI tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) or traditional formats (i.e., PPT, Excel), depending on the client's need that will enable the client to gain a new and/or deeper understanding of their business
* Regularly engage in client meetings and business development activities to help identify and research opportunities for new/existing clients. In the future, you will lead and coach more junior staff members


 ,
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Bachelor’s (required) or Master’s (preferred) degree in Industrial Management, Finance & Accounting, Economics, Data & Programming combined with finance
* Relevant work experience gained through internships, part-time positions, or previous roles within finance, consulting, or related fields
* Advanced analytical skills, ability to understand and navigate in highly complex structures both regarding data and organisations, a passion for problem solving, curious and growth mindset, and a friendly attitude
* Well-developed verbal communication, cooperation and self-leadership skills
* Experienced or skilled in written communication
* Enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and a commitment to learning
* Advanced level of English (required), advanced level of Swedish (preferred)


**Application**
 Please submit your application no later than September 13.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 We have opportunities for those looking to start immediately, as well as in January 2027.
   

  

**Please Attach The Following Documents To Your Application**
* CV
* Cover letter
* University transcripts (attach in “other”)
* Specify in your application for which start date you prefer


 Please note that PwC will not be able to sponsor a work permit for this position.
   

  

**Recruitment Process**
 As part of the selection, we use psychometric tests to ensure an objective, unbiased, and fair selection. The tests are the first step in our selection process. You will receive a link to these tests after we have received your application.
   

  

 We value the personal meeting to understand the value you can bring to PwC and what we can offer you. The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews. When meeting with HR, you will have a competency-based interview where we examine the personality test you completed before the interview. During the interview with the business, you will have the opportunity to meet with the relevant team to discuss the role.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Lead
description:
Since our foundation in a backyard laboratory in Stockholm in 1955, Munters has grown into a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical processes. With sustainable and innovative technologies, we help customers around the world create the perfect indoor climate, even for the most demanding industrial and agricultural applications. Whether it is battery production, pharmaceuticals, data center cooling or food production, we provide precise humidity, temperature and air quality control where it matters most. Our commitment to sustainability, innovation and customer value drives everything we do.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Mechanical Design Lead** 
 , you will take technical ownership of the design activities across both
 **new product development and existing product development projects** 
 . You will act as the mechanical technical authority and the primary interface towards the Project Manager for all mechanical engineering activities.
   

  

 In this role, you will translate
 **Product Demand and Product Requirements** 
 into clear technical specifications and robust, manufacturable solutions. You will guide projects from concept development and detailed design through verification and industrialization, while ensuring the right balance between performance, quality, cost and lead time.
   

  

 You will work closely with cross-functional teams and provide technical leadership to mechanical engineers, helping to ensure that innovative product concepts are transformed into high-quality products that deliver value to our customers.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**
* Lead design activities across new product development and existing product development projects.
* Take ownership of the mechanical technical solution throughout the complete project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary mechanical interface towards the Project Manager, providing regular updates on technical progress, engineering estimates, risks and resource requirements.
* Translate Product Demand and Product Requirements into clear Component Technical Specifications that result in manufacturable solutions.
* Develop product concepts and create 3D CAD models, assemblies and layouts using SolidWorks.
* Define the mechanical architecture and design intent, providing clear technical direction to engineers responsible for detailed design and engineering deliverables.
* Estimate and continuously update mechanical engineering effort throughout the project phases to support planning, resource allocation and decision-making.
* Lead and contribute to Design Reviews, Design FMEA and Verification Plans to ensure robust and high-quality designs.
* Create and review engineering documentation, including CAD models, manufacturing drawings, calculations and technical specifications.
* Optimize designs for performance, manufacturability, quality, serviceability and cost.
* Mentor mechanical engineers and promote engineering best practices across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing and Service to ensure successful product delivery.


**Who You Are**
* A proactive and analytical engineer who enjoys taking technical ownership and leading complex engineering challenges.
* A strong mechanical design professional who can combine technical expertise with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Structured and customer-focused, with the ability to balance technical performance, quality, cost and project timelines.
* Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments.
* Confident in making technical decisions while keeping the bigger picture and business objectives in mind.
* A natural technical leader who enjoys mentoring and helping others succeed.
* Passionate about developing innovative products that create real value for customers.


**Your Experience**
* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience.
* Extensive experience in mechanical product development.
* Proven experience leading the mechanical design within multidisciplinary development projects.
* Strong CAD skills in SolidWorks and experience working with PDM/ePDM systems.
* Experience developing products from concept through production and industrialization.
* Experience designing sheet metal products and components.
* Experience performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA/FEM) to validate and optimize mechanical designs.
* Good understanding of manufacturing methods and industrial production processes.
* Experience with Design FMEA, DFM and DFA.
* Ability to translate Product Requirements into robust and practical technical solutions.
* Strong communication, planning and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.


**Meritorious**
* Experience designing plastic and cast components.
* Experience with HVAC or climate control products.
* Experience working in global product development organizations.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements and product verification.


**Our Workplace**
* Challenging and impactful role as Senior Mechanical Design Lead within an international and innovative organization.
* Collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled engineering and product development teams.
* Opportunity to contribute to both new and existing product development projects.
* Strong focus on innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities for professional development and technical growth.
* International working environment with close collaboration across multiple functions and locations.
* Good work-life balance and a culture that encourages ownership, initiative and new ideas.


**Our Promise**
 At Munters, we want you to grow and make an impact. People are at the heart of everything we do. As an employer, we are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment, where inclusion and equality are not just words but actions.
   

  

 At Munters, you can be yourself, contribute to innovative technologies and achieve great things together with your colleagues.
   

  

**Are you ready to grow with us and make an impact?**
 Click
 **“Apply”** 
 via our
 **Career page** 
 to submit your application and CV.
   

  

 For questions, please contact
 **Yannick Voet** 
 , our Talent Acquisition Specialist:
   

  

 ✉️ yannick.voet@munters.com
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!

title: AI Architect
description:
You’re an experienced AI architect who wants to turn applied AI into scalable, production-grade systems while helping clients create tangible business value.
   

  

 As a senior consultant, you will work across the full lifecycle of applied AI, from strategy and architecture to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. You will help clients understand how AI affects their products, workflows, and technical systems, then turn those insights into solutions that are scalable, observable, and trustworthy.
   

  

 Your time will be divided between client assignments and Knowit Connectivity’s AI Advisory Team. Together with senior AI specialists, architects, and business leaders, you will shape AI strategy, develop internal capabilities, evaluate emerging technologies, and establish practical ways of working with AI across the organization.
   

  

 Your work may include:
   

  

* Designing AI-native architectures and intelligent systems
* Building and deploying LLM-based applications and RAG solutions in production
* Creating agent-based workflows and autonomous system behaviors
* Defining governance, observability, monitoring, and evaluation strategies
* Integrating AI into existing products, platforms, and business processes
* Guiding clients through technical and organizational decisions involving performance, reliability, cost, and control


 To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
   

  

 You bring senior-level, hands-on experience in applied AI and can move comfortably between strategic discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation. You also understand the demands of consulting and can help clients navigate both technical and organizational challenges.

title: Master's thesis: Knowledge Transfer and Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Object Detection Models in Autonomous Vehicles
description:
**Background**
 Autonomous vehicles rely on AI models trained on large-scale, multi-modal sensor data. As vehicle platforms evolve, changes in sensors and hardware often require updating or retraining these models, which is costly and time-consuming. A key challenge is therefore how to efficiently transfer knowledge between models operating under different configurations.
   

  

 This thesis is part of the research project DREAM – Distributed, Robust and Efficient AI for Autonomous Vehicles. The topic is highly relevant for enabling scalable and efficient AI development in next-generation autonomous driving systems.
   

  

**Description**
 Sensor data and AI enable cars to detect objects, understand their environment and make decisions about how to respond. When vehicles are updated and new models are developed, sensors and hardware often change, which in turn also affects the AI models used. One approach would be to create a new AI model from scratch and collect new data each time the vehicle platform is updated. A more efficient solution would be to transfer knowledge between models with varying architectures. In this Master’s thesis project, we aim to investigate knowledge transfer between diverse models and hardware setups, ensuring that learning can continue even when architectures change. The work will use the Zenseact Open Dataset and also explore knowledge transfer in a federated learning context.
   

  

**Main Tasks**
 In this master thesis project, you will focus on investigating knowledge transfer between diverse models and hardware setups in autonomous vehicles. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Explore how knowledge can be efficiently transferred between AI models with different architectures.
* Evaluate techniques for updating AI models when vehicle sensors or hardware change, without the need for full retraining or collecting extensive new datasets.
* Analyze the effectiveness of the proposed approach through experiments using multi-modal sensor data, including vehicle control signals, geographical positions, and lidar, radar, and camera measurements.
* Develop and experiment with a federated learning framework that incorporates knowledge transfer to maintain model performance and adaptability in real-time, large-scale deployments.


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for one or two highly motivated students with a good general background in machine learning and computer vision. The following skills would be essential:
   

  

* Deep learning
* Federated learning (would be a bonus)
* Python programming
* Reading scientific papers
* Handling complex systems

* Starting date: As soon as possible, not later than September 1st, 2026.
* Credits: 30 points
