title: DevOps/SecOps
description:
Vill du kombinera DevOps, cloud och cybersecurity? Som DevOps/SecOps-konsult bygger du automatiserade och säkra leveransmiljöer för kunder i olika tekniska miljöer.
   

  

 Vad kommer du att arbeta med?
   

  

 I rollen designar, administrerar och optimerar du moderna utvecklings- och driftmiljöer. Säkerhet integreras genom hela utvecklings- och leveransprocessen, från kod och beroenden till driftsatt infrastruktur.
   

  

 En viktig del av vardagen är att utveckla CI/CD-pipelines med automatiserade säkerhetskontroller, sårbarhetsskanning och secrets management. Du arbetar också med Infrastructure as Code, konfigurationshantering och automation för att skapa reproducerbara, skalbara och säkra miljöer.
   

  

 Containerteknik och orkestreringsplattformar är centrala i uppdragen. Här bidrar du med drift, säker konfiguration och härdning av container- och Kubernetesmiljöer. Monitorering, loggning och observability hjälper dig att identifiera avvikelser, sårbarheter och potentiella säkerhetshot.
   

  

 Uppdragen varierar mellan olika tekniska miljöer och branscher. Det ger dig utrymme att fortsätta utvecklas inom DevOps, cloud security och cybersecurity samtidigt som du skapar lösningar som fungerar i kundernas vardag.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, scripting och automation, exempelvis med Python, samt god förståelse för DevSecOps-principer.
* Erfarenhet av att administrera, utveckla och optimera CI/CD-pipelines samt implementera säkerhetskontroller som SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning eller secrets scanning.
* Kunskap om Git repository management, Git workflows, branchingstrategier och säker hantering av repositories, kod, beroenden och artefakter.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Terraform samt konfigurationshantering och automation med Ansible, Puppet, Chef eller liknande verktyg.
* Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes, inklusive hardening, RBAC, secrets management och sårbarhetshantering, samt kunskap om IAM, least privilege och role-based access control.
* Kunskap om monitorering, loggning och observability, vulnerability management och patchning samt grundläggande förståelse för cloud security och nätverkssäkerhet, exempelvis brandväggar, segmentering, TLS, certifikat och säker kommunikation mellan tjänster.


 Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
   

  

 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud med fokus på säkerhet samt säkerhetsverktyg för SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis, container scanning eller secrets scanning.
* Erfarenhet av SIEM, centraliserad logghantering, Security Operations, incidenthantering, incident response eller security monitoring.
* Kunskap om policy as code och automatiserad kontroll av att infrastruktur och deployment följer definierade säkerhetskrav.
* Fördjupad erfarenhet av Kubernetes security, exempelvis network policies, RBAC, admission policies eller runtime security, samt secrets management med HashiCorp Vault eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av Golang eller CI/CD-automationsflöden som omfattar egen hårdvara, exempelvis egenutvecklade testriggar.
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsstandarder eller ramverk som ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks eller OWASP.


 Vad får du hos oss?
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av arbetet. Kombinationen av varierande kunduppdrag och tekniskt utmanande projekt ger dig möjlighet att bredda och fördjupa din kompetens inom automation, cloud, DevOps och cybersecurity.
   

  

 Här möts teknik, säkerhet och kreativitet i en lärande miljö där du kan bidra med din erfarenhet och fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor och kunder.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter rollen intressant? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig och din erfarenhet.
   

  

 Om Knowit
   

  

 Jobba hos oss på Knowit Connectivity, där vi arbetar med tekniskt avancerade system inom embedded och uppkopplade lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa produkter tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer i uppdrag som ligger i teknisk framkant.
   

  

 Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
   

  

 Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.
   

  

 We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Enhetschef Elkvalitet och dataanalys
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens kraftsystem och bidra till energiomställningen? Som enhetschef för Elkvalitet och dataanalys har du en viktig roll med stort inflytande över kritiska frågor för elnätets funktion och stabilitet. Du blir en del av en ny organisation där du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som enhetschef för Elkvalitet och dataanalys leder du en enhet i utveckling, där uppdrag, arbetssätt och samverkan formas. Det ger dig stora möjligheter att påverka inriktning och kultur, samtidigt som du utvecklas inom ledarskap och tekniskt komplexa områden. Du ingår i sektion Systemförmågors ledningsgrupp och bidrar till sektionens strategiska utveckling. I rollen verkar du i gränslandet mellan teknik och strategi, där du omsätter teknisk specialistkunskap till tydliga prioriteringar, välgrundade beslut och konkret verksamhetsutveckling. Med många kontaktytor har du en viktig roll i att representera enhetens teknikområden samt bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer inom branschen.
   

  

 Du leder en enhet med 11 kraftsystemspecialister placerade vid flera av Svenska kraftnäts kontor och har helhetsansvar för verksamhet, personal och budget. Enhetens arbete omfattar att säkerställa god elkvalitet i stamnätet genom kravställning, analys och elkvalitetsstudier, t.ex. genom utformning av tekniska riktlinjer, tilldelning av störutrymme vid anslutning, övertonsstudier eller uppföljning av spänningsdippsutbredning. Enheten arbetar även med utveckling av metoder och verktyg för att övervaka dynamisk systemstabilitet samt kravställning av mätinfrastruktur och datakvalitet. Enheten har också ett sammanhållande ansvar för störningsanalyser.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Leda, utveckla och följa upp enhetens verksamhet med ansvar för personal, budget och resultat.
* Säkerställa framdrift samt driva utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och struktur inom enheten.
* Skapa förutsättningar för medarbetarna att nå uppsatta mål och utvecklas i sina roller.
* Företräda enheten i interna och externa forum samt delta i och leda styrgrupper och initiativ.


**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Vi söker en trygg och engagerad ledare med förmåga att skapa riktning i en verksamhet under utveckling. Du är målmedveten och driver förändring i komplexa sammanhang och säkerställer framdrift även när förutsättningarna inte är helt givna. Med god struktur skapar du tydlighet i en miljö där uppdrag och arbetssätt formas. Du har förmåga att se helheten, identifiera centrala frågeställningar och fatta välgrundade beslut.
   

  

 Du bygger förtroendefulla relationer och samverkar väl med andra, samtidigt som du har mod att driva frågor i sammanhang där perspektiven kan skilja sig åt. Som ledare stöttar du dina medarbetare och skapar förutsättningar för deras utveckling och verksamhetens resultat.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Vidare har du en civilingenjörsutbildning inom relevant område (exempelvis elektroteknik eller teknisk fysik), alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som Svenska kraftnät bedömer som likvärdig.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Chefserfarenhet med ansvar för personal och budget.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att leda kunskapsintensiv verksamhet med tekniska specialister, exempelvis som chef, teamledare, projektledare eller motsvarande.
* Kunskap om och god förståelse för kraftsystemets dynamik och uppbyggnad.
* Förmåga att obehindrat kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.


 Det är
 **meriterande** 
 om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av verksamhets- och processutveckling samt förbättringsarbete.
* Erfarenhet av tekniska anslutningskrav på anläggningar anslutna till elsystemet, gärna inom elkvalitet.
* Erfarenhet av kraftsystemanalyser och modellering.
* Erfarenhet inom analys av mätdata, alternativt arbete med kravställning av mätsystem.


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg, Västerås eller Göteborg.
* I tjänsten ingår resor inom Norden och Europa. Vid placering i Västerås eller i Göteborg tillkommer regelbundna resor till huvudkontoret i Sundbyberg 2–4 gånger per månad.
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 % .

title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!**



Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:
* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities


We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.


**The role:**


**As a Senior Software Engineer, iOS,** you will have an impact on how our users use the iOS app. You will be working on the whole app from authentication to the search feature, and you will also work very closely with all the other teams in the company to achieve our company vision: enabling each person or business to maintain a secure and trusted online identity.


**What you will do**


* Design, develop, and maintain the company's iOS application
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of the app
* Debug complex technical issues and identify solutions to improve the app
* Stay up-to-date with new technologies and trends in iOS development
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards
* Contribute to the technical design and architecture of the app
* Participate in the full software development life cycle, including planning, development, testing, and deployment.
* Mentor and guide experienced engineers, helping them develop both technically and culturally.


**What you bring in**


* 6+ years of overall experience with iOS development
* Advanced knowledge of programming using Swift
* Deep understanding and several years of hands-on experience in Cocoa and iOS application development (architectures, design, tools, SDKs), asynchronous server communication, and UX optimization
* Experience in agile development
* Fluent communication skills in oral and written English


**It would be great if you also have**


* SwiftUI experience
* Swift async/await experience
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions and Fastlane


**What we offer:**



We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

* A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
* Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller's "Lab Days" offer a space for imagination:** 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.


**Come as you are:**  

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.


**Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:** https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/



Sounds like a great opportunity?



We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.


**We only accept applications in English.**

title: UX Designer
description:
We're looking for a UX Designer to join our Application Development Department in central Stockholm. This is an opportunity to shape the user experience of industry-leading aviation tools used by a large and passionate user base worldwide.

**About Navigraph**
-------------------


Navigraph is a Swedish SaaS company that provides the international flight simulation community with flight planning tools, navigation data, and aeronautical charts used in professional aviation. Our 1.7 million registered users care deeply about realism, procedures, and getting the details right.


We're a team of nearly 60, including software developers, UX and graphic designers, data analysts, content producers, motion designers, and support specialists. Navigraph was founded by Stephen O'Connell (CTO) and Magnus Axholt (CEO), both of whom are still active in the company. We've grown considerably but kept the collaborative, creative culture we started with.

### **What makes us different**


Navigraph is privately held, profitable, and built on the principle that people come first. That means prioritizing product quality and employee satisfaction. Our employee NPS is 80, placing us in the top percentile across industries.


The problem space is unusual: professional aviation complexity, consumer-grade usability expectations, and platforms spanning mobile, web, desktop, and in-simulator environments, including VR. You won't find this combination elsewhere.

**The role**
------------


Bring research, make the case, change the direction!


You'll play a key role in shaping the user experience across Navigraph's product suite, from our flagship Charts app to desktop utilities and in-simulator interfaces. The work centers on information-dense, timing-sensitive interfaces where clarity directly affects the user experience under cognitive load. The challenges include showing the right information at the right moment while making complex workflows feel intuitive.


You’ll work hands-on throughout the end-to-end UX process; from framing complex problems and conducting research to designing, prototyping, validating, and refining features through to implementation. You'll also contribute to our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across products.


You'll manage multiple UX initiatives across products and help build our user research infrastructure, including the behavioral analytics we're establishing across products.

**The team**
------------


You'd join the Charts Team within the Application Department as part of a small but growing design group. Design is embedded with engineering: same dailies, shared context, with dedicated time for UX-specific collaboration. You'd also participate in cross-department design councils, shaping how UX works across the company.

**The community**
-----------------


Our users are deeply engaged, active on forums and Discord, vocal about their needs, and genuinely invested in the product. Navigraph has become one of the most recognized brands in flight simulation by listening to and serving this community. As a designer, you'll have direct access to user feedback and a user base that cares intensely about getting the details right.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

### **Professional experience**

* You have 5+ years in product/UX design across web, native mobile, and desktop platforms.
* You're passionate about UX and care deeply about design quality
* You're genuinely curious about users and want to understand why they behave the way they do
* You plan and conduct research to identify opportunities, resolve usability issues, and validate design decisions.
* You manage multiple UX initiatives across teams, balancing discovery, delivery, and iteration.
* You enjoy being hands-on and spending a significant part of your time designing features, exploring solutions in Figma, and working through interaction and UX/UI details.
* You bring experience with data-dense, information-rich interfaces, ideally in professional tools, technical software, or specialized domains.
* You enjoy turning complex UX problems into well-crafted features, getting into the details of how they work and feel.
* You're energized by complex problems, not frustrated by them
* You build good relationships with colleagues and create a positive team environment
* You help junior designers grow through feedback, guidance, and collaboration
* You express yourself clearly and precisely in English, both written and spoken

### **Technical skills**

* You design wireframes, prototypes, and user flows in Figma
* You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable taking designs from early exploration to detailed solutions.
* You have hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable design systems using components, design tokens, and shared libraries.
* You create and test interactive prototypes to validate design decisions
* You apply usability principles, accessibility standards, and human-computer interaction fundamentals throughout the design process
* You navigate technical constraints and platform-specific considerations that affect implementation
* You actively use AI-assisted tools to explore ideas, prototype, synthesize research, document work, or otherwise make your design process faster and more effective
* You’re curious about AI-enabled design workflows and enjoy experimenting with new ways of working.

### **Nice to have**

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

  


Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.



We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative **Analytics Engineer** to join our growing Analytics Platform team. As our second hire in this role, you will partner closely with our existing Analytics Engineer, Data Engineers, and Business Analysts to scale our data foundations and elevate our analytics practices.



You won’t just be writing code; you will be a key player in shaping our data architecture, championing data literacy, and empowering the transport industry to go electric through simple, beautiful, and highly effective data solutions.


### **You will:**


* **Anticipate business needs:** Work proactively with stakeholders to not just understand, but predict their future needs in terms of datasets and dashboards.
* **Scale our data foundations:** Design robust data models and build reliable pipelines alongside our engineering teams.
* **Drive business insights:** Define and implement key metrics to assess business performance and enhance our analytics-driven products.
* **Optimize our stack:** Continuously improve our analytics frameworks, BI tools, and data documentation.
* **Champion data literacy:** Educate colleagues across the organization on data modeling and BI tooling to empower them to do their jobs more efficiently.


### **We expect you to have:**


* Passion for high data quality and experience scaling analytics workflows.
* Strong skills in SQL, data modeling, and version control (Git).
* Proficiency in modern data warehousing and orchestration. Our core stack is *BigQuery*, *dbt*, and *Dagster* - you don't need to be a day-one expert in these exact tools, but you must have solid experience with them or their direct equivalents.
* Solid end-to-end development experience with BI tools. We use Looker, but expertise in similar tools (like Tableau or Qlik Sense) is perfectly fine.
* A proven ability to thrive in both collaborative team settings and independent work.


#### **Ideally, You Also Bring:**


* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (we use Terraform).
* Experience with a programming language for data analysis (e.g., Python, R).
* A strong eye for UI/UX design in dashboards and data visualization.
* Solid business acumen, financial literacy, and an understanding of predictive modeling.



This is a full-time position based anywhere in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.



At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

  

**Please note:** Our recruitment process includes an online candidate assessment via Alva Labs and a standard background check prior to employment.

**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

Born autonomous. Born electric.



Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.



We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

title: UX Designer
description:
**UX Designer** 




  





 We're looking for a UX Designer to join our Application Development Department in central Stockholm. This is an opportunity to shape the user experience of industry-leading aviation tools used by a large and passionate user base worldwide.
 



  





**About Navigraph** 




 Navigraph is a Swedish SaaS company that provides the international flight simulation community with flight planning tools, navigation data, and aeronautical charts used in professional aviation. Our 1.7 million registered users care deeply about realism, procedures, and getting the details right.
 



 We're a team of nearly 60, including software developers, UX and graphic designers, data analysts, content producers, motion designers, and support specialists. Navigraph was founded by Stephen O'Connell (CTO) and Magnus Axholt (CEO), both of whom are still active in the company. We've grown considerably but kept the collaborative, creative culture we started with.
 



  





**What makes us different** 




 Navigraph is privately held, profitable, and built on the principle that people come first. That means prioritizing product quality and employee satisfaction. Our employee NPS is 80, placing us in the top percentile across industries. 
 



  





 The problem space is unusual: professional aviation complexity, consumer-grade usability expectations, and platforms spanning mobile, web, desktop, and in-simulator environments, including VR. You won't find this combination elsewhere.
 



  





**The role** 




 Bring research, make the case, change the direction! 
 



  





 You'll play a key role in shaping the user experience across Navigraph's product suite, from our flagship Charts app to desktop utilities and in-simulator interfaces. The work centers on information-dense, timing-sensitive interfaces where clarity directly affects the user experience under cognitive load. The challenges include showing the right information at the right moment while making complex workflows feel intuitive.
 



  





 You’ll work hands-on throughout the end-to-end UX process; from framing complex problems and conducting research to designing, prototyping, validating, and refining features through to implementation. You'll also contribute to our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across products.
 



  





 You'll manage multiple UX initiatives across products and help build our user research infrastructure, including the behavioral analytics we're establishing across products.
 



 The team
 



  





 You'd join the Charts Team within the Application Department as part of a small but growing design group. Design is embedded with engineering: same dailies, shared context, with dedicated time for UX-specific collaboration. You'd also participate in cross-department design councils, shaping how UX works across the company.
 



  





**The community** 




 Our users are deeply engaged, active on forums and Discord, vocal about their needs, and genuinely invested in the product. Navigraph has become one of the most recognized brands in flight simulation by listening to and serving this community. As a designer, you'll have direct access to user feedback and a user base that cares intensely about getting the details right.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 Professional experience
 


* You have 5+ years in product/UX design across web, native mobile, and desktop platforms.
* You're passionate about UX and care deeply about design quality
* You're genuinely curious about users and want to understand why they behave the way they do
* You plan and conduct research to identify opportunities, resolve usability issues, and validate design decisions.
* You manage multiple UX initiatives across teams, balancing discovery, delivery, and iteration.
* You enjoy being hands-on and spending a significant part of your time designing features, exploring solutions in Figma, and working through interaction and UX/UI details.
* You bring experience with data-dense, information-rich interfaces, ideally in professional tools, technical software, or specialized domains.
* You enjoy turning complex UX problems into well-crafted features, getting into the details of how they work and feel.
* You're energized by complex problems, not frustrated by them
* You build good relationships with colleagues and create a positive team environment
* You help junior designers grow through feedback, guidance, and collaboration
* You express yourself clearly and precisely in English, both written and spoken



  





 Technical skills
 


* You design wireframes, prototypes, and user flows in Figma
* You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable taking designs from early exploration to detailed solutions.
* You have hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable design systems using components, design tokens, and shared libraries.
* You create and test interactive prototypes to validate design decisions
* You apply usability principles, accessibility standards, and human-computer interaction fundamentals throughout the design process
* You navigate technical constraints and platform-specific considerations that affect implementation
* You actively use AI-assisted tools to explore ideas, prototype, synthesize research, document work, or otherwise make your design process faster and more effective
* You’re curious about AI-enabled design workflows and enjoy experimenting with new ways of working.



  





 Nice to have
 


* Aviation interest, pilot experience, or personal experience with flight simulation, though you'll quickly learn from colleagues and a user base that care deeply about realistic procedures and workflows
* Basic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, React, or React Native)



  





**What we offer** 




 Navigraph is built on an open, caring culture where people genuinely come first. The structure is flat, leadership is hands-on, and flexibility is based on trust. Innovation and creativity aren't just tolerated, they're expected. You'll join a team that genuinely enjoys what they do and takes pride in setting the standard for what flight simulation tools can be.
 



  




* **Flexible work options** 
 : On-site and hybrid
* **A great benefits package** 
 : Please check out our career site.
* **Growth opportunities** 
 : We’ll support your professional development and give you the resources you need to excel.

 The Navigraph team is a tight-knit group with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We enjoy spending time together, and our annual work trips always include team-building activities that leave lasting impressions!

 Send your application, along with a portfolio and case studies that demonstrate your design thinking and the outcomes of your work. We're actively hiring and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world feel your work.**
 As a Lead Product Designer, you will play a crucial role in setting the creative bar for experience quality across a product area that spans several teams, and for the outcomes that experience creates for our customers. Your role will be to set direction, principles, patterns and quality thresholds, and encode that bar so that both people and models can meet it. Your own work is the proof, and it shows the highest creative judgment and taste.
   

  

 You will work in the build loop with engineering, prototyping in code and taking the UI through to live product. The role moves between two modes: embedded on high-impact initiatives, and setting direction and standards across teams. You will partner with design and product leadership on product direction and evolve the design process for AI-native work.
   

  

 Your key responsibilities include
   

  

* Lead high-impact, ambiguous initiatives from idea to live product, working in the build loop with engineering.
* Stay close to users, basing decisions on research, live product and data, and following up on what changed after launch.
* Prototype in code and take the user interface through to live product.
* Raise the bar with designers, product managers and engineers through pairing, critique and review of live product.
* Evolve the design system as infrastructure for both people and AI agents, covering behaviour as well as components.
* Encode how Epidemic Sound designs AI-driven products, including trust, control and evaluation, so others can apply it.


**Requirements**
* Exceptional design craft, with a high bar for usability, taste and coherence across the product.
* Authority with patterns, with the ability to define how they are applied, adapted or replaced across the organisation.
* Proven ability to synthesise research, analytics, market and business strategy into design direction with organisational impact.
* Fluency in the build loop, with the ability to set the standard for how design and engineering collaborate in-product, without file handoff.
* A track record of orchestrating AI rather than prompting it, knowing when its output is good enough and when not to generate at all.
* It would also be music to our ears if you have experience holding the cross-team view across multiple design teams, and a track record of connecting design decisions to user outcomes, business metrics, growth targets, and long-term product strategy.


**Equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

**Application**
 Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.
