title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior product designer to help shape the next layer of SeenThis: a product where creative and marketing teams can build, run, measure, and improve high-performing video campaigns across channels.
   

  

 This is a role for an AI-native designer who likes complex problems, expert users, and fast execution. You’ll work close to product and engineering, own meaningful parts of our media and advertising product suite, and help turn complicated workflows into tools people want to use every day.
   

  

**About SeenThis**
 The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent. Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open.
   

  

 Our team of 130+ employees works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Sydney. We're expanding across all teams and constantly seeking new colleagues who want to make real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily.
   

  

 Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it, and win together?
   

  

 Join SeenThis!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our adaptive streaming technology fixed the delivery problem for video advertising. Now we’re building the product layer on top.
   

  

 You’ll own parts of our media and advertising product suite, working closely with engineers, a PM, and the Design Lead to take ideas from first sketch to shipped product. You’ll help define how our product works, how it feels, and how product design works at SeenThis as the function continues to grow.
   

  

 While you will iterate and build fast, your role starts with discovery. You’ll be expected to become a domain expert for your part of our products. That means continually talking with customers, mapping their workflows, understanding the business context, and finding real problems.
   

  

 You’ll be expected to figure out what’s worth building before any screen is designed. Sometimes that means proper research or session data. Other times, a client call and a rough prototype may be the answer. That’s up to you.
   

  

 Getting this right is most of the job, because the wrong thing built well is still the wrong thing.
   

  

 This is also an execution-first and AI-native role. You’ll move quickly from problem to prototype to shipped product, using tools like Claude Code to explore ideas, test flows, and iterate faster.
   

  

 Building is cheap now; judgment is the scarce part. When AI can produce the screen, the work that matters is deciding what to build, what to cut, where to simplify, and when to push back. That part is still yours.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Run discovery for your product area: talk to customers, dig into the problem, map workflows, and decide what’s worth building before committing to a build.
* Become a domain expert for your part of the product, with a strong understanding of users, workflows, constraints, and business goals.
* Choose the right tool for each question: proper research when it warrants it, session data or support insights when that’s enough, and a fast prototype when that answers it sooner.
* Own user flows, interactions, and interfaces from first discovery through to shipped product.
* Design for expert users doing complex work, making powerful workflows feel clear, fast, and simple enough to use every day.
* Talk to users directly through client calls, support tickets, and session data, and form product opinions from what you find.
* Work hands-on with engineers through the build, not just at handoff.
* Use AI tools, including Claude Code, to design, prototype, and iterate. Build your own small tools when that’s faster.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap with your PM and the rest of the team.
* Help shape our design system and how design works at SeenThis while both are still taking shape.


**Qualifications**
* Have 5+ years of product design experience, with the seniority to own complex work from discovery through shipped product.
* Start with the problem, not the screen, and have shipped work where discovery shaped the outcome.
* Have designed complex digital products end to end, with work you can walk through and explain.
* Have a portfolio that shows clear thinking, polished UI, and real outcomes rather than well-composed screens.
* Move fluidly between early discovery, rough prototypes, high-fidelity execution, and hands-on iteration with engineers.
* Treat prototyping as a way to think, test, and align, not just a deliverable to produce.
* Already work AI-native, with real opinions about where Claude Code or similar tools help and where they get in the way.
* Are a designer who builds, not one who hands off.
* Are solid across UX, interaction, IA, and visual design, with the technical curiosity to understand how the product behaves, not only how it looks.
* Bring high ownership and low ego, and can drive your own work forward while the team and product are still forming.


**Application**
 As we review applications and interview on a continuous basis, please apply as soon as possible. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide personalized feedback prior to the interview stage. Thank you for understanding!
   

  

**Please note:** 
 we're in our summer holiday period. Response times may be a little longer than usual, and we will get back to all candidates with feedback once the holiday period is over. Thank you for your understanding and patience!
   

  

 We conduct background checks on all SeenThis-hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.
   

  

 We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis!
   

  

 Status Quo-what? With courage and curiosity, we explore the unknown in the quest for game-changing-impact.
   

  

 To us, ownership is more than just another buzzword. It's our driving force. We own our projects and nurture them from idea to reality.
   

  

 To us, it's essential to forge deep connections both within SeenThis and with our clients. And, we approach every challenge and celebrate each success as a unified team
   

  

 The open web represents the internet's greatest untapped advertising opportunity. While 61% of consumer time happens here, across premium publishers, diverse voices, and independent content, only 29% of ad budgets follow. SeenThis is changing that.
   

  

 Our proprietary adaptive streaming technology proves the open web can outperform walled gardens, delivering 70% more attention and exceptional campaign results for brands while keeping publishers profitable and the internet independent.
   

  

 Since 2017, we've served over 40 billion impressions for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries, partnering with agencies and publishers from eight offices worldwide.
   

  

 Brands deserve reach wherever their audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open and thriving. SeenThis unlocks the open web's full potential. For more information, visit www.seenthis.co

title: Head of Customer Experience
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're hiring a Head of Customer Experience to own how customers succeed with Lovable end-to-end — from first interaction to enterprise adoption. This isn't a traditional support leadership role: you'll build an agentic-first CX function from the ground up, sitting at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're hiring a Head of Customer Experience to own the full spectrum of how customers succeed with Lovable, from their first interaction to enterprise adoption.
   

  

 This is not a traditional support role. You'll own the function that sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM and build feedback loops that make Lovable better. Everything you build should be agentic-first. We're not looking for someone who will staff up a classic support org — we want someone who will build this function around AI agents.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* CX function — own ticketed support, async support, incident response, and onboarding.
* Agentic support infrastructure — architect and build AI-powered systems that resolve issues, surface product signals, and scale coverage without scaling headcount 1:1.
* The product feedback loop — you're the clearest signal we have on what's broken, confusing, or missing; you own turning that into structured input for Engineering and Product.
* Enterprise CX — build dedicated support motions, office hours, and success touchpoints for our largest customers.
* Social support — own Lovable's customer support presence and response across channels like Reddit, Discord, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X.
* CX metrics — own and move CSAT, resolution time, time-to-value, and NPS.


**What We're Looking For**
* 10+ years of experience, with at least 5 in a leadership role owning Customer Experience.
* AI-native operator — you're actively building agentic support systems today, not planning to "explore AI" in the future.
* Commercially accountable — you've owned NRR, churn, CSAT, or expansion targets and can cite specific results.
* Cross-functional fluency at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM.
* Proven people leader — you've hired, developed, and retained CX managers and ICs across multiple time zones.
* Technical depth — comfortable working inside an engineering org, contributing to product direction, and building tooling.
* Preferred: background from AI-native or developer tools companies; experience scaling PLG support at high-growth tech companies; has contributed code or built internal tooling for support/CX infrastructure.


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Manager for Mobile App
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 



  





**Day-to-day Responsibilities** 




**Product Strategy & Vision** 



* Define and own the mobile product roadmap aligned with business goals and EU FinTech market trends
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities
* Translate business objectives into a clear, actionable product vision
* Build and prioritize the product backlog using data-driven decision-making



  





**Conception & Discovery** 



* Lead product discovery workshops with stakeholders, customers, and technical teams
* Define user personas, customer journeys, and Jobs-To-Be-Done (JTBD) frameworks
* Co-create wireframes and prototypes with UX/UI designers
* Validate hypotheses through user interviews, usability tests, and A/B experiments



  





**Development & Delivery** 



* Work closely with cross-functional Agile squads (iOS, Android, Backend, QA, UX)
* Write clear Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
* Make trade-off decisions on scope, quality, and timeline to ensure on-time delivery



  





**Launch & Go-To-Market** 



* Define and execute mobile app launch strategies across EU markets
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success for successful releases
* Monitor KPIs post-launch (DAU, MAU, retention, conversion, NPS) and iterate
* Lead phased rollouts, beta programs, and feature flag management



  





**Compliance & Regulatory Alignment** 



* Ensure compliance with EU regulations: PSD2, GDPR, EBA Guidelines, AML/KYC
* Collaborate with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams throughout the product lifecycle
* Maintain awareness of upcoming regulatory changes impacting mobile financial services



  





**Who Are We Looking For** 




 Must-Have
 


* 5+ years of Product Management experience in FinTech, Banking, or Payments
* Proven track record delivering mobile applications (iOS and/or Android) from concept to launch
* Strong command of Agile/Scrum methodologies (CSPO certification is a plus)
* Experience working in the European market with knowledge of EU regulations (PSD2, GDPR, DORA)
* Ability to write structured User Stories, Epics, and PRDs
* Strong analytical skills – comfortable with data dashboards and metrics tools
* Excellent communication skills in English (additional EU language is a strong plus)



  





 Nice-to-Have
 


* Experience with mobile payment solutions, digital wallets, or card issuing products
* Knowledge of Open Banking APIs and PSD2 technical standards (SCA, TPP)
* Background in UX research or design thinking
* Familiarity with PCI-DSS, OAuth, or biometric authentication standards
* Knowledge of card scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard) or issuing/acquiring processes
* Proficiency with tools: Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Amplitude



  





**Perks & Benefits** 



* Pension plan
* Health contribution
* Health check – Every 2:nd year
* Private Health Care Insurance (EuroAccident)
* Parental pay and 12 months pension during parental leave
* Opportunity to hybrid working according to company standard
* Benefit portal with many great offers, plus more.



  





**Shape the evolution** 




 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 



 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
 



  





 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: CRM Automation Specialist - Full-Time
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 As a CRM Automation Specialist at Voi, you will strengthen our lifecycle marketing by turning data and insights into automated CRM programmes that drive engagement, conversion, and retention across our markets. You will work hands-on in Braze to design, build, and optimise journeys that support users from onboarding through to loyal, high-value riders. Sitting within the CRM team and collaborating closely with Data, Marketing, and Product, you will make sure lifecycle initiatives are insight-led, measurable, and aligned with Voi’s broader growth objectives.
   

  

**You Will**
* Analyse lifecycle performance using CRM data to identify opportunities across onboarding, engagement, upsell, and retention.
* Investigate user behaviour and campaign performance to uncover automation opportunities, lifecycle gaps, and areas for optimisation.
* Translate insights into actionable CRM journeys, segmentation strategies, and targeting logic that can scale across markets.
* Build, test, and optimise automated lifecycle journeys in Braze using Canvas, segmentation, and Liquid logic.
* Develop reusable templates and scalable campaign structures that reduce manual work and improve consistency.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate existing campaigns and expand lifecycle coverage across the customer journey.
* Design and run A/B tests across CRM channels (email, push, in-app) to improve engagement, conversion, and retention.
* Analyse experiment results, communicate findings clearly, and turn them into actionable improvements.
* Partner with Marketing, Data, and Product to ensure lifecycle activity is aligned with growth priorities and other channel initiatives.
* Maintain strong QA processes to ensure accurate segmentation, triggers, tracking, and personalisation, while keeping visibility across journeys to avoid overlap and conflicting experiences.


**What You Need To Embark**
 You are a data-driven CRM or lifecycle marketer who enjoys working hands-on with tools, journeys, and experiments. You are comfortable moving between analysis and execution, can manage multiple initiatives at once, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.
   

  

* 3+ years’ experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation in a B2C environment.
* Hands-on experience building lifecycle journeys in Braze or a comparable CRM platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL and confidence in analysing lifecycle data and campaign performance independently.
* Experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests, including an understanding of experimentation methodology and statistical significance.
* Strong understanding of lifecycle strategies such as onboarding, engagement, upsell, and retention.
* Proven experience building automated CRM journeys and scalable campaign structures.
* Comfortable working with CRM data structures, including user attributes, events, triggers, and segmentation logic.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, organisation, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and dependencies.
* Clear, collaborative communicator who enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


 Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.
   

  

**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This, You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale-ups.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated, and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: Product Manager, Fleet Billing
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
 Arrive for Business is the fleet mobility platform used by Arrive’s enterprise customers to manage parking, expenses, and mobility spend at scale. Those customers don't just need a place to park — they need their financial workflows to work the way they expect: seamless invoicing, flexible payment methods, and integrations with the tools they already use for expense management. That's the job of the Fleet Billing team.
   

  

 As Product Manager for Fleet Billing, you'll own the payment and billing configuration layer that sits at the heart of Arrive for Business. This includes the experiences that let fleet administrators connect payment methods, configure billing flows, and integrate with platforms like Concur. You'll also own how customers discover, upgrade, and manage their product packages, which is central to our push upmarket toward enterprise.
   

  

 This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of payments (working hand-in-hand with our internal Payments team), enterprise SaaS, partner integrations (e.g. Concur, Expensify, and others), and product package selection. If you like building products that sit inside the financial workflows of large organizations and want to get into the details right genuinely matter, this is the role for you.
   

  

**How To Make An Impact**
* Own the full product lifecycle for payment method management, subscription billing, expense management integrations, and product package upgrade / downgrade / visibility from discovery through delivery and outcome tracking.
* Work with our Payments team to expand payment method coverage (cards, wallets, invoicing) and integrate with additional expense platforms beyond Concur.
* Shape the upgrade, downgrade, and package visibility experience as we launch feature-differentiated tiers throughout Arrive for Business
* Set and be accountable for the metrics that tell you whether the team's work is actually improving billing reliability, expense workflow adoption, and payment success.
* Work fluidly across engineering, design, finance, and commercial partners to ship well.
* Use AI tools to move faster and think smarter. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with what's out there.


**Your background**
* 3-5 years of product management experience, ideally on B2B SaaS or fintech products where the customer is an organization, not an individual.
* Experience building or owning payment, billing, or financial workflow products is a strong plus.
* Comfort with complexity: enterprise billing systems have a lot of edge cases, and you bring structure to messy problems without needing a perfectly scoped brief to get started.
* Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to align engineering, design, and commercial stakeholders and move them forward without formal authority.
* Data-informed judgment. You know what to measure, and you hold yourself accountable to the numbers.
* Exceptional communication. You write and speak clearly, and you can articulate a nuanced product problem to any audience.
* Bias toward action. You make decisions, remove blockers, and stay focused on what matters.


**Why You'll Love This Role**
 The problem space is real. Billing is one of the first things an enterprise customer notices when something is wrong, and one of the last things they notice when it's right. Building it well matters.
   

  

 Near-term impact, not just roadmap. You'll own the follow-through from launch to learning to what comes next.
   

  

 You're working at Arrive's scale. The payment and billing infrastructure you build will be used by enterprise fleet customers across 90+ countries and 20,000 cities.
   

  

 We're going upmarket. The shift from SMB to enterprise is the defining strategic story for Arrive for Business, and this team sits at the center of it.
   

  

**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Power Platform Specialist
description:
**Vad erbjuder vi?**
* Möjlighet att arbeta i framkanten av Microsoft-teknik
* En central roll där din expertis inom Power Platform möjliggör innovativa lösningar och stärker våra Citizen Developers
* Nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna
* Ett högt medarbetarengagemang
* Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension enligt ITP planen och trygghetsförsäkringar
* Reseförmåner


 ”Vi är en arbetsplats med ett stort kunnande och en stark drivkraft att ständigt förbättra vår verksamhet. Som en del av Nordic Leisure Travel Group erbjuder vi en spännande och utvecklande miljö med möjlighet till en intern karriär. Vår arbetsglädje och vårt höga engagemang visar sig i vår årliga medarbetarundersökning – och vi är stolta över att vara en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas.”
   

  

**Vem söker vi?**
* Högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, teknik, matematik eller motsvarande kunskap genom arbetslivserfarenhet
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av Microsoft Power Platform, inklusive Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI & Copilot Studio
* Praktisk tillämpning av Generativ AI, AI-assistenter och AI-agenter
* Utmärkta problemlösnings- och analytiska färdigheter
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


**Det är meriterande om du även:**
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i en DevOps-kultur och med verktyg som AzureDevOps och GitHub
* Är certifierad inom AI & Microsoft Power Platform


 Ditt arbetssätt präglas av nyfikenhet och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas. Du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker och ser förändring som en möjlighet snarare än ett hinder. Vi värdesätter samarbete och söker en person som trivs i en teamorienterad miljö. Du är prestigelös, lyhörd och engagerad i att hitta gemensamma lösningar tillsammans med dina kollegor. Att ta ansvar är en självklarhet för dig, även när oväntade situationer uppstår. Du ser utmaningar som en naturlig del av arbetet och hanterar dem med ett positivt och lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt.
   

  

**Vad innebär rollen?**
* Utforma, utveckla och tillhandahålla lösningar i Microsoft Power Platform & Copilot Studio
* Samarbeta med verksamheten och andra intressenter för att förstå affärskrav och identifiera möjligheter för AI-lösningar
* Ta fram ett ramverk för AI-agenter och hjälpa till att identifiera och prioritera användningsfall där AI-agenter kan skapa störst affärs- och verksamhetsvärde
* Utveckla och underhålla Power Platform-infrastruktur och verktyg inklusive AI-komponenter
* Hålla dig uppdaterad om de senaste utvecklingarna inom Microsoft Power Platform
* Utbilda och stötta Citizen Developers i organisationen
* Kommunicera komplexa tekniska koncept till icke-tekniska intressenter.


 Som Power Platform Specialist kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att utforma, utveckla och driftsätta lösningar i Microsoft Power Platform för att möta verksamhetens behov. Du kommer att ansvara för att driva plattformen framåt och att fungera som en möjliggörare för Citizen Developers inom vår organisation för low-code lösningar. Dessutom kommer du att arbeta i framkanten av teknologin genom att integrera Generativ AI, AI-assistenter och AI-agenter för att automatisera processer och skapa nya värden för verksamheten.
   

  

 Du kommer att ingå i Vings Workplace team som ansvarar för att leverera innovativa och effektiva lösningar som driver vår verksamhet framåt. Teamet strävar efter att ständigt förbättras, och du kommer att ges stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling och att vara i framkant av den snabbt utvecklande low-code & AI teknologin.
   

  

****Intresserad?****
 Skicka in ansökan snarast då urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av tester från Alva Labs, ett logiskt problemlösningstest och ett personlighetstest. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll som sammanställer tidigare offentligt brottsregister och ekonomisk skuldupplysning.
   

  

 Rekryteringen görs i samarbete med 2Complete.
   

  

 Ving ingår i den nordiska resekoncernen Nordic Leisure Travel Group. I gruppen ingår researrangörerna Ving Sverige, Globetrotter, Ving Norge, Spies i Danmark, Tjäreborg i Finland, flygbolaget Sunclass Airlines samt våra egna hotellkoncept Sunwing Family Resorts, Ocean Beach Club och Sunprime Hotels. Gruppen säljer ett normalt år runt 1 250 000 resor i de nordiska länderna.
   

  

 Vi är ett företag där vi har roligt och bryr oss om varandra med vårt people promise "it should be fun, developing and rewarding doing a good job".

title: Barista/Bartender - Soho House Stockholm
description:
**Barista/Bartender – Soho House Stockholm**
 We are seeking a full-time Barista who has a passion for exceptional coffee, genuine hospitality, and creating memorable member experiences. You also need to have experience in bartending and cocktails, as you'll be a part of the bar team where you support our bar operation as well.
   

  

 You'll have experience working in busy, high-profile venues and a flair for delivering first-class service in a fast-paced environment.
   

  

 As part of our Soho House team, your role is to ensure that our members have an amazing experience every time. With your natural hospitality charm, attention to detail, and positive energy, we'll give you a platform to connect, grow, have fun, and make an impact.
   

  

 For this role, we require a minimum of 2–3 years' experience in a similar café or coffee-focused role. Experience with bartending and cocktail preparation is a must. You must be able to work evenings and weekends.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Soho House offers competitive compensation packages for our Baristas that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you're seeking a new challenge or looking to develop your career in hospitality, we provide training to help you grow both technically and professionally.
   

  

* Soho Friends Membership
* Discount on all Cowshed products (up to 50%)
* Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our food and beverage programmes offer unique training, events, and opportunities to inspire and educate.
* Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionally
* Annual health care contribution (friskvårdsbidrag)


**What We Are Looking For..**
* A passionate coffee professional with excellent customer service skills
* Bartending and cocktail experience
* Team player who communicates well with all colleagues
* Punctual, reliable, and trustworthy
* Sense of urgency and ability to thrive in a busy environment
* A "Yes, yes, yes" mentality
* Positive, proactive, and solution-oriented
* A genuine passion for food and beverage


 We will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, with a short break during the summer holidays in July.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
 



  





 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and employee benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
 



  





**Why should you apply? 🌟** 



* Be part of a Delivery team where customer satisfaction and user adoption are at the heart of everything we do.
* Join a collaborative and supportive team that makes work both rewarding and enjoyable.
* Thrive in a highly customer-centric environment where you contribute to delivery success and client satisfaction while developing your project management skills.
* Work closely with cross-functional experts across a hybrid Agile and Waterfall delivery model.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and help shape how Benifex delivers world-class implementation projects.



  





**Great Benefits** 




 ⚖️ Work-life balance with a hybrid working model.
 



 🧠 ITP1 pension.
 



 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
 



 📝 Collective agreement.
 



 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
 



 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
 



 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
 



 💰 Referral bonuses.
 



 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
 



 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
 



  





**Role Overview 🚀** 




 This role is well suited for someone early in their project management career who is looking to develop their skills in a structured, supportive environment.
 



 As a Project Manager within the Nordics Project Management team, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality implementations of Benifex solutions, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with customer needs. You will support and manage a portfolio of concurrent projects, with guidance from experienced colleagues, from initiation through to delivery and user adoption. As the primary point of contact for customers throughout the implementation journey, you will play a key role in driving successful outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Responsibilities 🤘** 



* Manage multiple concurrent implementation projects across varying levels of complexity.
* Deliver projects against agreed scope, timelines, and budget.
* Take full end-to-end ownership of project delivery and outcomes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, setting and managing expectations.
* Identify and resolve misalignment between customer needs and agreed scope.
* Coordinate cross-functional project delivery teams (configuration, content, integrations) without formal line management.
* Proactively identify risks, mitigate issues, and maintain clear project reporting (RAG status, timelines, budgets, risks).
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned and helping to enhance delivery processes.



  





**What are we looking for? 🔎** 



* 2+ years of experience in project management.
* Experience delivering software implementation projects (SaaS experience is a plus).
* Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and system configuration.
* Comfortable interacting with customers, building relationships, and communicating effectively with stakeholders.
* Understanding of customer needs and pain points, with the ability to deliver accordingly.
* Familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on delivery quality and outcomes.
* Highly structured, organised, and proactive approach to work.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to coordinate work across project teams.
* Experience with Jira or equivalent project management tools.
* Eagerness to learn and develop within project management.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.



  





**Our interview process** 




**✌** 
 Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.
 



 📞 Initial call with the Talent team
 



 ⏳ Interview with the hiring manager
 



 ⏳ Case presentation
 



 🤩 Final interview with a senior team member.
 



  





 Please submit your CV in English. We are looking forward to reading your application!
 



*Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments for interviews by replying to the email you will receive after you apply.*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Insights are only valuable when they lead to better decisions. And increasingly, those decisions won’t only be made by people.
 



  





 Across Voyado, we’re evolving how retailers understand their customers, products, and performance. At the same time, we’re building more predictive and agentic experiences where AI can interpret that information and turn insight into action. For both to work, the foundation needs to be trusted, consistent, and built around the decisions retailers actually need to make.
 



  





 That’s where you come in.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As our Senior Product Manager for Insights & Analytics, you’ll own the direction of this capability across the Voyado product suite. That includes the analytics platform, the customer-facing analytics experiences retailers use every day, and the semantic and metric layer that increasingly powers our AI-driven experiences.
 



  





 You’ll work closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Engineering Managers, architects, and Product Managers across Voyado Engage and Elevate. Within Insights & Activation, you'll also work closely with our Targeting and AI teams, connecting the insights we generate with the audiences, predictions, and actions they enable.
 



  





**Some of the things you'll be up to:** 



* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Insights & Analytics across the Voyado product suite, from the underlying analytics platform to the experiences our customers use
* Run continuous discovery with retailers to understand the decisions they are trying to make and where better insights could genuinely change the outcome
* Work across Engage and Elevate to create a coherent analytics experience rather than reinventing analytics within individual products
* Define how we measure the success of the capability, including adoption, trust, time-to-insight, and the commercial value analytics creates for retailers and Voyado
* Contribute to how analytics is packaged and commercialized as it increasingly becomes something customers actively buy, rather than simply something included in the product



  





**So, who are you?** 




 We believe you're a Senior Product Manager who combines strong product judgment with genuine analytical curiosity.
 



  





 You're comfortable moving between customer problems, commercial opportunities, and fairly technical conversations about data. You will not be the person building the data models, but you understand them well enough to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and make informed product decisions alongside Analytics Engineers and architects.
 



  





 You think beyond individual features. When someone asks for another dashboard, your instinct is to understand the decision behind the request. When several products need similar capabilities, you look for what should become a shared platform capability. And when investing in foundations that may take time to pay off, you can explain why that investment matters in terms that both engineers and commercial stakeholders understand.
 



  





 You also know that analytics is fundamentally a trust product. A beautiful dashboard doesn't matter if customers don't believe the numbers in it. You care about correctness, consistency, and clear definitions while still knowing that a product needs to ship, create value, and evolve.
 



  





**We believe you have:** 



* Senior Product Management experience within B2B SaaS, preferably in retail, e-commerce, martech, CRM, loyalty, CDP, or BI
* A track record of owning a product area end to end, from strategy and discovery through roadmap, delivery, launch, and measurable outcomes
* Enough technical understanding to work credibly with Analytics Engineers and architects, including the ability to reason about data models, semantic and metric layers, data contracts, and lineage
* Experience working in multi-product environments where a shared capability needs to serve several products and teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience influencing teams and people you don't directly manage



  





 Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery, and analytics tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is also a plus.
 



 As insights increasingly become something our products can act on, not simply present, experience with AI, ML, predictive products, or agentic capabilities is particularly interesting.
 



  





**What's in it for you?** 




 You'll own a capability, not a backlog.
 



  





 Insights & Analytics spans the Voyado product suite, giving you the opportunity to shape both the platform underneath and the products built on top of it. You'll work on questions that range from how retailers understand their performance today to how AI agents will reliably reason about those same metrics tomorrow. You'll also be working on a modern data foundation, including Databricks and our move toward modern embedded analytics, with short decision paths and plenty of room to turn a strong product direction into something customers can actually use.
 



  





**Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers, and some examples of what we can offer you are:** 



* You’ll operate in a culture that values curiosity, open discussion, and constructive challenge, where good ideas triumph over hierarchy
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment
* Work-life balance. We don't have a long work-hours culture; we value engagement over hours worked



  





**Some of our benefits:** 



* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* In-house gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package, your choice!
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up with additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week



  





**About Voyado** 




 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
 



 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
 



  





 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel - online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
 



 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
 



  





**Be yourself 🏳️ 🌈** 




 At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar!
 



  





 Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table, which in the end leads not only to a better working environment but also a better product.
 



  





**Making it personal with AI** 




 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
 



  





 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about the most.
 



  





**Note** 
 : As of right now, we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.
 



  





**Ready to make an impact?** 




 Fantastic! 🎉
 



  





 Applying is easy - upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
 



 Additional information
 



  





 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**About We are Undo** 




 Do you want to run the growth engine of Europe's leading tattoo removal experts? If so, this might be the opportunity you've been looking for.
 



  





 During 2026, Rethink & Undo are joining forces under one unified brand. Our mission is to change the perception of tattoos as something permanent. Currently, we are represented across the UK, the Netherlands, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland.
 



  





 We are growing fast. Our plan is to scale from 20 to more than 60 clinics by 2029, expanding further into other markets. As our Performance Marketer, you will own our paid marketing across all markets — with one clear goal: turning ad spend into new clients.
 



  





**Your base** 




 You will work from our office in Stockholm or Amsterdam, with occasional travel to our European clinics and markets. Performance marketing is currently shared across the team and external partners. You will be our first dedicated performance hire, You will report to Anton our Head of Growth and collaborate closely with the rest of the growth and marketing team.
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 




 Own paid media: Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, and YouTube — end to end, across all our markets.
 


* Set up tracking: Build and maintain pixels, UTM structures, and server-side tracking so we can trust our data completely.
* Report on performance: Combine full-funnel marketing metrics with business performance reporting — new consultations, new paying customers — for a complete view of what's working and where to go next.
* Own attribution: Define and maintain our attribution model so we understand what actually drives bookings.
* Manage budgets: Handle budget pacing and bid management across channels and markets, making sure every euro and krona works hard.
* Inform creative: Use campaign data to tell us which hooks, formats, and angles deserve more investment.
* Improve the website: Run CRO experiments that turn more visitors into booked consultations.
* Run email & SMS: Own our email and SMS marketing to follow up with leads and support customers through their treatment journey.



  





**We are looking for** 



* Channel Expertise: You have a strong track record of 5+ years of proven results in paid channels such as Meta, Google, and others; TikTok and YouTube experience is a strong plus.
* Technical Skills: You're comfortable setting up pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs, and attribution yourself — not just briefing someone else to do it.
* Analytical Ability: You base decisions on data, build your own reports, and can explain exactly why a campaign is being scaled or cut.
* Full-Funnel Understanding: You know performance doesn't stop at the click — landing pages, email, and SMS are part of the job too.
* A "Hands-on" Mentality: You thrive on execution and are happiest working directly in the ad accounts, not just overseeing them.
* Communication: Fluent in English. Proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, or other European languages is a major plus.



  





**Interested?** 




 We'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short note about the best campaign you've ever run to anton@weareundo.com

title: Data Analyst (Early Careers)
description:
Job Overview
  
  

**About the Role:**  

This entry-level role is your chance to turn raw data into critical insights that guide decision-making across our entire organisation. You'll collaborate directly with Sales, Product Owners, and Senior Management and others, gaining exposure to a wide range of business functions.
  
We are looking for a motivated, collaborative, kind, and humble individual to join our team. You'll get hands-on with our modern data stack—think GCP, BigQuery, DBT, and Airflow—to build robust data solutions. This is more than just running queries; you'll help teams define their data needs and build the data models and Looker dashboards that answer their most pressing questions.
  
For a recent graduate, this is a unique opportunity to apply your knowledge, master in-demand technologies, and see your work make a tangible impact. We foster a collaborative environment where you'll be encouraged to learn, communicate effectively, and leverage our AI-assisted development workflow to enhance analysis and build solutions more efficiently.
  
  

**Responsibilities and impact:**  

OSTTRA has the largest financial institutions in the world as clients. We believe that long-term value to the client is the most important goal of our team, and technology is the tool to bring that value, and your contribution in the form of delivery, improvements and innovations can have a significant impact on the financial system.
  
* Data Analysis and Interpretation:
* Analyse and interpret complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their challenges and translate them into data requirements.
* Report and Dashboard Development:
* Design, build, and maintain interactive and user-friendly dashboards and reports in Looker.
* Iterate on and enhance existing reports based on user feedback and evolving business needs.
* Data Modelling & Transformation:
* Use DBT to transform, model, and test data within our data warehouse, preparing it for analysis.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of our Airflow managed data pipelines to ensure data is accurate, timely, and reliable.
* Work with data engineers to improve data quality, consistency, and ingestion processes.
* Collaboration and Communication:
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, present findings, and provide data-driven recommendations.
* Clearly communicate complex insights and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous Learning:
* Stay curious and up-to-date with the latest trends in our tech stack (GCP, BigQuery, DBT, Looker) and the broader data analytics field.
* Proactively seek opportunities for skill development and training, including leveraging our internal AI-assisted tools.


**What's in it for you:**  

We strongly believe in individual growth and have long experience in guiding early careers engineers in our modern approach to software production, which includes:
  
* Rapid, iterative and phased delivery, backed by automated testing and deployment frameworks.
* Streamlined, autonomous and independent teams, optimised and supported for fast change.
* Clean architecture for maintainable, scalable, and flexible code, aligned with the team structures and with clear boundaries and responsibilities.
* Innovative culture with strong focus on exploration and prototyping, where failing fast is a virtue which drives technological and product improvements.


**What we’re looking for:****Fundamental requirement:**  

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* A genuine eagerness to learn, grow, and take on new challenges in the data field.


**Additional preferred requirements:**  

* Internship or academic project experience related to data analytics or business intelligence.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modelling and data warehousing concepts.
* Basic programming skills (e.g., Python).
* Experience with a BI tool (like Looker, Power BI, etc.) from projects or internships.
* Exposure to version control (e.g., Git) and cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure).


To be considered for this position, please upload both your resume and your official/unofficial academic credentials/transcripts (betyg). Applications missing these documents will not be processed.
  
**The location:** Stockholm, Sweden
  
  

**Right to work requirements:**  

This role is limited to persons with right to work in Sweden.
  
**Our Benefits:** Global vision, local impact
  
At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
  
  

**Our approach is built on three core pillars:**  

* Global foundations: We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health & Wellness, Financial Security, and Work-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well-being.
* Locally tailored: We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* Flexibility and growth: We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.


The Trust employee ownership plan
  
Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly.
  
This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
  
About OSTTRA
  
  

We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
  
Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end-to-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
  
  

Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
  
Joining our team now is a unique opportunity - you will help to shape the next generation of post-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more at www.osttra.com.
  
  

**Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA:**  

We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on.

title: AI Engineer - Euromaster
description:
Om rollen
  
  

Vill du vara med och forma nästa generations mjukvaruutveckling för vår nordiska verksamhet? Hos Euromaster tar vi nu klivet från traditionell utveckling till ett AI-native ekosystem.
  
  

Som AI Engineer blir du arkitekten och dirigenten för vår autonoma AI-agentstyrka. Med ett AI-native arbetssätt i grunden och verktyg som Claude och Microsoft Azure omvandlar du övergripande affärsmål till skalbar, säker och produktionsredo mjukvara i absolut toppklass.
  
  

Du blir en del av vår nordiska IT-organisation och rapporterar direkt till CIO Nordics. Du ingår även i vårt europeiska Group Architecture Network där du delar insikter och är med och formar koncernens framtida teknologiska riktning. För dig som vill växa finns internationella möjligheter inom vår globala koncern.
  
  

Vad du kommer att göra
  
  

**Agera brygga mellan affär och AI:** Förstå affärens behov och se helheten för att översätta övergripande mål till strukturerade, AI-drivna lösningar. Du jobbar tillsammans med organisationen för att skapa möjligheter och lösningar.
  
**Orkestrera autonoma agentflöden:** Designa, delegera och övervaka parallella arbetsprocesser där flera AI-agenter samarbetar för att bygga komplexa systemkomponenter.
  
**Bygga i moderna AI-miljöer:** Arbeta nativt i Claude Code, CLI-baserade agentverktyg samt avancerade utvecklingsmiljöer (t.ex. Cursor, Windsurf).
  
**Automatisera och optimera pipelines:** Skapa och underhålla autonoma flöden för kodning, testning, CI/CD och Azure-deployment med minimal manuell friktion.
  
**Kontextarkitektur & Prompt Engineering:** Optimera kontextfönster och prompt-tekniker för att minimera responstider och molnkostnader.
  
**Säkra kodkvalitet och arkitektur:** Ansvara för systemarkitektur, säkerhetsstandarder och kvalitetssäkring så att AI-genererad kod möter höga enterprise-krav.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
  

För att lyckas i rollen har du framåtanda och är en drivande och självgående person som tar egna initiativ. Du har en god pedagogisk och kommunikativ förmåga samt stark samarbetsförmåga, då du samverkar med både affärsintressenter och utvecklingsteam på lokal, nordisk och internationell nivå. Du har ett genuint affärssinne och förmåga att se helheten.
  
  

**Vi ser att du har:**  

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som systemutvecklare/mjukvaruutvecklare.
  
Solid erfarenhet av arbete i Microsoft Azure (eller motsvarande molnmiljö).
  
**Ett AI-native tänk:** AI är din förstahandsmetod och en naturlig del av hur du tar dig an och löser utvecklingsutmaningar.
  
**Språk:** Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.
  
Relevant utbildning inom Datateknik, Systemvetenskap, Mjukvaruutveckling eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
  
  

**Det är meriterande med:**  

Praktisk erfarenhet av Claude och dess ekosystem (Claude Code, CLI-verktyg).
  
Erfarenhet av att bygga och orkestrera AI-agenter/multi-agent-system.
  
Relevanta Azure-certifieringar (t.ex. Azure AI Engineer Associate eller Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  
  

Vad erbjuder Euromaster?Euromaster är en del av Michelinkoncernen och är Europas ledande kedja inom däck- och bilservice. Hos oss kombineras tryggheten hos en stabil, global koncern med agiliteten i ett nordiskt team som arbetar med vår svenska och finska verksamhet och som ständigt utforskar ny teknik.
  
  

**Internationella utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Som en del av en stor IT- och digital organisation i en global koncern finns det möjligheter till karriärutveckling internationellt för rätt person (inget krav, men en möjlighet om intresse finns).Forma framtiden: Du får en nyckelroll i att vara med i vår AI-transformation.
  
  

**Ansökan & Praktisk informationPlacering:** Vårt svenska huvudkontor i varberg (Hybrid)Resor: Tjänsten innebär en del resor (någon till ett par gånger i månaden inom Sverige/Finland/Europa).Omfattning: Heltid, provanställningÖvrig information om rekryteringsprocessen: Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller för att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö och ansvarsfull drift.
  
  

Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag – urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
  
  

**Våra värderingar och ledarskapSäkerheten först – alltid:** Vi kompromissar aldrig med säkerheten för våra medarbetare och kunder. Det är grunden i allt vi gör. Expertis, Ärlighet och Kundfokus: Dessa värderingar vägleder oss i varje beslut. Genom att kombinera vår expertis med ett tydligt kundfokus och ett ärligt bemötande bygger vi det viktigaste vi har: förtroende. Ledarskap med I CARE: Vi tror att alla är ledare – oavsett roll leder vi oss själva genom de val och beteenden vi har mot varandra och våra kunder. Vår ledarskapsmodell, I CARE (Inspiring, Create trust, Awareness, Results, Empowerment), genomsyrar hela vår kultur och hjälper oss att skapa vinnande attityder i vardagen.
  
  

Euromaster AB är en del av Michelinkoncernen och Europas största däckkedja – med över 2800 verkstäder i 17 länder. Vi är specialister på däck- och fordonsservice och hjälper både privatpersoner och företag med trygga och hållbara transportlösningar. I Sverige har vi 130 verkstäder på över 100 orter, där våra dedikerade medarbetare står redo att ge personlig service, med stöd av erfarenheten och kompetensen från hela vårt europeiska nätverk. Det gör oss till en stark och pålitlig partner för allt som rullar – på vägar, åkrar, byggarbetsplatser och andra miljöer där fordon verkar. Vi arbetar aktivt för att minska våra kunders miljöpåverkan och kostnader, med smarta produkter och tjänster som främjar ett mer hållbart transportsystem. Vårt svenska huvudkontor ligger i Varberg.
  
  

www.euromaster.se

title: Systemförvaltare till Serviceförvaltningen
description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.

**Nu söker vi en utvecklingsinriktad systemförvaltare till en nystartad enhet som ansvarar för systemstöd inom bland annat kontaktcenter och ärendehantering.**

### **Välkommen till oss**


Denna roll ingår i enheten digital utveckling och informationshantering som ansvarar för att driva digital verksamhetsutveckling inom serviceförvaltningen. Enheten har även ansvar för att tillhandahålla den digitala arbetsplatsen till förvaltningens medarbetare. Här finns även funktionerna informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och GDPR samt förvaltningens arkiv-, registratur- och nämndhantering.


Du blir en del av ett team på nio personer som formas under hösten och får möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp både arbetssätt, struktur och förvaltning.


Vi sitter i trevliga lokaler i Slakthusområdet, precis intill Globens tunnelbanestation.

**Hälsning från din framtida chef**

Hej! Jag heter Johanna Thunström och kommer att vara närmaste chef. Mitt ledarskap präglas av förtroende, transparens och ett nära samarbete med fokus på dialog, delaktighet och stöd när det behövs. Jag samtalar gärna om riktning, mål och prioriteringar det är viktigt för mig att du får utrymme att bidra med din kompetens, dina perspektiv och egna initiativ. Jag ser fram emot att välkomna dig som med dina erfarenheter inom systemförvaltning och digital utveckling blir en möjliggörare i vårt fortsatta utvecklingsarbete.

### **Vi erbjuder dig**

* friskvårdsbidrag
* vinter- och sommararbetstid
* flextid och semesterväxling som kan innebära fem eller sex extra semesterdagar.

### **Din roll**


Som systemförvaltare hos oss arbetar du i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och it. Du förstår verksamhetens behov och kan samtidigt sätta dig in i tekniska lösningar och hur olika systemdelar samverkar.


Just nu pågår upphandling av ett nytt ärendehanteringssystem och en ny kontaktcenterplattform och som systemförvaltare får du en central och aktiv roll i införandet och etableringen av de nya systemstöden. Du kommer felsöka och lösa problem i kontaktcenterplattformen där datorer, ljudutrustning och mjukvara behöver fungera tillsammans. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, it och andra intressenter med att forma lösningarna, konfigurera och sätta upp systemen samt etablera nya arbetssätt. Målet är att säkerställa att systemstöden fungerar väl och möter verksamhetens behov.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att

* fånga verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till praktiska och hållbara lösningar i nära samarbete med verksamhet, it, leverantörer och andra samarbetspartners
* planera och anpassa kommunikation och stöd kring förändringar, nya funktioner och arbetssätt för olika målgrupper
* dokumentera, standardisera och skapa enhetlighet i lösningar, konfigurationer och arbetssätt samt säkerställa att användare får rätt information och stöd
* konfigurera, administrera och etablera systemstöd, samt delta i införande av nya system och arbetssätt
* felsöka, analysera och lösa incidenter och problem, identifiera bakomliggande orsaker och bidra till långsiktiga förbättringar
* driva kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete och bidra till utveckling av teamets arbetssätt, struktur och ansvarsfördelning.


Arbetet är varierat och du kommer att växla mellan operativa och mer långsiktiga frågor och du kommer arbeta både verksamhetsnära och it-nära. Det kan exempelvis handla om att konfigurera ett ärendehanteringssystem, ta fram information inför en förändring eller planera hur ny funktionalitet ska införas och kommuniceras till olika delar av verksamheten.

### **Din kompetens och erfarenhet**


Vi söker dig som har

* eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, kommunikation, informatik, statsvetenskap eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt
* minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet av liknande arbete, exempelvis inom systemförvaltning, IT-support, kontaktcenter, teknisk förvaltning, systemadministration eller liknande
* erfarenhet av arbete i en stor och/eller komplex organisation
* erfarenhet av att felsöka och lösa problem kopplade till IT-system eller tekniska användarmiljöer
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemstöd och förståelse för hur olika tekniska komponenter och system samverkar
* god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


Det är meriterande om du har

* erfarenhet från kommunal verksamhet, gärna Stockholms stad
* erfarenhet av systemförvaltning enligt pm3 eller annan etablerad modell
* erfarenhet av införande, konfiguration och administration av systemstöd, gärna i ärendehanteringssystem och kontaktcenterplattformar
* erfarenhet av införande av olika AI-lösningar
* erfarenhet av användarinformation, guider och kommunikation vid systemförändringar och införanden.


Vi söker dig som har en god **helhetssyn** och kan se både verksamhetens behov och hur olika system och lösningar hänger ihop. Du är **kommunikativ** och har lätt för att anpassa ditt sätt att förklara och förmedla information till olika målgrupper. Som person är du **stabil** och **strukturerad.** Du driver och prioriterar aktiviteter utifrån verksamhetens behov, sätter tydliga mål och skapar struktur för att säkerställa att uppgifter och leveranser genomförs i rätt tid.Vidare är du också lösningsorienterad. Du nöjer dig inte med att hitta en tillfällig lösning utan vill förstå orsaken och bidra till att problemet inte återkommer. Du trivs med att **samarbeta** och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med verksamhet, it, leverantörer och andra samarbetspartners. Du är **serviceinriktad** och har en **pedagogisk förmåga** att göra komplexa frågor begripliga och ge användare ett tydligt och tryggt stöd. Du möter användare och verksamhet samtidigt som du kan utmana och föreslå förbättringar.

### **Övrigt**


I denna rekrytering använder vi inte personligt brev, vilket innebär att du inte ska bifoga ett sådant. Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt cv och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och kortfattat på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt cv. Vi önskar att ditt cv är skrivet på svenska.


Vi ser mångfald som berikande och välkomnar alla sökande oavsett kön, könsöverskridande identitet eller uttryck, sexuell läggning, etnisk tillhörighet, religion eller annan trosuppfattning, funktionsnedsättning och ålder.


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


Stockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.  



Serviceförvaltningen är en av stadens fackförvaltningar och har i uppdrag att svara för de administrativa uppgifter som är samordnade i staden. Det handlar framförallt om löneadministration, ekonomiadministration, stadsövergripande upphandlingsfrågor, kontaktcenterverksamhet samt interna konsulter som tillhandahåller stöd inom digitalisering, it & telefoni, rekrytering, samt, fastighets- och lokalfrågor. Vi har cirka 400 medarbetare och sitter i Globenområdet. Vår värdegrund sammanfattas i ordet KÖRA som står för: Kompetens - Öppenhet - Respekt - Ansvar.

title: Informationssäkerhetssamordnare till Förskoleförvaltningen
description:
Förskoleförvaltningen har ett etablerat och pågående arbete med informationssäkerhet och dataskydd. Vi söker dig som vill bidra till ett tryggt, säkert och robust samhälle. I rollen är skyddet av barns personuppgifter och integritet en central utgångspunkt. Inom avdelningen samarbetar vi nära för att knyta samman arbetet med dataskydd (GDPR), informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet, IT-säkerhet och fysisk säkerhet.


Som informationssäkerhetssamordnare har du ett övergripande och samordnande ansvar för att utveckla, strukturera och följa upp förvaltningens arbete med informationssäkerhet och dataskydd. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och stödjer chefer och medarbetare i att omsätta lagkrav, styrdokument och arbetssätt i praktiken.

**Om enheten**


Enheten för digitalisering och innovation samordnar och stödjer Förskoleförvaltningen arbete med digitalisering och innovation. Arbetet utgår från förvaltningens digitaliseringsstrategi och handlingsplan. Hos oss blir du en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team. Vi värdesätter olika perspektiv och erfarenheter och arbetar nära varandra. Vi delar kunskap, lär av både framgångar och utmaningar och har alltid fokus på kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling.  

  

**Arbetsuppgifter:**
  

  

I rollen som informationssäkerhetssamordnare kommer du bland annat att:

* Arbeta med konsekvensbedömningar (DPA) inom GDPR
* Arbeta med informationsklassning utifrån Göteborgs Stads klassningsmodell
* Delta i arbetet med att implementera cybersäkerhetslagen
* Ta fram, uppdatera och förvalta styrdokument, till exempel policyer, riktlinjer, rutiner och instruktioner
* Arbeta med riskbedömning och riskhantering
* Hantera och utreda informations- och cybersäkerhetsincidenter
* Utbilda och skapa ökad säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos medarbetare och chefer
* Följa utvecklingen inom dina ansvarsområden både i omvärlden och inom Göteborgs stad

**Kvalifikationer**

* Högskole-/universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis IT/data, offentlig förvaltning, juridik eller annan eftergymnasial utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* Minst ett års erfarenhet av att arbeta med styrning, ledning och utveckling, oavsett om detta skett i rollen som specialist, samordnare, projektledare eller liknande

**Det är meriterande om du har:**

* Grundläggande kunskap om ISO 27001
* Erfarenhet av arbete med informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet och dataskydd
* Erfarenhet av utbildnings-, förändrings- eller utvecklingsarbete
* Erfarenhet av ledningssystem för informationssäkerhet
* Kunskap om juridik och lagstiftning kopplat till avtal och GDPR
* Erfarenhet av arbete med konsekvensbedömningar (DPA)

**Personliga egenskaper**  

Vi söker dig som är analytisk, driven och kommunikativ. Du kan identifiera kärnan i ett problem, analysera komplex information och föreslå lösningar, även när förutsättningarna är otydliga.


Du tar initiativ, sätter i gång aktiviteter och arbetar målmedvetet för att nå resultat. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som samarbetar väl med kollegor och andra intressenter.


I rollen är det viktigt att du kan uttrycka dig tydligt och förtroendefullt, både muntligt och skriftligt. Du anpassar din kommunikation efter mottagare och situation.


Du är också nyfiken och motiveras av att lära dig nya saker. Du tar initiativ till förbättringar och omvärldsbevakar inom ditt område för att hålla dig uppdaterad om utveckling och nya krav.  

  

Tjänsten är ett 12 månaders vikariat med önskat tillträde så snart som möjligt.  

  

Välkommen med din ansökan!

**Övrigt**  

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället Göteborgs Stads kontaktcenter på 031-365 00 00. Förklara ditt ärende och be att bli kopplad till HR-specialist på enheten kompetens och arbetsmarknad. I övrigt tar vi endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem.  

  

I den här rekryteringen efterfrågar vi inte personligt brev. I stället får du möjlighet att beskriva din kompetens inom relevanta områden genom att besvara våra urvalsfrågor.  

  

Enligt lag kan vi inför anställning be dig visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret. För vissa tjänster kan även ytterligare kontroller bli aktuella.  

  

Vi vet att du gör ett bättre jobb om du mår bra, både på jobbet och på fritiden. Här har vi samlat några av de förmåner vi erbjuder dig som jobbar hos oss: Förmåner  

  

Göteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik: Lön och ersättningar  

  

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till val av rekryteringskanaler. Vi undanber oss därför erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster.  

  

**Om Oss**  

På förskoleförvaltningen ger du barnen möjligheter till en bra framtid. Varje dag!  

  

Vi ansvarar för utbildning och omsorg för cirka 25 000 barn i närmare 350 kommunala förskolor. Förvaltningen har omkring 7 000 medarbetare fördelat på cirka 75 yrken. Tillsammans arbetar vi mot samma mål - att utveckla en rolig, trygg och lärorik förskola för alla barn i Göteborg.  

  

Läs gärna mer om vårt arbete på vår hemsida: Jobba i förskoleförvaltningen - Göteborgs Stad  

  

Välkommen till världens viktigaste jobb!
