title: Software Architect Infotainment
description:
##### **Project description**

Luxoft is a global software services company providing professional services across various industries, including finance, automotive, and digital transformation.  

  

The Automotive practice within DXC Luxoft delivers software projects to numerous global car manufacturers and suppliers of both personal and commercial vehicles. We are recognized for our automotive software expertise and for providing high-quality services and deliverables.  

  

Currently, we are expanding our team for our Swedish clients and seeking Test Automation Engineers. You will join our growing organization in Sweden and contribute to the development of next-generation systems for the automotive industry, focusing on connected, autonomous, and electric vehicles.  

  

This project primarily involves making design decisions, defining software architecture for software domains, and maintaining documentation.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design system architecture for infotainment platforms.


Coordinate Android upgrades from versions A13 to A17 and A1


Manage cross-team governance involving eight feature teams.


Oversee performance and stability KPI tracking and improvement.


Plan for technology evolution and future platform enhancements.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in automotive and infotainment system design, with a strong focus on Android Automotive OS and embedded systems. Candidates must demonstrate a deep understanding of Android system architecture, including Framework, SystemServer, native services, AIDL/HIDL interfaces, HAL abstraction, and SELinux security. Experience in designing and maintaining complex distributed systems with numerous interconnected services is essential. Proficiency in architectural patterns such as Service Bus, IPC, Event-Driven, Pub/Sub, and microkernel is expected. Additionally, expertise with vehicle communication protocols like CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SOME/IP is required. Strong skills in C/C++ and Android native development, including JNI, NDK, and service implementation, are critical. Knowledge of the Linux kernel, device drivers, and embedded system fundamentals is also necessary.


Hard skills involve:


Extensive experience in automotive and infotainment system development


Advanced proficiency with Android Automotive OS and embedded frameworks


Mastery of interface definition and communication using AIDL and HIDL


In-depth knowledge of vehicle communication protocols and standards


Solid background in Linux kernel and embedded system debugging


Soft skills include:


Capability to integrate complex software components within automotive environments


Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting and optimizing embedded OS interactions


Effective collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to deliver automotive solutions


Nice to have


Prior experience with OS/platform upgrades or major architectural transitions, demonstrating the ability to manage significant system changes.


Knowledge of ASPICE L3 or TISAX certification processes, indicating familiarity with industry-standard quality and security frameworks.


Familiarity with ISO 21434 cybersecurity engineering and Functional Safety (FUSA), reflecting understanding of automotive safety and security standards.


Experience with multi-market/variant software builds and CI/CD automation, showing competence in managing diverse software configurations and streamlined deployment.


Background in performance profiling, power optimization, or timing analysis, supporting efficient system performance and resource management.


Experience working in agile environments with multiple cross-functional teams, highlighting adaptability and collaboration skills.

Senior

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Software, the fuel for mobility**  

  

We bring bold digital visions to life. So we’re on the lookout for more curious and creative engineers who want to create change – one line of high-quality code at a time. Our transformation isn't for everyone, but if you're excited about solving the leading-edge technological challenges facing the auto industry, then let’s talk about your next move.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------

  

At Volvo Cars, we are on a journey to redefine mobility through software. As part of this transformation, the VC.OS.HI (Volvo Cars High Integrity) initiative is building critical in-house base software capabilities that will power the next generation of software-defined vehicles.  

  

We are therefore establishing a practical AI-native engineering capability focused on solving real engineering problems, accelerating developer productivity, improving knowledge access, and enabling better decision-making across the software lifecycle.



As an Applied AI Lead Engineer, you will help shape how AI is adopted inside one of Volvo Cars' most strategic software programs. You will work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, developer productivity, and automotive innovation, translating advanced AI technologies into tangible engineering value.

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

As an Applied AI Lead Engineer, you will lead the design and industrialization of AI capabilities that enhance engineering effectiveness across Volvo Cars.  

  

You will:

  


* Lead applied AI solutions from concept and architecture through implementation, validation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Design solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Graph-RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic AI workflows.
* Build AI assistants that help engineers use knowledge across requirements, architecture, source code, CI/CD, testing, design documents, and operational data.
* Improve development workflows through AI-enabled backlog and requirements analysis, code navigation, documentation, testing, diagnostics, and decision support.
* Define scalable AI architectures covering data ingestion, indexing, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, observability, and secure deployment.
* Partner with architects, concept leads, developers, CI/build teams, and platform organizations to prioritize high-value use cases.
* Establish best practices for evaluation, prompt engineering, governance, quality assurance, security, and Responsible AI.
* Mentor engineers and help build sustainable AI engineering capability across VC.OS.HI.
* Measure impact through productivity, knowledge reuse, development efficiency, traceability, and developer experience.
* Contribute to Volvo Cars’ long-term AI strategy and AI-native engineering ways of working.
**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

We are looking for a hands-on technically strong and curious AI engineer who enjoys converting complex engineering challenges into practical solutions with measurable impact.

  

You likely have:

  

**Required qualifications:**

  

* Proven experience delivering AI-enabled products, platforms, or engineering solutions used by real users in production or production-like environments.
* Experience with LLM-based applications, including RAG, agentic AI, and tool-integrated systems.
* Hands-on experience with self-hosted models, model serving, inference optimization, and GPU resource management.
* Understanding of AI safety and reliability challenges, including tool misuse, context drift, retry loops, and guardrails.
* Experience building production-grade AI systems with scalability, observability, fault tolerance, and maintainability in mind.
* Knowledge of advanced retrieval architectures, including vector databases, knowledge graphs, hybrid search, reranking, and RAG pipelines.
* Experience designing multi-agent and multi-step workflows with state management, memory, orchestration, and recovery mechanisms.
* Ability to work across the full AI engineering lifecycle, from experimentation and evaluation to deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Strong software engineering and collaboration skills, translating AI innovations into reliable production solutions.

  

  

**Preferred qualifications:**

  

* Experience building enterprise knowledge assistants, engineering copilots, developer productivity tools, or AI-enabled software factory capabilities.
* Knowledge of MLOps, AI evaluation frameworks, telemetry, monitoring, and production AI operations.
* Experience in automotive, embedded systems, cloud platforms, developer platforms, or large-scale engineering organizations.
* Familiarity with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, vector or graph databases, FastAPI, and cloud-native architectures.
* Understanding of requirements, architecture, testing, CI/CD, and software development lifecycle processes.
* Experience enabling AI in regulated, security-sensitive, or safety-oriented environments.
  

**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.
  

  

At Volvo Cars, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with a passion for making a difference. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to help redefine the future of mobility, we invite you to be part of our journey.  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than 31st of August 2026. You will receive a confirmation email after your submission.  

  

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Recruiter Radoslaw Piela at radoslaw.piela@volvocars.com. For specific questions about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Venkata Siva Prasad Sarangam at venkata.siva.prasad.sarangam@volvocars.com.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates will undergo a background check.  

  

We welcome your application!

description:

### **Din Roll**


I denna tjänst kommer du att arbeta som Scrum Master i ett team som jobbar med mjukvara för elektronisk övervakning. Du blir en del av en miljö där vi värdesätter samarbete, lärande och ständig förbättring. Du kommer att ha en central roll i att skapa struktur, tydlighet och energi i teamens dagliga arbete. Ditt uppdrag handlar främst om och att bidra strategiskt till ett mer effektivt och modernt agilt arbetssätt och kommer därmed vara en viktig ambassadör för det agila arbetssättet i hela organisationen. Det innebär att du aktivt utmanar invanda arbetssätt, sprider kunskap och samarbetar med andra Scrum Masters för att driva gemensamma förbättringar. Du kommer också behöva stötta teamen operativt genom att aktivt jobba med testning av produkten.  

  

I den här rollen kommer du:

* Leda och facilitera det agila arbetet
* Skapa förutsättningar för fokus, leverans och kontinuerlig förbättring
* Coacha team och individer i agila arbetssätt och samarbete
* Bidra till att utveckla arbetssätt i större och komplexa utvecklingsmiljöer
* Samarbeta nära produktägare, utvecklare och andra nyckelroller
* Arbeta i komplexa projekt med varierande förutsättningar och höga krav på struktur och kommunikation
* Aktivt delta i testning och kvalitetssäkring av mjukvaran

### 

**Din profil**

  

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av produktutveckling i komplexa miljöer och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera struktur med människor och utveckling. Du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och trygg i att samarbeta med olika typer av personer. Du har ett agilt mindset och drivs av att se både team och arbetssätt utvecklas. Du vågar utmana, kommer med nya idéer och skapar energi i grupper du arbetar med.

  

Som person är du nyfiken med en naturlig vilja att förstå hur saker hänger ihop och hur individer kan utvecklas tillsammans i ett team. Du trivs i en miljö där du får skapa ordning, tydlighet och framdrift även när förutsättningarna är komplexa. Du är trygg i din kommunikation och kan enkelt anpassa dig till olika roller och nivåer i organisationen, oavsett om du pratar med utvecklare, produktägare eller andra intressenter. Du har du ett intresse för teknik och hur mjukvaruutveckling fungerar i praktiken, med fokus på kvalitet och tests. Detta gör att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i teamets vardag och bidra på ett relevant och konkret sätt.

  

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

* 1–3 års erfarenhet av arbete i eller nära en Scrum Master roll
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i team
* Erfarenhet av testning och kvalitetetssäkring av mjukvara
* God kunskap om agila metoder och agilt ledarskap
* Erfarenhet från större organisationer med komplexa strukturer
* God vana av Jira eller liknande verktyg
* Mycket god kommunikativ/skriftlig förmåga i svenska

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **IT Client Services Lead** is responsible for delivering reliable site IT support for the Solna office while acting as a senior technical resource for local users, regional IT colleagues, and cross-functional business stakeholders. This role uses in-depth client services and infrastructure knowledge to resolve complex issues, improve local IT service performance, and support consistent adoption of global IT standards across the site.


This is an individual contributor Professional P3 role. The role may provide informal guidance to colleagues and may lead small site or service improvement projects, but it does not carry people-management accountability.


This position reports to the *IT Director, Client Services (EMEA/APAC)* and is part of the *IT EMEA/APAC Site Support and Applications,* located in *Solna, Sweden* and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* **Partner in IT Client Services Leadership** for the Solna manufacturing site and serve as a key contributor across EMEA and APAC, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable workplace technology services that support business operations, manufacturing continuity, and an exceptional end-user experience.
* **Drive cross-functional and cross-regional collaboration across EMEA and APAC**, coordinating global IT teams, vendors, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application owners, and manufacturing stakeholders to successfully deliver technology initiatives, standardization efforts, and service improvements.
* **Lead technology lifecycle management for manufacturing and workplace environments**, including endpoint strategy, asset management, refresh planning, capacity management, and business continuity preparedness to minimize operational risk and disruption
* **Lead through influence, expertise,** developing technical capability across the Client Services organization, promoting best practices, and serving as a trusted escalation point for complex technical and operational challenges
* **Provide technical leadership across end-user computing, industrial endpoint technologies, collaboration platforms, AV systems, telecom, support cloud services, and manufacturing-adjacent technologies**, ensuring high availability and rapid resolution of complex issues impacting business-critical operations.

**The essential requirements of the job include**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field with 5+ years of related IT client services, site support, infrastructure, or end-user technology experience; or Master’s degree in a related field with 3+ years of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* In-depth practical experience supporting corporate end-user technology environments, including Windows endpoints, Microsoft productivity tools, mobile devices, printers, meeting room/audio-visual equipment, asset lifecycle, and enterprise support processes.
* Working knowledge of related infrastructure and service areas such as LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, cloud-enabled workplace services, identity/access processes, endpoint management, cybersecurity controls, telecom, and vendor/provider coordination.
* Proven ability to solve complex or recurring technical and service problems independently, using judgment based on multiple sources of information, established standards, business impact, and appropriate escalation paths.
* Strong stakeholder communication, prioritization, and service management skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to non-technical audiences, manage multiple priorities, document work effectively, and build consensus across local and regional teams.

*.*

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:**

* Traveling might be required 10%.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* ITIL, Microsoft, networking, endpoint management, cloud, or cybersecurity certifications or equivalent practical training.
* Help Desk or site support coordination activities in a regulated, manufacturing, diagnostics, life sciences, healthcare, or corporate environment.
* Using service management, asset management, knowledge management, or continuous improvement practices to improve user experience and operational performance

title: Technical Specialist – Healthcare IT - LIMS
description:
Join our team and your talent could be part of creating software that helps healthcare professionals bring new life safely into the world, helps people live longer and more fully, and makes all the difference in emergencies when every second counts.


Our teams empower customers with tools to support their patients and help save lives. We currently have seven business areas that develop specialised software solutions across medical fields and emergency services. At Omda you’ll be close to customer needs and your work will have an impact where it matters most.


Our **Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)** business provides comprehensive support for all aspects of blood, cell and tissue management, with 180 blood centres across 5 countries utilising the platform.


As our **Technical Specialist**, you'll join a team that installs, upgrades and improves ProSang while maintaining customer and internal system environments. You'll split your time between deploying and upgrading ProSang environments, troubleshooting customer systems, and working with colleagues to improve deployments and technical solutions.


If this sounds interesting to you, join our team in **Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo or Gothenburg**!


We currently work in a hybrid 3:2 model, with three days in the office and two days working from home each week.

 **As our Technical Specialist you will:**

* Set up and configure Linux and Windows servers, including basic database administration and Oracle database setup
* Perform minor and major upgrades, patching, maintenance and troubleshooting of ProSang applications and modules
* Work directly with blood centres across the Nordics to solve technical challenges, plan upgrades and ensure stable system environments within the LIMS domain, while managing customer communication, requests and technical requirements

**Your matching strengths for our role:**

* Preferably a couple of years' experience with Windows and Linux environments (server and client), or equivalent technical knowledge and a strong willingness to learn
* Experience with software installation on Linux and Windows servers, including Oracle databases
* Good understanding of server infrastructure and error tracing
* Relevant education or equivalent experience
* Fluent in at least one Scandinavian language
* Flexible and able to handle unplanned tasks

 **Would be great, but not mandatory, if you have:**

* Knowledge of Oracle databases (installation, backup, and recovery)
* Comfort communicating with customers in both IT departments and healthcare organisations

***We are interviewing continuously, therefore we recommend you submit your application as soon as possible.***

***Looking forward to meeting you!***

title: Testledare till Myndighet
description:

* Säkerställa rapportering av teststatus, testprogress samt testrapporter till berörda delar av organisationen och programmet.

Du får samarbeta med kollegor med många års erfarenhet inom energibranschen och kommer således ha möjlighet att få god vägledning och utbildning i din nya roll samt skaffa dig djup kunskap om energimarknaden parallellt med det tekniska arbetet.


Vid behov kan närliggande arbetsuppgifter och roller ingå inom avdelningen eller tvärfunktionellt inom organisationen.

**1.** Högskole-/universitetsutbildning minst 120p/180hp inom IT/Ekonomi/El/Teknik/Data.

**4.** Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av testautomation och leverans av testfall främst för verksamhetens tester.  

**5.** Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom test, vad gäller testplanering och teststrategi, samt operativ ledning av systemintegration- och Acceptanstest.  

**6.** Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att kunna leda och coacha juniora testare och agila team i arbetet med test och kvalitetssäkring  

**7.** Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet från svensk eller annan nordisk elmarknad

När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.


Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer

title: Software Engineer within Automotive
description:
Want to build automotive software where correctness, timing, and safety matter? Join technically demanding projects in ADAS, electrification, and connected vehicles.


You will develop embedded software for systems with complex interactions and strict requirements for performance, reliability, and functional safety. The work is hands-on, with opportunities to influence architecture, design decisions, and technical direction.


Depending on the assignment, you may:

* develop safety-critical embedded software in C and C++
* work close to the operating system using RTOS, Linux, or QNX
* debug and optimize systems with critical timing and resource constraints
* collaborate with systems engineers, testers, and hardware teams to ensure end-to-end functionality
* contribute to software architecture, technical decisions, testing, and quality assurance


Many assignments involve AUTOSAR and ASPICE, where traceability, testing, and structured quality processes are integral to development.

**To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:**
---------------------------------------------------

* several years of experience in embedded software development or automotive software
* solid knowledge of C and C++
* a strong understanding of embedded systems and low-level behavior
* experience working with RTOS, Linux, QNX, or a similar environment
* the ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across software, systems, testing, and hardware disciplines

### **Preferred qualifications**


Experience with AUTOSAR, ASPICE, automotive communication protocols, or tools from Vector is valuable. Knowledge of Rust is also a plus.


Fluency in Swedish is beneficial for some assignments.

**What can you expect from us?**
--------------------------------


You will work on technically challenging assignments that allow you to deepen your expertise, influence technical direction, and continue growing as an engineer. Rather than working alone in customer projects, you will have opportunities to join teams with experienced colleagues in embedded and automotive systems.


A close local team provides day-to-day support and knowledge sharing, while Knowit’s broader network connects you with expertise across technologies and industries.

**Application**
---------------


Let’s start a conversation. We would be happy to tell you more about our projects, how we work, and what you would like to take on next.

**About Knowit**
----------------


Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.


Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.


We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.


We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**For our client Aurobay/Horse Powertrain we are looking for a Network Engineer,**


Aurobay develops and produces world-class hybrid engines and transmissions. With factories on two continents - Sweden and China - we're a pioneering global supplier of propulsion technology, development services and contract manufacturing. The Aurobay brand brings together over 9,000 dedicated and determined people that design, develop, and manufacture next-generation powertrain solutions for a global market.


Aurobay is part of HORSE Powertrain Limited, a global leader in powertrain solutions. The Group has 19,000 employees, 17 plants and 5 R&D centers across three continents. We partner with OEM customers around the world and offer innovative solutions that can cater to up to 80% of the growing hybrid and combustion powertrain market, enabling a faster transition toward cleaner mobility.


At Aurobay, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives and experiences make for a stronger, more innovative company.

**We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer** to join our **Global Team** responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the organization’s network infrastructure. As part of this collaborative and dynamic team, you will contribute to ensuring the **security, reliability, and performance** of both wired and wireless network systems.


Additionally, you will play a critical role in optimizing solutions such as **Cisco ISE, Catalyst Center,** leveraging your expertise with these tools - or equivalent technologies - to drive operational excellence.


﻿

**Required skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Certifications: Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or their equivalent.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Proficiency in network protocols and technologies—especially 802.1X.
* Hands-on monitoring and automation experience.
* Solid experience managing firewalls (e.g., Fortigate, Palo Alto).
* In-depth knowledge of technologies like SD-WAN and MPLS.

**Desired Skills:**

* Strong understanding of network security principles and best practices (segmentation, NAC, firewalling, zero trust concepts).
* Experience with network monitoring, troubleshooting and observability tools (SNMP, NetFlow, logs, packet inspection).
* Hands-on experience with enterprise wireless networking (design, deployment, RF optimization, troubleshooting, 802.11 / 802.1x).
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Ansible, Python or similar).
* Familiarity with SDN technologies and modern network automation concepts.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About WPP Media**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.



WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.



For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

**Role Summary and Impact**



At Choreograph, part of WPP Media, we're leading the way in data-driven marketing solutions. We collaborate with the world's most ambitious brands to solve complex challenges in media and marketing through data and technology. From econometrics and media buying algorithms to dashboards and strategic consulting, our work has an impact.



WPP Media Sweden is building a local data engineering capability to support the entire Swedish organisation. The team will create the data foundations that help us work smarter across data, automation, measurement, Open Intelligence and AI, while turning Nordic and global technology investments into concrete value for the Swedish business.



As an Data Engineer, you will learn to build and maintain reliable cloud-based data solutions that make client data easier to access, improve reporting automation and enable advanced analytics. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across data engineering, business intelligence, data science and media, with guidance and room to grow.



If you're curious, enjoy solving problems with data and want to start your career in a collaborative environment where your work supports teams across WPP Media Sweden, this could be the perfect role for you!


**What you'll do**



We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will:


* Support the development and maintenance of cloud-based data pipelines and infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Use Python and SQL to collect, transform and prepare data for reporting, measurement, analytics and AI use cases.
* Assist with data quality checks, monitoring and troubleshooting to help keep data products accurate and reliable.
* Work with colleagues in media, business intelligence and data science to understand internal needs and turn them into practical data solutions.
* Contribute to documentation, version control and repeatable engineering practices, including infrastructure and transformation workflows.
* Take part in training, workshops and knowledge sharing, while gradually taking ownership of well-defined engineering tasks.


**Skills and Experience**



This is an entry-level position, suitable for candidates with approximately 0–2 years of experience. We welcome experience gained through education, internships, personal projects or limited professional experience, and the requirements below should be viewed in that context.
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a similar quantitative or technical field.
* Experience with programming, gained through education, projects or work experience. We use Python as our main coding language.
* Foundational knowledge of SQL and an understanding of how structured data is stored, transformed and queried.
* An interest in cloud platforms and modern data engineering. We use Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* A structured and curious approach to problem-solving, with care for data quality and documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain technical questions clearly to colleagues with different backgrounds.
* English: Fluent in speech and writing
* You have a valid work permit in Sweden


**Nice to have**


* Hands-on experience from internships, student projects or personal projects involving data pipelines, APIs, databases or cloud services.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Exposure to GCP, Terraform, Dataform, dbt or similar data engineering tools.
* Experience with Power BI or another business intelligence tool, or an interest in media, marketing or measurement.
* Swedish: good understanding in speech and writing


**Life at WPP Media & Benefits**



Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.



In Sweden, our benefits include a SEK 3,000 wellness allowance, a 37,5-hour workweek, half-days and "klämdagar" off, 30 days of vacation, and two paid volunteer days per year. WPP Media Sweden is a member of Almega, and all employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (kollektivavtal), which ensures occupational pension, insurance, and other negotiated terms. We host regular team activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and wellness initiatives throughout the year.


WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.  

  

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

  

**Application**  

  

This is a full-time permanent position with a start date as soon as possible. We apply a six-month probationary period.



In addition to reviewing your CV and conducting interviews, our recruitment process includes a testing phase. Selection and interviews are ongoing, so please submit your application as soon as possible.



We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger and encourage applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.


**Contact**



If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Viktor Åhlen (viktor.ahlen@wppmedia.com) or Martin Söderhäll (martin.soderhall@wppmedia.com). Due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.



Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Software Engineer (GoLang/PHP)
description:
**About Gelato**
----------------


Gelato has built the world's largest and most global network for on-demand production of customized items e.g. t-shirts, wall art, mugs, books, hoodies, and cards. We support a new wave of e-commerce entrepreneurs and the global shift towards local and more sustainable production.


In many ways, we at Gelato are rethinking how digital fabrication of customized products can be done on-demand. Just imagine what will happen when we add 3D printing capabilities to this global service. We are already empowering thousands of e-commerce entrepreneurs to grow and scale their businesses.

**Platform**
------------

**Gelato** is an **AI-first**, cloud-native platform transforming local, on-demand production and delivery — with zero physical assets. We power:

* **Global production orchestration**: connecting e-commerce customers to 130+ partners across 32 countries. From AI-guided plate design to smart routing and logistics, we deliver to over 5 billion people in under 72 hours—faster, greener, smarter.
* **GelatoConnect**: our AI-driven print production OS that helps producers master digital printing — from inventory to shipping — by automating every step: procurement, prepress, printing, packaging, and dispatch. It’s machine-agnostic, real-time, and built for uptime, precision, and profitability.

**AI at the Core**
------------------


We are not just early adopters of AI — we’re **AI-native builders**. Across engineering, product, and operations, we embrace AI to accelerate innovation:

* **AI-first development** using LLMs for code generation, testing, documentation, and design exploration.
* **Autonomous AI agents** driving platform resilience, observability, cost control, and internal workflow automation.
* **AI-native product features** built into GelatoConnect and the core platform — improving routing, personalization, and production optimization.
* A culture of **continuous experimentation** with RAG, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and model fine-tuning.

**What you will be doing**
--------------------------

* Using the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
* Collaborating closely with other engineers as a valuable member of a cross-functional team
* Sharing your knowledge and building creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices
* Designing, developing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and scalability
* Taking end-to-end responsibility for the services that are owned by your team, including taking part in an on-call rotation

**Who you are**
---------------

* A programming language agnostic having 5+ years of experience in a similar role
* Having a minimum of B.S. degree in Information Technology or Computer Sciences
* Able to adapt, change and grow quickly as we scale the organization
* Passionate about engineering practices like agile, continuous delivery, test-driven development, traceability, and observability
* Growth mentality, are curious and not afraid to be experimental.
* You share your ideas and continuously improve yourself and the team around you
* Solid experience as an Engineer designing, developing, and maintaining API driven solutions
* Strong communication skills, high integrity, and great attention to detail

**Possess knowledge and experience, or have an interest in working with:**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Docker and Kubernetes
* GoLang (Go-kit, DDD) and/or PHP (Symfony)
* Microservices architecture
* PostgreSQL, BigQuery, RabbitMQ
* Memcache, Redis
* ELK, DataDog, Prometheus & Grafana

**What it’s like to work at Gelato**
------------------------------------


We are a customer-obsessed team with the ambition to change the world by connecting technology to the printing industry and making it much more sustainable. Everyone who joins our team must feel genuinely intrigued and motivated by our mission. We expect a lot. We are a driven team with big goals, so we seek individuals who are genuinely passionate about their work and possess an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is unique and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture and how we work before presenting your application.


At Gelato, we pride ourselves on our global presence with 14 offices worldwide, fostering a dynamic and diverse work environment. Rooted in a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and camaraderie, we actively cultivate a company culture that thrives on shared experiences. We encourage team members to embrace this culture by working from our inspiring office spaces at least three days a week, allowing for meaningful connections and collective growth.


Lastly, we ask that you please upload your CV in **English**, regardless of which country you are applying from.

description:
Lead the next generation of marine control systems
  
Marine Jet Power utvecklar avancerade vattenjetbaserade framdrivningssystem för snabbgående fartyg. Nu söker vi en Technical Lead som vill leda utvecklingen av nästa generations embedded-baserade marina styrsystem och samtidigt bygga framtidens arbetssätt tillsammans med vårt utvecklingsteam. Läs gärna mer om oss på https://marinejetpower.com/
  
Din roll
  
* Leda utvecklingen av våra styrsystem och embedded-lösningar.
* Skapa struktur, prioriteringar och teknisk riktning.
* Bidra till arkitektur, verifiering och tekniska vägval.
* Coacha utvecklingsteamet och skapa samarbete.
* Balansera teknik, kvalitet, tid, kostnad och affärsnytta.


Vi söker dig som
  
Har erfarenhet av avancerad produktutveckling inom embedded systems, automation, fordon, försvar eller liknande teknikområden. Du kombinerar djup teknisk förståelse med ledarskap och ett tydligt resultatfokus.
  
Nödvandiga kvalifikationer
  
* Civilingenjorsexamen eller masterexamen inom elektroteknik, datateknik, inbyggda system eller likvärdigt
* Minst 5 ars erfarenhet av inbyggd mjukvaruutveckling, varav minst 2 ar i en ledande eller ansvarig roll
* Kunskap i C, C++ och PLC
* Förståelse för marina system, drivsystem eller liknande inbyggda reglersystem.
* Van att arbeta med versionshantering
* God förmåga att kommunicera tekniska koncept pa svenska och engelska


Dina viktigaste personliga kompetenser
  
* Analys och omdöme
* Resultatorientering
* Systematiskt arbetssätt
* Effektiv kommunikation
* Konstruktivt teamarbete
* Personalutveckling


Framgång i rollen
  
* Etablera en tydlig utvecklingsmetodik.
* Öka leveransprecision och samarbete mellan hårdvara och mjukvara.
* Bidra till nästa generations marina styrsystem.


Utveckla teamets kompetens och långsiktiga arbetssätt
  
Varför Marine Jet Power?
  
Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka nästa generations marina styrsystem i ett internationellt teknikbolag med korta beslutsvägar, hög teknisk nivå och stor möjlighet att göra skillnad.

title: Produktägare/IT-projektledare CRM
description:
Röda Korset är världens största humanitära rörelse och finns i 191 länder. När katastrofen slår till är vi redan på plats för att hjälpa utsatta människor, inte minst tack vare 16 miljoner volontärer. Svenska Röda Korset driver verksamhet inom kris och katastrof, skyddsfrågor samt hälsa och vård. Vi har förtroendet att omsätta bidrag från individer, företag och myndigheter i konkreta insatser för de mest utsatta. Vi kämpar för att rädda liv, och ge hopp, överallt och varje dag. Oavsett i vilken roll du jobbar är du med och bidrar – i just din profession och genom handlingskraft och mod. Välkommen till vår värld!
  
Vill du
  
använda din tekniska kompetens för att göra verklig skillnad? Hos Svenska Röda
  
Korset bidrar du i en verksamhet som räddar liv varje dag. Nu behöver vi en
  
kollega som kan driva digital utveckling och förvalta vår CRM-plattform!
  
Om tjänsten
  
I rollen
  
ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta digitala tjänster med fokus på vårt
  
CRM-system och kringliggande tjänster. Vårt CRM är navet i både vårt
  
insamlingsarbete och vårt stöd till våra
  
lokalföreningar och volontärer. Du
  
kombinerar produktägarskap, systemförvaltning och projektledning – och är med
  
från behov till lösning.
  
Det ligger i ditt uppdrag att framtidssäkra befintlig CRM-miljö. Du arbetar med externa utvecklings-partners för att kontinuerligt vidareutveckla och förbättra funktionerna i systemen och ansvarar för budget, upphandlingar och avtal inom ditt område. Du leder utvecklingsteamet.
  
Du
  
  

**kommer bland annat att:**  

Driva utveckling och förvaltning av vår CRM-plattform MS Dynamics
  
Prioritera behov, planera utveckling och hålla ihop back log och roadmap
  
Samverka med leverantörer och säkerställa leverans, kvalitet och prestanda
  
Inte koda men gärna kunna konfigurera, testa och göra initial felsökning
  
Driva förstudier och leda den tekniska leveransen vid införanden av nya lösningar och vidareutveckling och uppgradering av befintlig plattform
  
Fånga upp behov från verksamheten och omsätta dem till konkreta lösningar
  
  

Arbetet
  
innebär många kontaktytor – från verksamhetsrepresentanter till utvecklare och
  
leverantörer. Du får en central roll i att skapa lösningar som fungerar i
  
vardagen.
  
Om dig
  
Vi tror
  
att du har en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom IT eller
  
systemvetenskap och mångårig erfarenhet av att arbeta nära verksamheten med
  
digital utveckling – till exempel som produktägare, systemförvaltare eller
  
IT-projektledare.
  
Du har
  
Förmåga att omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar
  
Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med leverantörer
  
Gedigen kunskap om agila arbetssätt och har själv haft rollen som produktägare i ett agilt team
  
  

**Meriterande:**  

Erfarenhet av MS Dynamics och MS Power platform
  
Erfarenhet av medlemsorganisation eller ideell sektor
  
Erfarenhet av hur AI och automatisering, kan skapa nytta i verksamheten och av att utveckla lösningar baserade på CRM-data
  
  

Som
  
  

**person:**  

Är du strukturerad och samarbetsinriktad och kan driva processer från start till mål
  
Gillar du att sätt dig in i tekniken och kan prata med både arkitekter, utvecklare och behovsägare
  
Är du trygg och lösningsorienterad ledare som ser dina medmänniskor och har nyttan för målgruppen framför ögonen
  
  

Mer om oss
  
Du blir en del av vår IT-funktion där du har flera kollegor med motsvarande roll men med ansvar för andra produktportföljer. Du samarbetar nära kollegor både på vår Engagemangs och insamlingsavdelning och i vår Nationella verksamhet och stöttar genom att leverera tillförlitlig effektiv teknik.
  
Hos oss
  
får du använda din kompetens i ett sammanhang där den gör skillnad – varje dag.
  
  

**Du får:**  

Ett meningsfullt uppdrag i en global humanitär organisation
  
Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla digitala lösningar med stor räckvidd
  
Vara del av ett team och samarbeta med engagerade kollegor
  
  

Ingen
  
kan göra allt, men alla kan göra något – tillsammans gör vi mer.
  
Övrig information
  
I den
  
här rollen behöver du kunna arbeta på svenska. I tjänsten kan förekomma enstaka
  
möten på kvällar eller helg.
  
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tänkt placering på vårt kontor på
  
Lindhagensgatan 126 i Stockholm. Vi
  
tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning. Start enligt överenskommelse.
  
På
  
Svenska Röda Korset har vi förkortad arbetstid och jobbar i snitt 36,25 timmar
  
per vecka över året. Vi har även möjlighet att jobba hemifrån upp till två
  
dagar i veckan och att utföra en timme friskvård på betald arbetstid. Vi
  
erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och lunchförmån.
  
Så här rekryterar vi
  
Vi
  
välkomnar din ansökan senast den 6 september 2026. Välkommen att kontakta
  
rekryterande chef Anders Larsson på anders.larsson@redcross.se om du har frågor
  
om tjänsten.
  
Svenska
  
Röda Korset strävar efter att vara en inkluderande organisation med medarbetare
  
som bidrar till mångfald i både perspektiv, erfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror
  
att det gör oss mer relevanta. Därför rekryterar vi gärna personer som har
  
olika etnisk och social bakgrund, könsidentitet- och uttryck, tro, ålder,
  
funktionsvariationer och sexuell läggning. 
  
Vår
  
rekryteringsprocess startar med ett första urval baserat på en upprättad
  
kravprofil och följs sedan av intervjuer och i vissa fall online-tester samt
  
bakgrundskontroll och referenstagning.
  
Då Svenska
  
Röda Korset är med i "Inter-Agency Scheme for
  
the Disclosure of Safeguarding-related Misconduct" för
  
att skydda vår sektor från sexuella övergrepp ställer vi särskilda frågor kring
  
detta till dina referenser. Slutkandidater kan även komma att screenas
  
mot EUs och FNs sanktionslistor.
  
Här hittar du kontaktuppgifter till de fackklubbar som finns representerade hos oss. Du lan också läsa mer om oss som arbetsgivare på vår karriärsida. 
  
Vi
  
undanber oss kontakt från säljare av rekryteringsrelaterade tjänster.

title: Software Engineer – DevOps för inbyggd mjukvaruplattform
description:
Bygg en säker och skalbar mjukvaruplattform för nästa generations fordonsapplikationer i Göteborg.
  
Här får du vara med och bygga en säker, pålitlig och modern mjukvaruplattform för nästa generations fordonsapplikationer. Rollen passar dig som trivs nära utveckling, integration och release i en tekniskt avancerad miljö.
  
Om rollen
  
Du arbetar med en fullstackad inbyggd utvecklingsmiljö för fordonsnära mjukvara.
  
Fokus ligger på att skapa en stabil plattform för nya applikationer och funktioner.
  
Du blir en del av ett team som utvecklar högpresterande compute-lösningar i fordon.
  
  

Det här kommer du göra
  
Designa, bygga, testa och integrera mjukvara för utveckling och release.
  
Arbeta hands-on med verktyg och flöden som stödjer kontinuerlig integration.
  
Bidra till säkra, robusta och skalbara lösningar för framtida fordonsplattformar.
  
Samarbeta i ett team som utvecklar och förbättrar den tekniska plattformen löpande.
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
Gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i tekniskt komplexa miljöer.
  
Praktisk vana av Linux och utveckling i POSIX-liknande miljöer.
  
Stark kompetens i Python, C/C++ och shell scripting.
  
Förståelse för moderna CI-flöden och plattformsutveckling.
  
  

Teknik & Verktyg
  
Python
  
C/C++
  
Shell scripting
  
Linux
  
Gerrit, Bazel, Zuul, Jenkins och Docker

title: Senior Software Engineer inom Product Simulation
description:

Här får du vara med och utveckla en simuleringslösning som gör det möjligt att validera nya idéer, design och funktioner i en virtuell 3D-miljö. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta nära produktutveckling och skapa verktyg som hjälper framtida produkter att ta form.

Bakgrund från spelindustrin eller liknande utvecklingsmiljö.

Vana av att arbeta med krav i en tekniskt komplex miljö.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Vill du arbeta med data som används för att utveckla framtidens energiteknik? Nu söker vi en Data Engineer till ett svenskt teknikbolag inom solcellsbranschen, där forskning, produktutveckling och avancerad produktion sker under samma tak. Här får du arbeta med data från bland annat maskiner, produktionssystem och tekniska processer och blir en del av en tvärfunktionell miljö där data engineering samverkar med mjukvara, mekatronik, produktion och forskning.
  
Om rollen
  
Som Data Engineer arbetar du med att samla in, strukturera och tillgängliggöra data från olika delar av verksamheten. Det kan handla om data från produktion och maskiner, men också från forskning och andra tekniska system.
  
En central del av rollen är att bygga och vidareutveckla datapipelines samt arbeta med SQL, datamodellering och datakvalitet. Du kommer även att skapa dashboards och rapporter som gör data mer tillgänglig och användbar för olika delar av organisationen. I den befintliga datamiljön används bland annat ELK-stacken, Knowi och PostgreSQL.
  
Eftersom forskning, utveckling och produktion finns nära varandra får du arbeta nära både datan och de tekniska processer som genererar den. Du samarbetar med kollegor inom bland annat mjukvara, mekatronik, vision, produktion och forskning. I rollen får du självständigt ansvar för avgränsade datapipelines, datamodeller och dashboards, samtidigt som du utvecklas tillsammans med mer erfarna kollegor.
  
ArbetsuppgifterBygga, underhålla och förbättra datapipelines för olika typer av teknisk data
  
Transformera rådata till strukturerade och användbara dataset
  
Arbeta med SQL, datamodellering och datatransformering
  
Skapa och underhålla dashboards och rapporter
  
Arbeta med Elasticsearch, Logstash och andra delar av ELK-stacken
  
Felsöka dataflöden och problem kopplade till datakvalitet
  
Bidra till bättre struktur och tillförlitlighet i befintliga dataflöden
  
Vi söker dig somHar relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis data, IT, teknik eller motsvarande område
  
Har erfarenhet av SQL, databaser och arbete med datapipelines eller datatransformering
  
Har erfarenhet av Python eller motsvarande scriptspråk
  
Har arbetat med dashboards, rapportering eller datavisualisering
  
Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift då språket används i det dagliga arbetet
  
  

Meriterande erfarenheter
  
ELK-stacken, exempelvis Elasticsearch eller Logstash
  
Knowi eller andra BI- och dashboardverktyg
  
PostgreSQL
  
Data från produktion, maskiner, sensorer eller andra tekniska system
  
  

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som gärna sätter dig in i hur både data och tekniska system hänger ihop. Du arbetar strukturerat och metodiskt när du löser problem och tar ansvar för att det du bygger fungerar för dem som ska använda det. Samtidigt uppskattar du att samarbeta med andra ingenjörer och tekniska kompetenser och bidrar gärna med idéer kring hur dataflöden och arbetssätt kan förbättras.En bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.
  
**Övrig informationOmfattning:** Heltid
  
**Start:** Så snart som möjligt med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid
  
**Placering:** Stockholm
  
**Rekryteringsansvarig:** Hedvig Svärd, Hedvig.svard@Friday.se
  
**Lön:** Fast månadslön
  
  

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval och annonsen kan stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt.
  
Om FridayPå Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
  
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering där alla ges samma möjlighet att lyckas.
  
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Software Engineer within Automotive
description:
Want to build automotive software where correctness, timing, and safety matter? Join technically demanding projects in ADAS, electrification, and connected vehicles.
  
You will develop embedded software for systems with complex interactions and strict requirements for performance, reliability, and functional safety. The work is hands-on, with opportunities to influence architecture, design decisions, and technical direction.
  
  

**Depending on the assignment, you may:**  

develop safety-critical embedded software in C and C++
  
  

work close to the operating system using RTOS, Linux, or QNX
  
  

debug and optimize systems with critical timing and resource constraints
  
  

collaborate with systems engineers, testers, and hardware teams to ensure end-to-end functionality
  
  

contribute to software architecture, technical decisions, testing, and quality assurance
  
  

Many assignments involve AUTOSAR and ASPICE, where traceability, testing, and structured quality processes are integral to development.
  
  

**To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:**  

several years of experience in embedded software development or automotive software
  
  

solid knowledge of C and C++
  
  

a strong understanding of embedded systems and low-level behavior
  
  

experience working with RTOS, Linux, QNX, or a similar environment
  
  

the ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across software, systems, testing, and hardware disciplines
  
  

Preferred qualifications
  
Experience with AUTOSAR, ASPICE, automotive communication protocols, or tools from Vector is valuable. Knowledge of Rust is also a plus.
  
Fluency in Swedish is beneficial for some assignments.
  
What can you expect from us?
  
You will work on technically challenging assignments that allow you to deepen your expertise, influence technical direction, and continue growing as an engineer. Rather than working alone in customer projects, you will have opportunities to join teams with experienced colleagues in embedded and automotive systems.
  
A close local team provides day-to-day support and knowledge sharing, while Knowit’s broader network connects you with expertise across technologies and industries.
  
Application
  
Let’s start a conversation. We would be happy to tell you more about our projects, how we work, and what you would like to take on next.
  
About Knowit
  
Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.
  
Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.
  
We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.
  
We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Embedded Software Engineer – styrsystem
description:
Utveckla mjukvara och funktioner för avancerade styrsystem i en tekniskt stark miljö med helhetsansvar från krav till verifiering.
  
Här får du arbeta med utveckling av mjukvara och funktioner för avancerade styrsystem i en tekniskt komplex fordonsmiljö. Rollen passar dig som vill ta helhetsansvar och bidra i hela kedjan från krav till verifiering och uppföljning.
  
Om rollen
  
Du blir en del av ett erfaret team som utvecklar elektrohydrauliska styrsystem.
  
Arbetet spänner över krav, design, utveckling, test och release.
  
Du arbetar nära både mjukvaru-, mekatronik- och verifieringsingenjörer.
  
Rollen innebär även arbete med funktionell säkerhet och cybersäkerhet.

Specificera krav och bryta ned logik till genomförbar design.
  
Testa, felsöka och trimma funktioner i fordonssystem.
  
Bidra till förbättringar och ta ansvar för din del av leveransen.
  
Samarbeta med globala utvecklingsteam och leverantörer.
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom mekatronik, reglerteknik, elektronik eller liknande.
  
Minst 8 års relevant erfarenhet av inbyggda realtidssystem.
  
Stark programmeringsförmåga och god förståelse för embedded utveckling.
  
Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt i tal och skrift.
  
Intresse för fordonsindustrin och styrsystem.

title: Samordnare till Digitaliseringsavdelningen, Region Norrbotten
description:
**Samordnare till Digitaliseringsavdelningen, Region Norrbotten**
=================================================================


**Uppdaterad:** 2026-08-20, 08:10
Brinner du för digitalisering och vill göra skillnad för Norrbottens invånare och vårdens medarbetare? Som samordnare inom verksamhetsområde Digitala vårdstöd och invånartjänster får du en viktig roll i att införa och förvalta lösningar som exempelvis 1177:s tjänster och Min vård Norrbotten. Tjänsterna gör det möjligt för invånare att kommunicera med vården och utbyta information med interna vårdsystem, såsom Cosmic.
  

Tillsammans med verksamheten och andra kompetenser bidrar du till en tillgänglig och framtidsinriktad vård.


**Vi söker**
------------


Vi söker dig som har relevant högskole-/universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis hälso- och sjukvård, digitalisering, informatik eller annan bakgrund som bedöms likvärdig. Du har god förståelse för hur digitala verktyg kan stödja invånare, patienter och medarbetare i vårdens processer.


Det är meriterande om du har kunskap i invånartjänster eller liknande digitala vårdsystem som exempelvis Cosmic. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller har arbetat med en eller flera nedanstående:


* Utvecklingsarbete med digitala lösningar.


* Förvaltningsarbete inom IT eller vårdverksamhetssystem.


* Utbildning, metodstöd, förändringsledning, införande eller support inom hälso- och sjukvård.


* Förvaltning av rutiner, informationssidor, formulär, program eller behörighetsstrukturer.


* Arbete med releaser, test, avvikelsehantering, förbättringsförslag eller kvalitetssäkring.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Du är initiativtagande, självgående och tar ansvar för din uppgift. Du är även strukturerad och planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett effektivt sätt samt värderar och ser nyttan av samarbete med andra.

  


**Det här får du arbeta med**
------------------------------

Som Samordnare kommer du att arbeta med förvaltning och införande av digitala lösningar, med tyngdpunkt på invånartjänster, som möter verksamhetens behov och bidrar till nytta för invånare, patienter och medarbetare. Du samarbetar med andra förvaltningsobjekt, verksamhetsrepresentanter, tekniska kompetenser inom Digitaliseringsavdelningen och i vissa fall leverantörer. Du bidrar också med helhetssyn inom dina områden i förhållande till avdelningens övriga uppdrag.


Rollen innebär ett verksamhetsnära arbete där du bidrar till att samordna och användningen av invånartjänster och digitala vårdstöd. Arbetet omfattar både förvaltning och införande av lösningar samt att vara ett sakkunnigt stöd i samverkan med verksamhet, Digitaliseringsavdelningen (informationsteknik och medicinteknik) och andra berörda aktörer.


Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:


* Fungera som resurs i förvaltning, referensgrupper och nätverk inom digital vård och invånartjänster.
* Ta fram underlag till regionövergripande rutiner och arbetssätt för digitala lösningar.

title: Junior Management Consultants to Financial Services Consulting - August 2027
description:
Are you an aspiring Management Consultant eager to work with strategically important transformation projects for top-tier clients in the financial services sector? Join us at KPMG Financial Services Consulting, we are growing rapidly and offer great career opportunities!
  
  

Financial Services Consulting
  
  

Financial Services Consulting is part of KPMG’s broader Transformation and Risk Consulting area, bringing together more than 140 colleagues across complementary transformation, risk, and advisory capabilities. The Financial Services Consulting unit consists of approximately 90 professionals focused on the financial services sector, including banks, insurers, wealth managers, and associated companies. You will join a global organization and work across a variety of areas with competent and inspiring colleagues. Our Management Consultants — change agents, business developers, and subject-matter experts — are guided by agile, delivery-focused, and inclusive ways of working. Together with our clients, we help change the financial services sector for the better.
  
  

We provide transformational capabilities in complex and strategic areas within Finance, Risk & Regulatory, Operations, and Technology, as well as in sector-specific domains such as Payments and Claims. We support our clients in change initiatives covering system and regulatory implementations, sustainability, AI, integrations and separations, cost reductions, and efficiency improvements, as well as project and program management. We challenge, develop, and elevate our clients to deliver long-lasting value. Regardless of the objective — digitalization, profitability, sustainability, compliance, or innovation — we are the transformation partner for financial services.
  
  

Our team is primarily based in Stockholm, Göteborg, and Malmö.
  
  

What do we offer?
  
  

From day one, you will be supported by structured learning, hands-on client work, and experienced colleagues who will help you grow as a consultant. Together with other KPMG colleagues you will be working on exciting client engagements, and you will get a mentor as well as a dedicated performance manager supporting you in your career.
  
  

During your first years at KPMG, you will be a part of our advisory-wide learning and development program. In the program, you will acquire knowledge about all business sectors, industry trends, and KPMG’s key clients. You will learn about our tools, methods, and gain deep knowledge about our capabilities and delivery models.
  
  

Work with great people
  
Julia Blomqvist
  
Deal Advisory
  
**"The 3 best things about working at KPMG are:** The people: Ambitious colleagues who become friends. Responsibility: Significant from day one, fostering growth. Development: Constantly improving in a supportive environment."
  
Oscar Allgulander
  
Capital Markes
  
"What I value most at KPMG is working alongside highly competent colleagues, being continuously challenged in my assignments, and experiencing a steep learning curve that drives my professional development"
  
Skills & Requirements
  
  

We are looking for high performing and talented team players who are recent or soon to be graduates. More specifically, we want you to have:
  
  

Preferably a master’s degree in business, IT, engineering, law, or a comparable field. We also welcome candidates with other relevant educational backgrounds or equivalent experience
  
A strong business and digital mindset
  
Excellent communication skills
  
Multilingual proficiency (fluency in English is required, Swedish is an advantage)
  
Analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities
  
Excellent academic results
  
Genuine interest in the financial services sector
  
Collaborative mindset and ability to thrive in teams
  
We also value international experiences, prior work experiences as well as other engagements and achievements indicating personal drive, ambition, and passion
  
  

We look forward to welcoming new colleagues. We offer great fun, a steep learning curve, and the opportunity to work closely with senior colleagues and clients on critical business challenges.
  
  

Join us
  
  

Apply online as soon as possible, but no later than the 30th of September. Please only attach your CV, cover letter and university grade transcripts. Please note that in compliance with personal data management regulation (GDPR), we are unable to accept CVs via email. Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship.
  
  

As a first step of the recruitment process, we use capacity and personality tests to increase the objectivity of the selection process. You will receive the tests by e-mail in connection with your application and we will not process your application until the tests have been completed. If you move on to the next step in the recruitment process, you will be invited to an Assessment Day at our office in Stockholm. The Assessment Day will be in the middle of October 2026.
  
  

Based on mutual agreement successful candidates will be based in Stockholm and start in August 2027.
  
  

If you have any questions, please contact our recruiter Amanda Engberg, amanda.engberg@kpmg.se
  
  

We look forward to receiving your application!
  
  

About the company
  
  

At KPMG, we know that if we use and act on our insights together with the right people, we find opportunities everywhere. With 2000 employees in Sweden, Latvia and Lithuania, and a network of more than 265 000 experts in 143 countries across the globe, we are one of the world’s leading professional services firms.
  
  

We offer expertise within advisory, audit and tax and legal services to many of our region’s leading companies. We may support their organizational change, provide advice regarding risk and compliance, ESG reporting or development journeys, cyber threats, technology transformation, or finance strategy optimization. We also have experts within analysis, M&A and transactions, audit, tax and legal.
