title: HPE Networking Services Account Manager
description:
HPE Networking Services Account Manager  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**Job Family Definition:**


Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.

**HPE Networking Services Account Manager** is responsible for driving growth of HPE Networking services within assigned accounts or territory, with a focus on new business, renewals, attach, upsell, and expansion of service contract value. The role works with end-user customers, partners, account teams, and internal stakeholders to position services as an integral part of the customer’s networking strategy.


The position requires a solid understanding of the services value proposition and how customers assign services contracts. Knowledge of marketing campaigns to align initiatives with account planning activities is also required. The Services Account Manager develops consultative customer proposals, tailoring strategy and solutions to meet the needs of the customer. They understand the customer’s business challenges /objectives to provide value added services and solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develops long-term sales pipeline to increase the company's market share in specialized area.
* Integrates with the local product sales team and internal stakeholders. Ensuring services always being represented.
* Uses specialty expertise to seek out new opportunities for customer value by expanding and enhancing existing opportunities to build the pipeline in and drive pursuit in specialty area.
* Sets direction for business development and solution replication.
* Creates and grows reference customers.
* Sells complex products or solutions to customers on a partnership basis.
* In addition to driving new business, manages and expands renewal opportunities within the assigned focus area by analyzing the installed base, identifying expiring service contracts, mitigating renewal risks, and driving upsell and contract expansion to increase renewal contract value.
* Maintains accurate pipeline, CRM hygiene, and forecast discipline for assigned services opportunities and renewals.
* Establishes a professional, working, and consultative, relationship with the client, including the C-level for mid-to-large accounts by developing a core understanding of the unique business needs of the client within their industry.
* Maintains and uses overall cross-portfolio knowledge to support account leads with integration of solutions.
* Contributes to enduring executive relationships that establish the company's consultative professionalism and promote its total solution capabilities.
* Maintains expertise on IT at all levels - new applications, maintenance, typical budgets of the CIOs, typical objectives, measures, metrics.
* Maintains broad market and competitor knowledge to ensure credibility with Customer Executives.


***Education and Experience Required:***

* University or Bachelor's degree; Advanced University or MBA preferred.
* Directly related previous work experience in services and/or networking is a plus.
* Demonstrated achievement of progressively higher quota diversity of business customer, and higher-level customer interface.
* Prior selling experience includes multiple, diverse set of selling responsibilities.
* Viewed as expert in given field by company and customer.
* Considered a mentor of selling strategy, including designing strategy.
* Typically 7+ years of related sales experience.
* Project management and analytical skills required.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Fluency in Swedish and English will be required; knowledge of Finnish language will be considered a plus
* Understands networking architectures and services frameworks.
* Know strengths and weaknesses of key competitors in account and how to leverage this knowledge in the account.
* Uses expertise specialty, consultative solution selling and business development skills to align the client's business needs with solution.
* In-depth knowledge of client's business, organizational structure, business processes and financial structure.
* Considerable knowledge of the customer's infrastructure and architecture.
* Demonstrates leadership and initiative in successfully driving services sales in accounts - prospecting, negotiating and closing deals.
* Demonstrates leadership and initiative in successfully driving full portfolio including software (subscriptions) and services needed for the customer's requirements.
* Strategic planning on a business development level; can build an effective business case reflecting the value of an appropriate strategy.
* Uses C-level engagement skills in collaboration with account leads to offer value-add solutions to the client.
* Excellent project oversight and analytical skills.
* Works with the account team to build an effective account plan and strategy to drive incremental revenue in the account.
* Successful partner engagement experience. Works effectively with our partners to drive additional revenue.
* Understands and sells high value software (subscriptions) solutions.
* Demonstrates the ability to leverage the company's portfolio of products and services to change the playing field against our competition.
* Understands the leverage of services as part of strategic portfolio of products.
* Promotes services as part of all strategic opportunities.
* Maintains knowledge of industry trends, associated solutions, and key partner/ISV solutions.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.


**Job:**


Sales**Job Level:**


Master

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, or any other protected category, and all decisions we make are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Our goal is to be one global team that is representative of our customers, in an inclusive environment where we can continue to innovate and grow together. Please click here: Equal Employment Opportunity.

**Hewlett Packard Enterprise is EEO Protected Veteran/ Individual with Disabilities.**

  



HPE will comply with all applicable laws related to employer use of arrest and conviction records, including laws requiring employers to consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories.

  



**Recruitment Fraud Alert**


We have become aware of an increase in fraudulent recruitment activities in which individuals impersonate our company or authorized recruitment agencies to offer fake employment opportunities. These scams may occur through false websites, emails, social media, or chat-based applications and often aim to obtain personal information or money. Please note that Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), its direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliated companies, and its authorized recruitment agencies/vendors will never charge a candidate a registration fee, hiring fee, or any other fee in connection with its recruitment and hiring process. We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.


All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. Any reliance on fraudulent communication is at the individual’s own risk, and HPE disclaims legal liability for any resulting damages. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.

title: Engineering Manager – Tech ITS Distribution & Investments
description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI, automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future-proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?  

  

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who is passionate about building winning teams and driving innovation through modern technologies such as agentic AI, cloud-native solutions, and automation. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, both through your leadership and the solutions your team delivers.



**About the role**  

As an Engineering Manager, you will be part of Technology Investment & Trading Solutions (ITS), helping drive the next generation of savings, investment, and trading solutions at SEB. You will lead a team within Tech ITS Distribution & Investments, combining leadership, technology, and business understanding. Working in a fast-moving environment where customer value, innovation, quality, and operational excellence are key to our success, you will contribute to delivering scalable, end-to-end investment services for our customers.



You will:



* Build new high-quality services that bring great customer value
* Be part of something new that aims to become the best
* Work with great people in an organization where technology, business services, and the business operate as one to build the best services for our clients
* Be part of transforming our ways of working towards spec-driven development and agentic AI
* Drive the technical agenda and roadmap in close collaboration with the Tech Lead and Product Owner
* Coach and develop engineers, strengthening both technical excellence and team performance
* Work closely with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between solutions and client needs
You are expected to:



* Build strong teams
* Develop the team and its people
* Drive the adoption of new technologies
* Identify opportunities where modern technologies create business value
* Encourage experimentation, curiosity, and learning in the team
* Lead the evolution of ways of working, tools, and engineering practices
You report to the Department Manager and are an active member of the management team.



**Who you are**



You are an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical background and a passion for building high-performing teams. You combine people leadership with a deep understanding of modern software development and know how to empower individuals and teams to grow, perform, and deliver results.



**We believe you have:**



* Several years of people leadership experience, with a coaching and empowering leadership style
* A strong technical foundation from roles such as Tech Lead, Lead Engineer, or similar
* Deep understanding of modern software development practices and engineering excellence
* Have hands-on experience in advanced agentic engineering, spec-driven development, and how to build AI cases that makes a significant difference in terms of saving time or cost
* A curiosity-driven mindset and the ability to lead and drive change in a fast-moving environment
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Experience leading the transition to AI-first and agentic engineering practices is considered a strong merit. We place significant value on leaders who have successfully driven both the technical and cultural change required to adopt AI at scale, building new capabilities, ways of working, and mindsets across engineering teams.
**Why this role matter**  

This is an opportunity to combine leadership, technology, and transformation in a business-critical area at SEB. You will play a key role in driving the adoption of modern engineering practices, AI, and automation, while building a strong team and helping shape the future of savings, investment, and trading solutions.



**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



We encourage you to submit your application no later than 3rd of September via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linn Odén at linn.oden@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.  


Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.



SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.



Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.



sebgroup.com/career



bit.ly/SEBcareer



.

title: Store Manager till 3Butiken Gränby
description:
Vi står nu redo att välkomna nästa ledare till 3Butiken Gränby. 3Butikerna är en av Tres viktigaste kanaler när det kommer till att skapa nöjda och lojala kunder. I den här rollen får du möjlighet att jobba med coaching och teamutveckling, driva försäljning och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra.
  
  

En dag som Store Manager
  
  

Jag heter Alexander och är affärsområdesansvarig för våra 3Butiker. Som din närmsta chef ser jag fram emot att jobba tillsammans med dig! En dag i 3Butik är händelserik och varierad, och jag vill gärna ge dig en inblick i hur det kan se ut.
  
  

Dagen börjar med att du och teamet säkerställer att butiken är inbjudande och redo att välkomna kunder. Du sätter upp försäljningsmål, planerar dagen och håller dig uppdaterad om de senaste produktlanseringarna och kampanjerna. Kanske har du senare ett möte med mig, för att gå igenom resultat och fokusområden eller ett utvecklingssamtal med en medarbetare. Snart är det dags att möta dagens första kund och tillsammans med teamet skapa en förstklassig upplevelse.
  
  

Mer om rollen
  
  

Som Store Manager är du en närvarande och operativ ledare med fullt ansvar för både personal och butikens dagliga drift. Du leder genom att vara på plats i butiken, coachar teamet i kundmötet och visar riktningen genom att själv möta och sälja till våra kunder. Rollen innebär ett tydligt mandat och ett stort eget ansvar, där du skapar trygghet och närvaro för både medarbetare och kunder, även under helger. Du är en del av ett starkt butikskluster med nära till fysiskt stöd, vilket ger dig goda förutsättningar att lyckas. Ersättningen är direkt kopplad till både din egen försäljning och butikens prestation.
  
  

Vi erbjuder dig
  
  

Att vara en del av en fantastisk företagskultur, med ett stort nätverk och nära kontakt till hela vår säljorganisation.
  
Tre är en arbetsplats där individuell utveckling och intern rörlighet är ett av våra stora fokusområden. Med hjälp av drivna medarbetare, engagerade ledare och våra interna utbildningar ger vi dig förutsättningar att växa på Tre.
  
En möjlighet att vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan.
  
Att vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser där vi sätter våra medarbetare i fokus samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar.
  
Några av våra medarbetare
  
Julia Maxén
  
Gruppchef
  
"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."
  
Henrik Sundvall
  
Digital projektledare
  
"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"
  
Jayasri Battola
  
Utvecklare
  
"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."
  
  

Mer om dig
  
  

Om vi får gissa är du någon som har erfarenhet av att arbeta inom service och försäljning. Kanske besitter du en ledande roll idag, eller så är du en informell ledare och är redo för ditt nästa kliv i karriären. Oavsett så tror vi att du drivs av att ta ansvar, påverka och skapa framgång tillsammans med ditt team.
  
  

Som person har du en naturlig förmåga att bygga relationer och inspirera din omgivning. Med ditt driv och din struktur håller du alltid kursen mot målet, samtidigt som du ser till att vägen dit är både effektiv och utvecklande, för både dig själv och andra. Du älskar att lösa problem, hitta möjligheter och göra det där lilla extra som gör skillnad. I en snabbföränderlig miljö trivs du som bäst, där tempot är högt och resultaten tydliga. Att nå mål är en självklarhet för dig, men du vet också att framgång skapas tillsammans.
  
  

Välkommen med din ansökan
  
  

Låter det här som något för dig? Vad glada vi blir!
  
  

Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar CV och svarar på några frågor i samband med att du söker. Vi tror på din potential och dina förmågor, och för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv urvalsprocess använder vi tester som en del av vår bedömning. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.
  
  

Vi har riktigt bra förmåner
  
  

Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
  
  

Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
  
  

Hundzon & gym i 3huset
  
  

Subventionerad lunch
  
  

Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
  
  

Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
  
  

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.
  
  

Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.

title: Store Manager till 3Butiken Uppsala City
description:
Vi står nu redo att välkomna nästa ledare till 3Butiken Uppsala City. 3Butikerna är en av Tres viktigaste kanaler när det kommer till att skapa nöjda och lojala kunder. I den här rollen får du möjlighet att jobba med coaching och teamutveckling, driva försäljning och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra.
  
  

En dag som Store Manager
  
  

Jag heter Alexander och är affärsområdesansvarig för våra 3Butiker. Som din närmsta chef ser jag fram emot att jobba tillsammans med dig! En dag i 3Butik är händelserik och varierad, och jag vill gärna ge dig en inblick i hur det kan se ut.
  
  

Dagen börjar med att du och teamet säkerställer att butiken är inbjudande och redo att välkomna kunder. Du sätter upp försäljningsmål, planerar dagen och håller dig uppdaterad om de senaste produktlanseringarna och kampanjerna. Kanske har du senare ett möte med mig, för att gå igenom resultat och fokusområden eller ett utvecklingssamtal med en medarbetare. Snart är det dags att möta dagens första kund och tillsammans med teamet skapa en förstklassig upplevelse.
  
  

Mer om rollen
  
  

Som Store Manager är du en närvarande och operativ ledare med fullt ansvar för både personal och butikens dagliga drift. Du leder genom att vara på plats i butiken, coachar teamet i kundmötet och visar riktningen genom att själv möta och sälja till våra kunder. Rollen innebär ett tydligt mandat och ett stort eget ansvar, där du skapar trygghet och närvaro för både medarbetare och kunder, även under helger. Du är en del av ett starkt butikskluster med nära till fysiskt stöd, vilket ger dig goda förutsättningar att lyckas. Ersättningen är direkt kopplad till både din egen försäljning och butikens prestation.
  
  

Vi erbjuder dig
  
  

Att vara en del av en fantastisk företagskultur, med ett stort nätverk och nära kontakt till hela vår säljorganisation.
  
Tre är en arbetsplats där individuell utveckling och intern rörlighet är ett av våra stora fokusområden. Med hjälp av drivna medarbetare, engagerade ledare och våra interna utbildningar ger vi dig förutsättningar att växa på Tre.
  
En möjlighet att vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan.
  
Att vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser där vi sätter våra medarbetare i fokus samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar.
  
Några av våra medarbetare
  
Julia Maxén
  
Gruppchef
  
"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."
  
Henrik Sundvall
  
Digital projektledare
  
"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"
  
Jayasri Battola
  
Utvecklare
  
"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."
  
  

Mer om dig
  
  

Om vi får gissa är du någon som har erfarenhet av att arbeta inom service och försäljning. Kanske besitter du en ledande roll idag, eller så är du en informell ledare och är redo för ditt nästa kliv i karriären. Oavsett så tror vi att du drivs av att ta ansvar, påverka och skapa framgång tillsammans med ditt team.
  
  

Som person har du en naturlig förmåga att bygga relationer och inspirera din omgivning. Med ditt driv och din struktur håller du alltid kursen mot målet, samtidigt som du ser till att vägen dit är både effektiv och utvecklande, för både dig själv och andra. Du älskar att lösa problem, hitta möjligheter och göra det där lilla extra som gör skillnad. I en snabbföränderlig miljö trivs du som bäst, där tempot är högt och resultaten tydliga. Att nå mål är en självklarhet för dig, men du vet också att framgång skapas tillsammans.
  
  

Välkommen med din ansökan
  
  

Låter det här som något för dig? Vad glada vi blir!
  
  

Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar CV och svarar på några frågor i samband med att du söker. Vi tror på din potential och dina förmågor, och för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv urvalsprocess använder vi tester som en del av vår bedömning. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.
  
  

Vi har riktigt bra förmåner
  
  

Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
  
  

Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
  
  

Hundzon & gym i 3huset
  
  

Subventionerad lunch
  
  

Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
  
  

Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
  
  

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.
  
  

Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.

title: Vice President, R&D
description:
*You'll own the technology direction for the platforms our 200+ utility customers run their business on. You'll lead managers, not just individual contributors, through a shift to AI-powered development. And you'll do it with real ownership from day one. This is your next move as Vice President, R&D at EG.*

 **As Part of the department**  

Leading R&D for the Software Utility Companies Run On Zynergy and Xellent are EG's core software platforms for Utility, relied on by more than 200 customers across the Nordics every day. As Vice President, R&D, you'll lead the shift toward AI and automated development, and set the technology strategy that keeps both platforms reliable as electrification, flexibility markets and new regulation reshape the sector.


You'll lead an international R&D organisation of around 120 people across Denmark, Sweden, Poland and India, with 5 direct reports. You'll report to Bjarki Björnsson, Senior Vice President for Utility, and join the Utility management team. The role is based in Stockholm.

 **Your Role: Own the Technology Direction, End to End**  

*Real ownership of an international development organisation, a genuine AI agenda with direct customer impact, and a platform for your next move in EG's leadership team.*


The R&D organisation is yours to lead. You own development strategy, architecture, delivery and quality across the Utility portfolio, working closely with Product Management, Customer Support and Professional Services. You'll also set the AI agenda for Utility and share practice with R&D leaders across EG.  

**Key responsibilities:**

* **International development organisation —** lead and grow a distributed team across the Nordics and Mangalore, building one culture with strong local leadership and a deliberate onshore/offshore balance.
* **AI in our products and how we build them —** set the AI agenda for Utility end to end, and raise engineering productivity through AI-assisted development, automated testing and modern tooling.
* **Technology and architecture —** own the target architecture and modernisation roadmap for Zynergy and Xellent, balancing new capability, technical debt and long product lifecycles.
* **Delivery, quality and commercial ownership —** own release predictability and compliance and manage the R&D budget with a commercial mindset.
* **Talent and customer proximity —** attract, develop and retain leaders, and stay close to our 200+ customers to turn their reality into clear priorities.

**Your Profile: Technical Depth, Commercial Judgement, Real Leadership**  

Strategic thinking comes naturally, paired with the willingness to stay close to the technology, the teams and the customers. Transformation motivates you, and you know how to lead change across cultures, locations and time zones. The big picture stays in view, without losing focus on what matters most. Structure, development standards and continuous improvement matter to you, and you work closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success and Sales — sharing practice with R&D leaders across EG along the way.


Your background can vary, but to thrive in this role, you:

* Have proven experience leading R&D or engineering organisations at scale in an international software or SaaS company, including distributed teams.
* Bring strong technology judgement across cloud, data, architecture and the modernisation of established products.
* Have a practical, hands-on view of AI in a product context — from data foundation and governance to what turns into real customer value in production.
* Have a performance mindset grounded in evidence, with strong execution and a bias for action.
* Build trust as a leader, develop other leaders, and sustain motivation through change.
* Are curious, ambitious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant master's degree in engineering, computer science or similar.

**What's in it for You?**  

At EG, you will be trusted to set direction, drive change and take responsibility from day one. As part of our leadership team, you will have the mandate to influence strategy and build high-performing teams, in a collaborative, international culture where ambition goes hand in hand with trust and personal growth.

* **Meaningful impact —** lead teams that solve real challenges and build software that makes a difference in society and business.
* **Real ownership —** take responsibility from day one, with the freedom to shape your role, influence strategy and drive change.
* **Continuous growth —** find the space, support and opportunities to grow and take on new challenges.
* **Collaborative culture —** join a global, ambitious leadership team rooted in Nordic values, where collaboration and trust help us succeed together.
* **AI at the frontier —** put AI to work across our products and how we build them, with direct visibility into what it means for more than 200 customers.

**Our Values:**

* **Lead the Industry** — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* **Make it Happen** — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* **Stronger Together** — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**  

If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Bjarki Björnsson, SVP Utility, on +45 20 69 95 85. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially. Please submit your application through our recruitment system using the Apply button.

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**  

Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.


Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.


Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.


Curious what it's really like to work at EG?


Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
description:
Help Shape the Future of Enterprise Trusted AI
Artificial Intelligence is transforming the way the world's leading organisations operate. But as AI adoption accelerates, so does the need for trust, security and governance.


That's where our client comes in.


Backed by leading venture capital investors, they're building the trust and decision layer that enables enterprises to deploy AI securely, confidently and at scale.


Operating at the intersection of AI, identity and data governance, they're creating an entirely new category of enterprise technology.


This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious, high-growth business and help shape the future of enterprise AI. Already attracting major corporate customers, trusted system integrators and resellers, this is a role created to support the next phase of growth in Europe. The right candidate will be joining at a time to support direction, key initiatives and strategic growth in the UK and EU.


This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise and exceptional, human-centred soft skills.


The Opportunity
We're looking for an experienced Enterprise Sales Engineer to join our client's team in a hybrid role based within commuting distance of London.


You'll become a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers to help them understand why data trust is the foundational layer every enterprise AI deployment needs and how our client's platform enables secure, context-aware and authorised access to enterprise data for AI applications.


Working closely with Sales, Customer Success and Partner teams, you'll combine deep technical expertise with exceptional communication skills to guide organisations through every stage of the customer journey—from discovery and demonstrations through to proof of concept, deployment and adoption.


If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing enterprise buying decisions and working with cutting-edge AI technologies, we'd love to hear from you.

 **Requirements**  

  

Key Responsibilities* Partner with Account Executives to drive strategic customer opportunities.
* Deliver compelling technical demonstrations, workshops, solution presentations and Proofs of Concept (PoCs).
* Act as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Support customers during deployment and ensure successful platform adoption.
* Build lasting, strong relationships with enterprise customers, partners and system integrators.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and executive audiences.
* Collaborate across Sales, Product and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience.


What We're Looking ForMust Have's* 10–15 years' experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or Technical Pre-Sales within enterprise software.
* Strong expertise in graph database technologies, including hands-on experience with Neo4j and the Cypher query language.
* Demonstrated understanding of IaC principles and the core Terraform workflow (init, plan, apply), with the ability to maintain and update existing configurations.
* Comfortable implementing and maintaining data flows between systems using REST APIs for request-response actions and Apache Kafka / Confluent for message-based data movement.
* Experience with technologies such as Python, JavaScript, React, and Go.
* Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), in particular OAuth 2.0 and AuthZEN, cybersecurity, cloud technologies or enterprise software.
* Excellent presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A consultative, customer-first approach with the ability to influence technical and business decision-makers.
* A genuine passion for solving complex technical challenges and helping customers unlock the value of AI securely.
* Ability to travel largely within the UK and EU, with occasional global travel.


What We Offer
This is an opportunity to be part of something genuinely exciting.


You'll join a talented team that's defining a new market and solving one of the biggest challenges facing enterprise AI today.

* **£120,000 base | £200,000 OTE**
* Equity participation in a high-growth, venture-backed company.
* Remote-first culture with a collaborative and mission-driven team.
* The opportunity to define and build a new market category from the ground up.

title: SAP Technical Architect
description:
Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and modernize complex SAP landscapes that support critical business processes across finance, supply chain, procurement, human capital, analytics, and enterprise operations. We work with clients moving from legacy ERP environments to SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, and hybrid architectures where cloud, integration, data, security, and extensibility must work together as one coherent enterprise platform.


Our technology work is not limited to system implementation. We help clients make architectural choices that shape the long-term scalability, resilience, security, and performance of their SAP environments. This includes defining SAP landscape strategies, integration architectures, extension approaches, cloud operating models, governance principles, and technical foundations for innovation using SAP Business Technology Platform, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Signavio, and emerging SAP Business AI capabilities such as Joule.


You will join a growing SAP community across Sweden, the Nordics, and Deloitte’s global SAP network, working closely with functional consultants, developers, enterprise architects, client IT teams, and business stakeholders to deliver complex transformation programs with confidence and quality.


**Role overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Technical Architect to join Deloitte’s SAP team in Stockholm.


In this role, you will take a leading role in shaping the technical architecture for SAP transformation programs. You will work across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, SAP Business Technology Platform, integration platforms, cloud infrastructure, security, performance, extensibility, and technical delivery governance. Your role will be to ensure that the SAP solution is not only functionally strong, but technically robust, scalable, secure, and aligned with the client’s enterprise architecture.


You should bring deep SAP technical experience, a strong understanding of modern cloud and integration patterns, and the ability to translate business and solution requirements into practical architecture decisions. We are especially interested in candidates who can combine hands-on technical credibility with senior stakeholder communication, delivery leadership, and the ability to guide clients through complex technology choices.


**Responsibilities**

As an SAP Technical Architect, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live activities.


* Lead SAP technical and application development workstreams across the solution lifecycle, including design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities
* Advise client technology and business stakeholders on SAP-enabled transformation priorities, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform, custom development, extensibility, and enterprise integration
* Oversee technical design and delivery across SAP development and integration components, including ABAP, application programming interfaces, middleware, OData services, Core Data Services views, and connected enterprise applications
* Define and apply technical architecture standards, development methods, and quality controls to support scalable, maintainable, and secure SAP solutions
* Lead integrated delivery teams and collaborate with functional, data, security, infrastructure, and business teams to drive execution, resolve issues, and align technical solutions to business process transformation objectives
* Contribute to practice development through proposal support mentoring and recruiting support.
**Qualifications**
------------------

We are looking for candidates with strong experience from SAP technical roles and complex SAP transformation or implementation programs. You have hands-on experience in areas such as SAP architecture, development, integration, Basis, security, cloud, or technical delivery, and you have played a leading technical role in at least one major SAP S/4HANA program.


You bring a solid understanding of non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, resilience, security, compliance, maintainability, and operational readiness, and you can translate these into clear architecture principles, technical standards, and delivery guardrails.


You are comfortable working with enterprise architects, client IT organizations, infrastructure teams, security teams, functional consultants, developers, testers, and project leadership. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly, support pragmatic decision-making, and maintain long-term architecture quality. Strong Swedish language skills are important for local client work, combined with professional English skills for Nordic and global collaboration.


**Desired personal skills**

In this role, you will thrive if you enjoy working at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. You are someone who can understand a client’s strategic objectives, recognize the technical implications, and shape an architecture that is both ambitious and realistic. You are confident in senior client conversations, comfortable facilitating technical design discussions, and able to explain complex architecture topics in a way that creates clarity for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You bring a structured, quality-oriented delivery style and take ownership of the technical integrity of the solution. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, reducing unnecessary complexity, and guiding teams toward designs that are secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable. At the same time, you understand that architecture must enable delivery, not slow it down, and you are able to balance long-term principles with practical project realities.


You actively seek to bring new thinking into your work while maintaining strong judgement about what is mature, relevant, and valuable for clients. Just as importantly, you collaborate generously, support the development of colleagues, and contribute to a team culture built on inclusion, diversity, integrity, and high professional standards.


**Additional Information**
--------------------------

At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We offer a range of on-the-job learning experiences, formal development programs at Deloitte University, and access to a personal coach to support you in identifying and utilizing your strengths. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.


Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.


**How to Apply**

You apply online. Your application should consist of:


* CV
* Letter of motivation
	+ Why you are interested in Deloitte and the role as a consultant
	+ What you think you can contribute with and bring to the role

**Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we work with ongoing selection.**

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success.


*As a qualitative part of Deloitte’s recruitment process, our final candidates undergo a background check, to increase awareness of our future employees, secure the working environment for our employees and meet regulatory requirements. The background check process is carried out in collaboration with ToFindOut.* *https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/*

**Questions?**

If you have any questions regarding the role or the application process, please contact Anna Taube, Manager Talent Acquisition, at ataube@deloitte.se .


**We are looking forward to your application!**

For further information on Deloitte, please visit www.deloitte.se


**What impact will you make?**

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Umbraco Web Application Manager / Application Management Team
description:
We are looking for an experienced supplier or team with strong knowledge of Umbraco Cloud and web application management for a long-term remote assignment.
  
**Assignment period:** Immediate – 30 September 2027
  
**Possible extension:** Until 30 September 2030
  
**Extent:** 100%
  
**Location:** Remote
  
About the assignment
  
The assignment involves the ongoing management, maintenance and support of an external website built on Umbraco Cloud.
  
The responsibility includes ensuring that the web solution remains stable, secure and well maintained, as well as supporting continuous improvements and further development.
  
  

**The work will cover:**  

Application management and technical support
  
Maintenance and troubleshooting of the web solution
  
Security and stability management
  
Further development and improvements
  
Development, testing and deployment
  
Work across Development, Staging and Production environments
  
Coordination of application management activities
  
  

The website is hosted on Umbraco Cloud, with Microsoft Azure as the underlying cloud infrastructure. Management of the underlying cloud/operating environment is not included in this assignment.
  
Required experience
  
  

**We are looking for a supplier/team with:**  

Strong experience with Umbraco CMS / Umbraco Cloud
  
Experience in web application management
  
Experience with website maintenance and further development
  
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure environments
  
Experience with development, testing and deployment processes
  
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  
Experience providing ongoing application support
  
  

Language requirement
  
The Project Manager and other members of the application management team must be able to communicate effectively in Swedish, both verbally and in writing.
  
This is a long-term assignment suitable for an experienced Umbraco specialist, application management team or IT service provider.
  
Interested candidates or suppliers are welcome to submit their CV/profile and relevant experience to careers@i-raysolutions.com.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
At Alleima, data is a strategic asset and a key enabler for business performance, digitalization, and future innovation. We are building an Alleima Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric that will become a central foundation for trusted, scalable, and business-driven data across the company. When fully implemented, the platform will support analytics, reporting, and decision-making across key domains including Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and Sustainability.
  
This is an opportunity to take a central role in defining and evolving a platform that connects business needs, architecture principles, and hands-on technical realization. As our Lead Data Platform Architect, you will help shape how Alleima works with modern data architecture, reusable data products, and scalable analytics capabilities.
  
Data and AI are among the fastest-moving fields out there. What’s considered best practice today can become legacy tomorrow. Alleima works in a modern, fast-paced way, and we see AI as essential to working efficiently. We’re looking for someone who wants to keep pace with developments in an evolving technology landscape.
  
**Placement:** Flexible within Sweden.
  
About the role
  
As Lead Data Platform Architect, you will define, lead, and realize the technical architecture for Alleima’s Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric. Working in close partnership with the Platform Owner, you will drive the end-to-end architecture and collaborate with domain data engineers, BI teams, enterprise architects, and solution teams.
  
You work both strategically and operationally, from defining target architecture, standards, and reusable patterns to supporting solution design, technical reviews, and complex design decisions in practice. The role also includes guiding platform evolution, enabling strong engineering practices, and ensuring that the Common Data Platform supports cross-functional analytics and decision-making across the company.
  
The platform journey is already underway, giving you the opportunity to influence its next phase and help turn emerging solutions into robust, reusable capabilities across Alleima.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

* Own the end-to-end architecture for the Common Data Platform, from source integration and ingestion to transformation, storage, semantic modelling, visualization, and analytics, and define the target architecture, reference patterns, and engineering standards that guide its evolution.
* Lead the design and implementation of scalable data solutions in Microsoft Fabric, using capabilities such as lakehouse and medallion patterns, notebooks, data pipelines, and semantic models.
* Enable domain data engineers and BI teams to build high-quality solutions by supporting the design and optimization of ETL/ELT pipelines, reusable information models, and analytics capabilities using SQL, Python/PySpark, and related technologies.
* Establish strong engineering and governance practices across the platform, including CI/CD, Git-based development, deployment, metadata, lineage, cataloging, and documentation, ensuring solutions are secure, standardized, reusable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and coach data engineers, BI developers, and solution teams, sharing best practices and helping teams make sound architectural and technical decisions while building strong capabilities across the organization.
* Explore and evaluate new developments in Microsoft Fabric, AI-assisted engineering, and the broader data ecosystem, bringing relevant capabilities into the platform where they create real value.


About you
  
We believe you hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. You bring solid, hands-on experience from data platforms, analytics, data engineering, and architecture roles, and you are comfortable working across both strategic and hands-on responsibilities.
  
You likely have a background as a Data Architect, Solution Architect, Lead Data Engineer, or similar. What matters more than years in the role is technical depth combined with real curiosity. You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. What matters most is deep experience in modern cloud data platforms and a strong understanding of data architecture and engineering.
  
You have strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks, Power BI and semantic models, Azure data platform services, and modern data engineering practices using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  
You are familiar with ETL/ELT design, orchestration, CI/CD, Git-based development, integration patterns, and secure enterprise data platform design. Experience with Purview, Entra ID, Dataverse/D365 integrations, and Azure integration or cloud architecture patterns is considered a plus.
  
We see AI-assisted development tools, such as Copilot and LLM-based assistants, as a natural part of modern engineering. You actively use these tools in your work today and are interested in continuing to explore how they can strengthen engineering practices and create value.
  
As a person, you are driven, curious, and collaborative, with the ability to coach others, challenge your own thinking, and keep learning as the field moves — you’re energized by staying at the front of it, not by having already arrived. You are fluent in English, and Swedish is a plus. For this position, you need to be based in Sweden.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Use your marketing skills to support mission-driven organisations enhance and showcase their impact, while helping strengthen our core brand.**


As Marketing Executive, you will help tell the stories of Purposeful Ventures’ incubations and partner organisations, as well as our own. Working closely with the Senior Communications Manager, the Philanthropy and Communications team, and colleagues across some of our incubations and partner organisations, you will develop clear, audience-focused marketing that helps mission-driven organisations connect with the people who matter most and strengthens the Purposeful Ventures brand.


A distinctive part of this exciting new role is the opportunity to support our incubations as they are being set up. From helping develop visual identity assets to supporting with social media content, you will help our incubations put the foundations of its brand and marketing in place – working with their founders and teams to do so. If you enjoy variety, collaboration and turning ideas into compelling stories, you'll thrive in this role.


We welcome a keenness to work with start-up teams and with a non-profit focused on improving young people’s lives from their earliest years.

**Please download the** **full job description** **on the Purposeful Ventures website**

**Job Description**


This role sits within Purposeful Ventures’ core team, and provides marketing and brand support to both our core team and wider incubations.

**Responsibilities and duties**

**Digital marketing and owned channels**

* Manage routine updates to Purposeful’s current website, ensuring content is accurate, up to date and aligned with our tone of voice
* Support the Senior Communications Manager with the development of Purposeful’s new website including gathering content from internal teams, creating or adapting visual assets, CMS content
* Work alongside the Senior Communications Manager to create and design engaging LinkedIn content that reflects Purposeful’s brand and engages our priority audiences, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders if required
* Support the Senior Communications Manager with populating Purposeful’s LinkedIn content calendar, including updating our annual activity calendar
* Prepare regular engagement analysis, using LinkedIn Analytics and other relevant analytics tools, across Purposeful’s owned channels supporting the Senior Communications Manager to identify trends and opportunities to improve content performance

**Content and brand assets**

* Design and adapt defined collateral for presentations and external communications, including case studies, testimonials, annual reports, impact reports and templates, ensuring materials are clear, accurate, up to date and aligned with Purposeful’s tone
* Create and adapt defined compelling visual content to illustrate Purposeful’s work and impact to internal and external audiences (such as video, photography, graphics, data illustration)

**Bespoke marketing support for incubations and partner organisations**

* Work with the Senior Communications Manager and wider team to produce defined marketing materials for new incubations, based on each incubation’s set-up strategy. Typical outputs may include launching social media profiles, creating visual identity assets, brand guidelines, microsite or website design/build, supporting creating key messaging documents, creating tone of voice/glossary guidance, designing marketing assets, drafting social media content plans and marketing plans
* Work with the Comms team and our Ventures colleagues to deliver or support defined marketing projects for our existing incubations and parter organisations, building on the types of outputs above

**Who we are looking for**

**Key requirements**

* Passionate about creating a fairer society where all young people thrive
* Demonstrable track record of taking ownership of commitments and working hard to succeed.
* A strong design eye and experience using design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud or similar software) to create clear marketing assets
* Working knowledge of a range of website skills, platforms (e.g. Wix, Squarespace), content management systems, basic web design principles, user experience and user journeys
* Experience working from defined marketing briefs, understanding scope of work requirements: executing a brief, delivering agreed outputs for a specific audience at pace, on time and within a limited budget
* Knowledge of relevant social media tactics and experience supporting the set-up of social media profiles, or creating and managing content across social media platforms with an understanding of audience and channel specific nuances – particularly on LinkedIn
* Experience using analytics tools, such as Google Analytics and LinkedIn Analytics, to monitor engagement, evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement across website and social media channels.
* Ability to liaise with stakeholders beyond your immediate team, which may include experience with clients, social entrepreneurs, start-up leaders, customers or external stakeholders including working to a brief, managing feedback and delivering agreed outputs
* Right to work in the UK


Desirable

* Experience supporting internal communications across one or more channels, formats or outputs
* Experience supporting B2B or B2C event planning (such as conferences, exhibitions, public or internal events, speaker presentations, receptions, webinars or fundraising events)
* Experience working with freelancers or marketing agencies, including supporting drafting briefs, commissioning processes, project check-ins, recording minutes/actions
* Awareness of how AI tools can support content creation, design and editing, with judgement about when human review, accuracy checks and brand oversight are needed
* Charity or start-up experience is not essential. We are looking for someone who brings initiative, curiosity and transferable marketing skills, and can produce relevant, meaningful assets and outputs that add value to a project.

description:

Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. * Establish best practices for data privacy, model governance, autonomous agents and human-in-the-loop validation to ensure internal AI solutions are secure and reliable.

### **We expect you to:**

 Experience designing and developing ETL/data pipelines.
   

  

 Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for Databricks and related cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data discoverability.
   

  

 Experience designing scalable, robust, and secure data platform solutions.
   

  

 AWS and/or Databricks certifications are considered a strong advantage.
   

  

  

  

 Experience & Skills
   

  

 Several years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, Platform Engineer, or in a similar senior data engineering role.
   

  

 Proven hands-on experience working with Databricks in production environments.
   

  

 Experience designing, developing, and maintaining medium- to large-scale data platforms.
   

  

 Strong understanding of data platform architecture and modern data engineering practices.
   

  

 Experience implementing governance capabilities within complex data environments.
   

  

 Ability to independently drive technical improvements and solve complex platform and data challenges.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

 Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
   

  

 Ability to translate requirements into scalable and production-ready technical solutions.
   

  

  

  

 Who You Are
   

 You are a senior and self-driven Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Databricks and modern data platform development. You combine deep technical knowledge with a structured and pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
   

  

 You are comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions and driving improvements independently while collaborating closely with developers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and business stakeholders. You understand the importance of governance, data quality, security, and maintainability and have the ability to balance these requirements with the need to deliver scalable and valuable data products.
   

  

  

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Full-time assignment (100%).
   

  

 On-site work required five days per week in Södertälje.
   

  

 Remote work is not part of the normal assignment setup.
   

  

 Any exception to the on-site requirement must be agreed in advance with the Hiring Manager.

title: Senior IT Analyst
description:
**Job ID: 5605**
 Would you like to work in an international team of IT professionals with a long experience in enterprise file transfer services and business processes? We are now looking for a Senior IT Analyst to manage and develop our B2B integration platform, working closely with other IT teams and business stakeholders.
   

  

 At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with the financial solutions of tomorrow. We’re creating an agile environment where we’re harnessing the power of technology – one where you can make an impact. So bring your skills, ideas and unique background. With us, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to grow and make your mark on something bigger.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We’re not just a bank; we’re a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Welcome to the E-Bridge team. We add value by providing file transfer services for our corporate customers and internal partners. As a Senior IT Analyst, you’ll play a valuable role in providing high quality, business critical and reliable service.
   

  

 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
* Operate, maintain and improve our primary B2B integration platform.
* Continuously improve monitoring of the technical platform as well as data flows.
* Capacity and performance management.
* Automate manual operations.
* Handle incidents and participate in problem investigations.
* Act as the 3rd line support and the escalation point to the vendor.
* Work closely with our developers adopting DevOps practices.
* Onboarding of new B2B partners or internal systems, doing technical assessments


**To succeed in this role, we believe that you are:**
* Self-driven, communicative, team player with good understanding of critical enterprise environments and importance of operational stability
* Able to stay calm, focused and work rational under pressure


**Your experience and background:**
* Experience with SEEBURGER Business Integration Suite.
* Technical knowledge and experience of communication and file transfer protocols: SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS.
* Knowledge of digital certificates and file/message integrity.
* Linux and container skills.
* Scripting and automation skills e.g. bash, Python, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools skills e.g. Splunk, Grafana.
* Good understanding of distributed systems.
* Understanding of databases and basic SQL skills.
* Experience of B2B integration.


**Additional skills that would be an advantage:**
* Experience with Splunk, AppDynamics, Jira, Confluence, Git/Bitbucket, Bamboo.
* Knowledge about file messages/filetypes used in banking sector.
* Knowledge about additional protocols:  SWIFT, MQ.
* Knowledge about webservices.


 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 25/08/2026. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Darko Delinac, darko.delinac@nordea.com and Ritu Mittal (ritu.mittal@consult.nordea.com) for HR related matters.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
   

  

 We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

 We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

 We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

 We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think."
   

  

 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Territory Systems Engineer, Commercial, (Nordics)
description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

 As a Territory Systems Engineer, you will be the trusted technical partner to the Territory Account Executive and our valued Channel Partners. Your role is critical in translating Pure’s vision and innovative solutions into tangible, value-driven technical proposals for a broad and dynamic set of customers. You will play a pivotal part in accelerating growth by ensuring our partners and customers have the technical resources, validation, and support needed to successfully adopt Pure Storage solutions.
   

  

 At Pure, you'll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your technical and sales career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Territory Systems Engineer is a core technical role responsible for driving sales and technical adoption across our key commercial accounts in the Nordics. This position is for an experienced engineer who brings technical proficiency and a consultative approach to pre-sales. You will act as the technical authority within your territory, empowering partners to scale and delivering complex technical solutions with independence. You’ll be the bridge between customer business challenges and Pure’s technical vision, driving high-impact sales outcomes without the need for day-to-day oversight. This position requires a blend of technical acumen, partnership enablement, and a proactive approach to supporting high-volume, transactional sales motions. You will partner closely with the Territory Account Executive to lead technical sales campaigns, driving new business and expansion opportunities from discovery to closure. This Territory Systems Engineer role is a strategic position where you will immediately leverage your existing technical expertise and channel knowledge to drive high-volume, transactional sales motions.
   

  

 You won't be in this alone. You'll be joining a highly collaborative Nordics Systems Engineering team known for sharing knowledge and celebrating successes together. Your contributions will be immediately recognized and valued. We believe business happens between people, so you will act as a trusted advisor, leading high-stakes customer meetings across the Nordic region.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like: You will succeed by becoming the go-to technical partner in your territory. Success is defined by your ability to collaboratively drive deals to closure and your reputation as the advisor customers trust to solve their toughest infrastructure challenges.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Serve as the Technical Sales Lead: Partner directly with the Territory Account Executive to drive technical sales campaigns, manage complex discovery, present solutions, and secure deal wins.
* Drive Partner Collaboration and Enablement: While you will enable partner Systems Engineers to scale, you will also work side-by-side with them and the Territory Account Executive to execute on joint business opportunities and win competitive deals.
* Lead with Presence: You will manage technical relationships face-to-face across the Nordic region. This role involves travel (typically 2–3 days/week), which you and your Territory Account Executive will collaboratively schedule to maximize impact, meet customer needs, and win deals.
* Facilitate Technical Validation: Review and validate sizing, quotes, and technical architectures for various solutions, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs and product capabilities.
* Drive Tool & Resource Adoption: Increase awareness and usage of Pure's sales and technical tools across the partner ecosystem, ensuring they are leveraged effectively at the appropriate stages of the sales cycle.
* Support Collaborative Growth: Build and maintain strong, productive relationships with both the Territory Account Executive and Channel Partners to ensure seamless technical support, shared goal achievement, and ultimately, closed deals.


**What You'll Bring**
* Proven Technical Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in a customer-facing or pre-sales technical role (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, Infrastructure Consultant) within the IT infrastructure market. A track record of independently managing technical sales cycles and solving complex customer requirements is essential.
* Domain Expertise: Significant expertise (5+ years) with data storage, virtualization, or modern cloud infrastructure. You should possess the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and design solutions that go beyond standard configurations.
* Relationship-First Approach: Comfortable leading customer meetings and building deep, long-term technical relationships in person. You are eager to be on the road to ensure we maintain high-touch engagement across our territory.
* Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated success working closely with a sales counterpart (like a Territory Account Executive) and channel partners to achieve shared business and technical objectives.
* Autonomy and Deal Ownership: A high degree of self-motivation and initiative with a proven ability to independently manage technical sales cycles, apply complex technical concepts effectively, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong Communication & Coaching Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical value to diverse audiences, from partner Systems Engineers to business decision-makers. Fluency in both Swedish and English is required.
* Organizational Resilience: Excellent organizational and time management skills necessary to juggle multiple partner engagements, technical validations, and training support activities in a dynamic territory.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**
