title: Domänarkitekt Infrastruktur IT
description:
**Sista ansökningsdatum: 2 oktober** 




 Som nyckelaktör i Sveriges energiomställning växer Svenska kraftnäts IT-division för att möjliggöra en fördubblad elproduktion och en fossilfri framtid. Med den senaste tekniken ökar vi både infrastrukturens kapacitet och utvecklingstakten inom digitalisering och processer. För att fortsätta den här resan framåt söker vi en erfaren Domänarkitekt till Infrastruktur IT.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Här blir du en del av IT-arkitekturenheten som består av 15 personer. Enhetens ansvarsområde är att tillhandahålla en övergripande målbild för Svenska kraftnäts IT-arkitektur.
 



 Som
 **Domänarkitekt Infrastruktur IT** 
 får du en nyckelroll i utvecklingen och moderniseringen av Svenska kraftnäts framtida IT-infrastruktur, både on-prem och i molnet. Du leder arbetet med att ta fram och etablera en stabil målarkitektur och färdplaner samt säkerställer att lösningarna följer myndighetens strategiska riktning, standarder och höga säkerhetskrav.
 



 Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med lösningsarkitekter och teknikområdesansvariga, där du i ditt arbete bidrar till att skapa en modern, standardiserad och robust infrastruktur för en samhällskritisk verksamhet. Samtidigt som du är del i den egna enheten arbetar du tvärfunktionellt och har en given plats i arkitekturrådet, där du bidrar till den övergripande arkitekturella utvecklingen. Rollen innebär att balansera innovation med mycket höga krav på säkerhet, robusthet och regulatorisk efterlevnad i en komplex och samhällskritisk miljö.
 



  





**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:** 



* Leda och driva framtagandet av målarkitekturer för Svenska kraftnäts IT-infrastruktur, både on-prem och i publika molnmiljöer
* Agera senior teknisk rådgivare och ledningsstöd genom att förankra målbilder på hög nivå, ge beslutsunderlag till chefer och säkerställa rätt strategiska vägval och prioriteringar
* Säkerställa att IT-lösningar designas i enlighet med våra målarkitekturer och standarder
* Driva standardisering av våra IT-infrastrukturtjänster för att underlätta arbetet i våra utvecklingsprojekt och IT-förvaltningar
* Delta i olika samarbetsgrupper för coachning och granskning av lösningar, arkitekturstyrning, utveckling av arkitekturramverk etc.
* Beskriva och kommunicera arkitekturen till aktuella målgrupper
* Ansvara för framtagning av målbilder och färdplaner
* Stödja portföljstyrningen och framtagandet av utvecklingsplaner inom förvaltningsorganisationen
* Inom domänen leda och coacha lösningsarkitekter och teknikspecialister i projekt och IT-drift
* Hålla dig uppdaterad genom omvärldsbevakning inom ditt område



 Här erbjuds stora möjligheter att påverka Svenska kraftnäts framtida IT-landskap.
 



  





**Om dig** 




**Skallkrav:** 




 Vi söker dig som är samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta tvärfunktionellt för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar naturligt en ledande roll, skapar engagemang och driver arbetet framåt genom att få med dig och motivera andra. Du är van vid att kommunicera på alla nivåer, är inlyssnande samtidigt som du kan hantera motstånd och utmaningar utan att avvika från beslutade styrningar och inriktningar. Du är analytisk och kan förstå komplexa sammanhang och omsätta insikter i väl underbyggda ställningstaganden. Vidare är du resultatorienterad och driver arbetet framåt med tydligt fokus på vad som behöver uppnås.
 



 Du ska också leva upp till
 **den statliga värdegrunden.** 
 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
 



 Du har en högskole-/universitetsutbildning inom ett relevant tekniskt område alternativt gedigen bakgrund inom IT-arkitektur och IT-infrastruktur förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
 



 Du har även:
 


* Minst 8 års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta som IT-infrastrukturarkitekt i enlighet med etablerade arkitekturmetoder, verktyg och processer
* Minst 2 års aktuell erfarenhet av att agera domänarkitekt eller lead architect för infrastruktur
* Flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av tekniskt arbete inom IT-infrastruktur, såsom applikationsplattformar, middleware, nätverk, lagring eller operativsystem – med djup kompetens inom minst ett område
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram och förankra målarkitekturer inom infrastrukturområdet
* Erfarenhet av hybrid‑ eller molnarkitektur (t.ex. IaaS/PaaS‑tjänster)
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en stor och komplex IT-organisation
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska



  





**Meriterande** 



* Certifiering inom IT-arkitektur (t.ex. CITA, TOGAF eller Dataföreningens arkitektcert)
* Certifiering inom annat relevant infrastrukturområde (såsom CISSP, PKI, IAM, Azure, VMware, Cisco, Red Hat, Windows Server eller liknande)
* Erfarenhet av arbete med IT-säkerhet inom en samhällskritisk verksamhet alternativt verksamhet med mycket höga säkerhetskrav
* Erfarenhet av IAM
* Erfarenhet av att driva transformation mot DevOps‑principer, automatisering av infrastruktur genom skriptning, Infrastructure as Code och/eller modern platform engineering-praktik



  





**Bra att veta** 



* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter #LI-hybrid
* Resor kan förekomma i denna tjänst
* Sista ansökningsdag 2026-10-02, vi använder urvalsfrågor istället för personligt brev. Vänligen bifoga ditt CV skrivet på svenska som tydligt beskriver den erfarenhet som vi söker.
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, provanställning kan komma att tillämpas
* **Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät**



  





**Intresserad av att ansöka eller få veta mer?** 




 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Computer Sweden Recruitment. Vid frågor kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Johanna Nordberg, 070 3343159,
 **johanna.nordberg@csrecruitment.se** 
 alternativt ansvarig rekryterare hos Svenska kraftnät Maria Sahlén, 072-459 85 27,
 **maria.sahlen2@svk.se** 
 .
 



 Fackliga representanter:
 


* Annika Ingeborn, facklig representant SACO, 010 475 87 72
* Erica Midfjäll, facklig representant ST, 010 475 87 31



 Du når oss också via e-post:
 **Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se** 




 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare i samband med rekrytering, vi har upphandlade avtal som gäller för Svenska kraftnät som statlig myndighet.
 



  





**Om Svenska kraftnät** 




 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretess-medvetenhet. Inför anställning genomförs säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) vilket innefattar grundutredning och om anställningen avser befattning i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövningen även att innefatta en registerkontroll. För anställning på Svenska kraftnät kan det vara ett krav på svenskt medborgarskap i vissa befattningar. Med anställningen följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. För mer information om personalsäkerhet på svenska kraftnät.
 **https://www.svk.se/sakerhet-och-beredskap/sakerhetsskydd/personalsakerhet**

title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 Business Relationship Manager
 



**Experience:** 
 10+ years of relevant industry experience
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Type:** 
 Full-time | Permanent position
 



  





**Tata consultancy Services** 
 is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses for the past 50 years. We believe innovation and collective knowledge can transform all our futures with greater purpose. We help companies across industries achieve their strategic goals and lead their digital transformation programs. With 600,000 experts globally and 18,000+ consultants working for leading Nordic Customers, we have a strong sense of purpose for the ecosystem around us – our employees, partners, customers and society.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Are you passionate about building trusted client relationships and turning business challenges into meaningful growth opportunities?
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Business Relationship Manager** 
 to help develop and grow our strategic relationship witho our client. This is an opportunity to work closely with senior decision-makers within a leading global industrial and electrical engineering organization, while shaping solutions across engineering, manufacturing, IoT, supply chain, product lifecycle management and sustainability.
 



  





 You will be part of TCS’s IoT and Digital Engineering Service Line and play a central role in strengthening the client partnership, creating new business opportunities and ensuring that our services continue to deliver measurable value.
 



  





 The role combines strategic account development, consultative sales and relationship management. You will collaborate with delivery, solution and sales teams to shape propositions that respond to the client’s evolving priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Build and strengthen trusted, long-term relationships with senior client executives, business leaders, IT stakeholders and procurement teams.
* Grow TCS’s engineering, manufacturing and IoT services within the account, including manufacturing transformation, edge-to-cloud IoT platforms and product lifecycle services.
* Identify and develop new opportunities through account mining, consultative conversations and a strong understanding of the client’s business.
* Shape value propositions, proposals and business cases together with technical, delivery and sales teams.
* Manage the opportunity pipeline and support sales cycles from early engagement through to successful closure.
* Monitor account performance, lead business reviews and help ensure a consistently positive client experience.
* Represent TCS in client engagements and relevant industry forums, contributing to thought leadership and increased market visibility.



  





**About you** 




 You are a relationship-driven business leader who combines commercial awareness with a genuine interest in technology, engineering and industrial transformation.
 



  





 You are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and can translate complex client challenges into clear business opportunities. You know how to bring different teams together around a shared objective and create momentum in complex sales environments.
 



  





 Most importantly, you approach clients with curiosity, credibility and a consultative mindset. You focus on building partnerships that create long-term value rather than short-term transactions.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least five years in business development, consultative sales or strategic account growth.
* Strong experience within the industrial, electrical engineering or manufacturing sector.
* Proven experience developing senior client relationships and growing business within the European market.
* Experience positioning technology or engineering services and shaping proposals, value propositions, business cases or complex commercial solutions.
* The ability to understand customer and market needs and collaborate with solution teams to develop relevant offerings.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, business administration or another relevant discipline.
* Fluent in
 **Swedish and**

title: Field Marketing Manager – Sweden & Norway
description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

**Marketing that moves the business forward.**
 Cybersecurity is changing at extraordinary speed. AI is transforming how businesses operate - and how cyber threats evolve. At Check Point Software, we are at the forefront of this transformation, helping organizations secure their networks, cloud, data, users and AI-driven environments.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Field Marketing Manager for Sweden & Norway** 
 to help us accelerate growth in these two markets. This is much more than a campaign execution role. We are looking for someone who wants to
 **own a market, make things happen and see the direct impact of their work on the business.**
**The Opportunity**
 As Field Marketing Manager, you will be the driving force behind our local marketing strategy in Sweden and Norway.
   

  

 Working closely with Sales, Channel, Corporate Marketing and strategic partners, you will turn business priorities into impactful marketing programs - from account-based marketing and demand generation to C-level events, partner initiatives and digital campaigns.
   

  

 You will have the autonomy to shape the local agenda, test new ideas, identify opportunities and continuously improve what we do. From the initial idea to execution, follow-up and measurement, you will take ownership of your programs and ensure they deliver real business impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the Sweden & Norway marketing strategy, aligned with sales priorities and business objectives.
* Develop and execute integrated field marketing programs from A to Z, including ABM, demand generation, C-level engagement, executive roundtables, seminars, webinars and other high-impact activities.
* Work hand-in-hand with Sales to create engagement and build a healthy marketing-generated pipeline.
* Develop strategic partner marketing programs with system integrators, technology partners and other key players in the ecosystem.
* Bring global campaigns to life locally, adapting messaging and activation to the Swedish and Norwegian markets.
* Drive digital activities across e-mail, social media, paid campaigns and other relevant channels.
* Create compelling experiences for senior decision-makers and cybersecurity leaders.
* Manage local marketing budgets and make smart investment decisions based on business impact and ROI.
* Measure campaign performance, pipeline contribution and conversion -and use the insights to continuously improve.
* Coordinate agencies, vendors and internal stakeholders to deliver outstanding execution.
* Keep your finger on the pulse of the market and proactively identify new opportunities for Check Point to engage customers and partners.
* Take ownership of projects beyond your immediate scope when needed and contribute to the success of the wider Northern Europe marketing organization.


**Qualifications**
**Who You Are**
 You're an experienced B2B marketer who combines
 **strategic thinking with a strong bias for action** 
 . You are someone who
 **goes the extra mile because you care about the outcome** 
 , not simply because it's on your task list.
   

  

**You Are**
* Proactive and entrepreneurial - you naturally take initiative and look for ways to create more impact.
* Highly accountable - when you own something, you own it from start to finish.
* Sales oriented - you understand that great marketing ultimately needs to contribute to business growth.
* Hands-on - you're equally comfortable defining the strategy and making sure the last detail of an event is right.
* Organized and resilient - you can manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment without losing sight of what matters.
* Collaborative - you know how to build strong relationships with Sales, partners and colleagues across the organization.
* Challenging status-quo - you're always looking for a better way to do things.
* A team player who steps up - someone your colleagues can rely on when things get busy and who is happy to take ownership when the wider team needs support.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5–7+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally within B2B technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or another complex technology environment.
* Strong experience in field marketing, demand generation and/or ABM.
* Proven ability to work closely with Sales and translate business objectives into effective marketing programs.
* Experience with channel and partner marketing.
* Strong project management and execution skills.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce and Marketo. Zuddl or similar event platforms are a plus.
* Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Fluent Swedish and English. Norwegian is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel occasionally, approximately 15%.

title: IT Client Services Lead
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

 The
 **IT Client Services Lead** 
 is responsible for delivering reliable site IT support for the Solna office while acting as a senior technical resource for local users, regional IT colleagues, and cross-functional business stakeholders. This role uses in-depth client services and infrastructure knowledge to resolve complex issues, improve local IT service performance, and support consistent adoption of global IT standards across the site.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor Professional P3 role. The role may provide informal guidance to colleagues and may lead small site or service improvement projects, but it does not carry people-management accountability.
   

  

 This position reports to the
 *IT Director, Client Services (EMEA/APAC)* 
 and is part of the
 *IT EMEA/APAC Site Support and Applications,* 
 located in
 *Solna, Sweden* 
 and will be an on-site role.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Partner in IT Client Services Leadership for the Solna manufacturing site and serve as a key contributor across EMEA and APAC, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable workplace technology services that support business operations, manufacturing continuity, and an exceptional end-user experience.
* Drive cross-functional and cross-regional collaboration across EMEA and APAC, coordinating global IT teams, vendors, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application owners, and manufacturing stakeholders to successfully deliver technology initiatives, standardization efforts, and service improvements.
* Lead technology lifecycle management for manufacturing and workplace environments, including endpoint strategy, asset management, refresh planning, capacity management, and business continuity preparedness to minimize operational risk and disruption
* Lead through influence, expertise, developing technical capability across the Client Services organization, promoting best practices, and serving as a trusted escalation point for complex technical and operational challenges
* Provide technical leadership across end-user computing, industrial endpoint technologies, collaboration platforms, AV systems, telecom, support cloud services, and manufacturing-adjacent technologies, ensuring high availability and rapid resolution of complex issues impacting business-critical operations.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field with 5+ years of related IT client services, site support, infrastructure, or end-user technology experience; or Master’s degree in a related field with 3+ years of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* In-depth practical experience supporting corporate end-user technology environments, including Windows endpoints, Microsoft productivity tools, mobile devices, printers, meeting room/audio-visual equipment, asset lifecycle, and enterprise support processes.
* Working knowledge of related infrastructure and service areas such as LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, cloud-enabled workplace services, identity/access processes, endpoint management, cybersecurity controls, telecom, and vendor/provider coordination.
* Proven ability to solve complex or recurring technical and service problems independently, using judgment based on multiple sources of information, established standards, business impact, and appropriate escalation paths.
* Strong stakeholder communication, prioritization, and service management skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to non-technical audiences, manage multiple priorities, document work effectively, and build consensus across local and regional teams.


- 

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**
* Traveling might be required 10%.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* ITIL, Microsoft, networking, endpoint management, cloud, or cybersecurity certifications or equivalent practical training.
* Help Desk or site support coordination activities in a regulated, manufacturing, diagnostics, life sciences, healthcare, or corporate environment.
* Using service management, asset management, knowledge management, or continuous improvement practices to improve user experience and operational performance


 Cepheid, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
   

  

 We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
   

  

 Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Working at Mercell** 




 At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.
 



 With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.
 



 Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.
 



  





**Your Mission** 




 As a Customer Success Manager at Mercell, you'll own a portfolio of supplier customers across Europe with a focus on the Swedish market, the businesses who rely on our platform to discover, access, and win public tenders. Your mission is to make sure they get real, measurable value from Mercell every single day.
 



 That means building genuine relationships and becoming a trusted partner your customers turn to; spotting the early signals of churn and acting before it happens; and uncovering the moments where customers are ready to grow, so you can open the door to new opportunities. Above all, you'll be the person who ensures every customer in your portfolio realises the full potential of what Mercell can do for them helping them win more, work smarter, and see us as essential to their success.
 



 If you're energised by ownership, thrive on building lasting relationships, and love turning satisfied customers into genuine advocates, this is a role where you'll see the impact of your work directly in retention, in growth, and in the success of the customers you champion.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 



* Own and resolve defined categories of customer issues raised via HubSpot, Jira, or similar systems (e.g. onboarding, billing questions, contract terms, access issues, product transitions).
* Assess, prioritize, and resolve cases efficiently and consistently based on established processes.
* Ensure cases are handled according to approved playbooks, policies, and best practices.
* Deliver low-touch, structured customer engagement through standardized responses, templates, and automated touchpoints.
* Guide customers to relevant self-service resources, documentation, and training materials to encourage independence and adoption.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Experience (ideally 2-3 years) in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, Operations, or another client-facing SaaS role.
* Strong ability to build deep knowledge within defined functional or product areas.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely.
* Experience working with ticketing systems, CRM tools, and digital workflows.
* Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with clear processes and SLAs.
* Fluent in English and Swedish; additional Nordic or European languages are a plus.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Strong communication skills with the ability to build trust and engage effectively with customers and internal stakeholders
* Highly disciplined and structured, able to manage priorities, follow through consistently, and work with strong attention to detail
* Analytical and solution-oriented mindset, able to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities quickly
* Flexible and adaptable, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
* Customer- and service-minded, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and delivering value

title: Beredskapsspecialist för IT-verksamheten
description:
Länsstyrelsen är den högsta civila totalförsvarsmyndigheten inom länet. Tillsammans med en rad andra aktörer samordnar vi det civila och militära försvaret. Här är Länsstyrelsernas IT-avdelning en kritisk aktör.
   

  

 Vårt uppdrag är att möta Sveriges 21 länsstyrelsers behov inom IT - vi på IT-avdelningen bidrar till ett demokratiskt, hållbart och säkert samhälle.
   

  

 Vi utökar nu vår verksamhet och bygger upp ytterligare kompetens och teknik för kris och beredskap. Var med och stärk Sveriges beredskap och bli en av oss på Länsstyrelsernas IT-avdelning.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
**Lockas du av att jobba med att säkerställa IT-leveransen inom civilt försvar? Har du koll på myndighetsförfattningar och erfarenhet av beredskaps- eller totalförsvarsfrågor? Är du dessutom en fena på att driva verksamhetsutvecklande projekt och gillar att förstå komplexa samband? Då kanske du är vår nya Beredskapsspecialist!**
 Som Beredskapsspecialist kommer du att tillhöra IT-avdelningens säkerhetsenhet som ansvarar för att perspektiven civilt försvar, IT-säkerhet, säkerhetsskydd, säkerhetsjuridik och kontinuitet omhändertas inom IT-verksamheten. Säkerhetsenheten agerar styrande, rådgivande och samordnande med utgångspunkt i ett helhetsperspektiv för IT-verksamheten.
   

  

 I din roll som beredskapsspecialist inom IT-verksamheten är civilt försvar ditt primära fokus.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:
   

  

* Samverka med länsstyrelserna och andra myndigheter inom totalförsvarsfrågor relaterat till IT-avdelningens uppdrag.
* Genomföra analyser, driva utredningar, tolka nya och förändrade behov, förstå påverkan på IT-leveransen, samt omsätta detta i planer för lösning och genomförande.
* Aktivt bidra till ett sammanhållet angreppssätt kring kontinuitet, kris och beredskap.
* Utveckla, utbilda och öva IT-avdelningens krigsorganisation.
* Driva på utvecklingen av ledningsstödsystem och sambandssystem.


 Ditt arbete innehåller också löpande samarbete med länsstyrelsernas gemensamma stödfunktioner och förvaltningsorganisation.
   

  

 Vår uppgift är att se till att länsstyrelsernas IT-verksamhet har rätt nivå av skydd. Det handlar både om tekniska krav och hur vi ska agera i en kris. Vi hanterar kraven på och metodstöd för IT-säkerhet, säkerhetsjuridik, teknisk säkerhet, kontinuitetsplanering, säkerhetsskydd och civilförsvarsplanering. Dessutom samverkar vi med andra myndigheter inom cybersäkerhetsområdet och totalförsvaret.
   

  

 Vi utvecklar alltid vår verksamhet och du behöver därför vara öppen för att dina arbetsuppgifter även kan komma att förändras över tid.
   

  

 Länsstyrelsernas IT-avdelning finns över hela landet. Placeringsort är Göteborg, Vänersborg, Stockholm eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi erbjuder ett flexibelt arbete med goda möjligheter till distansarbete del av arbetstiden.
   

  

 Resor inom landet förekommer.
   

  

**Om dig**
 I rollen som Beredskapsspecialist arbetar du med många olika intressenter, vi söker därför dig som har god förmåga att samarbeta med andra och skapa goda relationer med fokus på samverkan både inom och utanför din egen organisation. Du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt och kan fatta beslut inom ramen för ditt uppdrag. Du är också en person som är drivande och har en god initiativförmåga, du motiveras av att komma vidare i arbetsuppgifter och genomföra de beslut som tagits. Du har en coachande inställning och tack vare din kommunikativa förmåga och ditt pedagogiska förhållningssätt kan du nå ut med ditt budskap till olika målgrupper på ett tydligt och anpassat sätt. Vidare har du förmåga att förstå komplexa samband, skapa helhetsbilder och snabbt kunna sätta dig in i hur saker och ting hänger ihop.
   

  

 För oss är personliga egenskaper viktiga och vi ser det som självklart att du agerar utifrån Den statliga värdegrunden - Statskontoret och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.
   

  

**Du har:**
* Eftergymnasial utbildning med examen från högskola eller universitet, eller annan utbildning och erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig.
* God kunskap om författningar som styr myndigheters arbete med beredskap och civilt försvar.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med beredskaps- eller totalförsvarsfrågor.
* Erfarenhet av att jobba med myndighets- eller organisationsövergripande verksamhetsutvecklande projekt och förankring.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift.


**Vi ser gärna att du har något av följande:**
* Erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsskydd och skyddsvärd information.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom regionala eller centrala myndigheter.
* Erfarenhet av stabsarbete.
* Erfarenhet av funktionell kravställning.
* Insikt om beroenden till digitala system samt IT- och telekominfrastruktur i komplexa verksamheter med höga säkerhetskrav.


 Vi tror på allas lika möjligheter och ett av våra huvuduppdrag är att verka för mångfald och en personalsammansättning som speglar länens befolkning.
   

  

 Du söker jobbet via denna länk: Ansök här
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Läs mer om oss på vår webb Jobba på IT-avdelningen . Här finns information om våra förmåner . Vi finns också på Linkedin .
   

  

 I den här rekryteringen vill vi inte att du bifogar något personligt brev. För att berätta om dina erfarenheter och förmågor får du i din ansökan svara på ett antal frågor. Detta är för att vi ska kunna ta ställning till i vilken omfattning din kompetens och dina förutsättningar matchar vårt behov. Ansökan ska vara på svenska då det är vårt arbetsspråk.
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kommer att genomföras innan vi fattar beslut om anställning. För en del anställningar kan därför svenskt medborgarskap komma att krävas. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning Personalsäkerhet - Säkerhetspolisen (sakerhetspolisen.se) .
   

  

 Länsstyrelsen är en beredskapsmyndighet och har ett särskilt utpekat ansvar under kris och krig/höjd beredskap.
   

  

 I den här rekryteringen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Det innebär att vi kan komma att kalla till intervju även innan sista dag för ansökning har passerat.
   

  

 Anställningen kan komma att inledas med provanställning 6 månader.
   

  

 Vi har valt rekryteringskanaler och vill inte bli kontaktade av rekryteringsföretag.

title: Enhetschefer till Cybersäkerhetskontoret
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? FRA söker enhetschefer som vill bidra till skyddet av Sverige. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som enhetschef vid Cybersäkerhetskontoret hör du till avdelningen för cyberverksamhet. Kontorets uppdrag är att stärka skyddet mot kvalificerade IT-angrepp från utlandet mot Sverige samt att genomföra signalspaning mot kvalificerade cyberhotsaktörer. Genom att identifiera och följa angriparna bakom angreppen skapar vi kunskap om tillvägagångssätt och motiv. Den omsätter vi till underrättelserapporter och olika former av stöd inom teknisk cybersäkerhet till våra uppdragsgivare. På så sätt bidrar vi till att stärka Sveriges cybersäkerhet.
   

  

 Som enhetschef är du första linjens chef och är med i kontorets ledningsgrupp där ni tillsammans driver verksamhetens utveckling. Du leder en grupp av specialister och skapar förutsättningar för verksamhetens utveckling utifrån kontorets mål. Utöver det så etablerar och utvecklar du relationer med interna partner och externa uppdragsgivare.
   

  

 Rollen innebär ett övergripande personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar, inklusive arbetsledning, planering, uppföljning, ekonomi, regelverk, kompetensutveckling och rekrytering. Arbetet utförs vid FRA:s lokaler på Lovön.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Akademisk utbildning inom relevant område exempelvis it, systemvetenskap, statsvetenskap eller motsvarande erfarenheter genom arbetslivserfarenhet
* Erfarenhet av chefskap med personalansvar
* God förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Vi Ser Det Som Meriterande Om Du Har**
* Erfarenhet av underrättelse- eller cybersäkerhetsarbete
* Erfarenhet av att leda uppdrag av teknisk karaktär
* Erfarenhet av arbete med förändringsledning eller tjänsteleveranser


 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Samarbetsförmåga – Arbetar bra med andra människor. Relaterar sig till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
* Utvecklingsorienterad – Har lätt för att ta till sig och se möjligheter med nya idéer, metoder och arbetssätt. Driver och implementerar förändring.
* Ledarskap – Leder, motiverar och förser andra med befogenheter som krävs för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål. Samordnar grupper och blir en referenspunkt för andra. Skapar engagemang och delaktighet.
* Strukturerad – Planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett effektivt sätt. Sätter upp och håller tidsramar.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.
   

  

 Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.
   

  

 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att maila
 **rekrytering@fra.se** 
 . Fackliga företrädare nås på
 **010-557 46 00.**
 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se
 **senast 2026-09-13.**
 Referensnummer
 **2026FRA867-2.**
 Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
   

  

**Sökord**
*Enhetschef, cybersäkerhetsarbete, data/it, informationssäkerhet*

title: Systemförvaltare
description:
På miljö- och stadsbyggnadskontorer arbetar cirka 50 engagerade medarbetare med bred kompetens inom bland annat stadsplanering, bygglov, kartframställning, miljöfrågor, hälsoskydd, livsmedelskontroll och bostadsanpassning. I en kultur präglad av öppenhet, tillit och arbetsglädje får ditt engagemang och din kunskap möjlighet att växa – tillsammans gör vi livet och arbetslivet på Lidingö lite bättre varje dag.
   

  

 Välkommen till Lidingö stad – en citynära, grönskande ö endast 15 minuter från centrala Stockholm. Med kunskap och samarbete bygger vi broar som leder till nya möjligheter, både för livet som pågår och för det som väntar. Hos oss finns många möjligheter att utveckla dina styrkor – eller upptäcka helt nya. Med hjärtat i verksamheten, blicken mot framtiden och nyfikenheten som vägvisare gör vi tillsammans livet och arbetslivet på Lidingö lite bättre varje dag. Välkommen att bli en del av Lidingö stad – bron till framtiden.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Vi söker nu en vikarie för vår systemförvaltare som går på föräldraledighet. Som vikarierande systemförvaltare blir du en viktig samordnande kraft i det fortsatta arbetet med våra två största verksamhetssystem, Ecos och Nova.
   

  

 Du Håller Ihop Pågående Förvaltning, Stödjer Verksamheten i Vardagsnära Systemfrågor Och Bidrar Till Att Arbetet Drivs Vidare Med God Struktur, Kvalitet Och Säkerhet.Rollen Innebär Både Löpande Samordning Och Stöd i Systemförvaltningsarbetet, Medverkan i Utvecklingsfrågor Och Informationssäkerhet. Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Omfattar Att
   

  

* Systemförvalta Ecos och Nova, inklusive planering, prioritering och uppföljning av förvaltningsarbetet.
* Samordna och strukturera förvaltnings- och utvecklingsbehov tillsammans med verksamhet, IT och leverantörer.
* Driva och uppdatera systemförvaltningsplan, kontinuitetsplan, återställningsplan och plan för digitalt bevarande.
* Säkerställa att systemen och rutiner följer informationssäkerhetskrav och KLASSA.
* Säkerställa att dokumentation för lagefterlevnad, inklusive krav kopplade till NIS2, är korrekt, uppdaterad och tillgänglig.
* Sprida kunskap och stödja Superuser/koordinatorer, bland annat genom dialoger, utbildning och löpande informationsdelning.
* Leda och samordna nätverk, forum och återkommande avstämningar.
* Vara huvudkontakt mot leverantörer hålla i leverantörsträffar, uppföljningar och planerade aktiviteter.
* Medverka i införanden, uppgraderingar och projekt kopplade till systemen.


**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren systemförvaltare med god förståelse för verksamhetsnära systemförvaltning. Erfarenhet av Ecos är ett starkt meriterande, eftersom systemet utgör en central del av uppdraget. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av Nova ser vi det som meriterande.
   

  

 Du har en förmåga att arbeta strukturerat, självständigt och samordnande. Vidare har du en god förståelse för informationssäkerhet och arbete med styrdokument.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Staden tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Anställningen är ett vikariat med planerad start den 1 oktober 2026 och sträcker sig cirka 12 månader.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss är det självklart att vi lär av varandra och att vi tillsammans skapar en arbetsmiljö där alla trivs och känner sig delaktiga. Välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  

 Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Lidingö stad tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.
   

  

**About Global Blue**
 Global Blue by Shift4 is the industry leader in Tax Free Shopping solutions, simplifying the tax refund process for international travelers and driving revenue for retailers through a fully integrated commerce experience. As a business partner for the shopping journey, we seamlessly connect shoppers and brands worldwide, powering over 40 million transactions each year. For more information, please visit globalblue.com and shift4.com.
   

  

 To support and strengthen our international and dynamic IT team we are now looking for a Field Service Engineer to join our team in Helsinki/Stockholm. As a Field Service Engineer you will be focused on supporting IT systems infrastructure on our branch offices, refund offices, refunding agents and our customers who use Global Blue issuing solutions as well as Shift4 products. This includes working with payment processing platforms, point-of-sale solutions, and other Shift4 technologies to ensure seamless transactions and optimal system performance. You will work closely with the international IT team as well as country sales- and refunding teams. You will be part of a truly international working environment that supports your professional development, fosters a collaborative and supportive team culture, and provides a competitive salary and benefits package.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

 Handling deployment, support, maintenance and decommissioning of Global Blue decentralized IT systems
   

  

 Providing Level 1 support for Shift4 solutions IC2, REX, CAS, Kiosks and Terminals and handle given tasks related to all issuing solution implementations and maintenance.
   

  

 Providing support for Shift4 payment products, including POS/payment terminals, the Shift4 payment gateway and other payment processing hardware and software, as this support scope expands.
   

  

 Ensuring IMACD (Installation, Move, Add, Change, and Disposal) of decentralized IT hard- and software within agreed SLA terms.
   

  

 Assisting the incident resolution process at locations with on-site staff.
   

  

 Accepting, coordinating and prioritizing all “customer” requests assigned in ticketing systems.
   

  

 Ensuring correct and timely ticket handling (initiate, track, update and close tickets).
   

  

 Ensuring diagnostic, classification and fault Isolation of incidents and assess priority and severity.
   

  

 Coordinating incident resolution across 2nd and 3rd level.
   

  

 Assisting in root cause analysis.
   

  

 Ensuring that all internal and external SLA terms and conditions are met
   

  

 Staying up to date with current and upcoming technologies and concepts
   

  

 Ensuring the fast restore of services across all IT systems by identifying and implementing fixes or workarounds.
   

  

 Writing and improving knowledgebase pages for employees (incl. manuals and FAQs)
   

  

**You Will Also Have An Opportunity To Support With**
 Performing network and system changes together or after preparation with 2nd level support teams
   

  

 Preparing specifications, installation and testing of computer systems and peripherals within established guidelines
   

  

 Contributing to audits
   

  

 Performing regular reviews
   

  

 Contributing to workflow optimizations and service catalogue setup
   

  

 What we are looking for
   

  

 We’re seeking a proactive and customer-focused professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional service and value. You are a team player but at the same time able to take own initiatives and responsibility from your work cases.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Minimum 2-3 years of practical experience working with IT systems
   

  

 Applicable IT education
   

  

 Technical skills (1 year or more in one of the below areas):
   

  

 Windows 11, Android, Apple products
   

  

 O365 support
   

  

 Basic understanding of Azure and Intune is a plus
   

  

 Networking and telecommunications (WAN, LAN, VOIP) is a plus
   

  

 Basic understanding of payment processing and POS/payment terminal systems (e.g. Shift4) is a plus
   

  

 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
   

  

 Customer service oriented, with operational "hands-on" attitude
   

  

 High quality standards, accuracy and risk awareness
   

  

 Independent, goal-oriented and self-motivating personality
   

  

 Organizational skills and the ability to prioritize workload
   

  

 Excellent communication skills, especially within a multicultural global organisation
   

  

 Fluency in English is required, along with proficiency in either Finnish or Swedish.
   

  

**Together, We Go Further**
 At Global Blue, great work happens when talented people come together in a supportive and inspiring environment. Here’s what you can expect:
   

  

 A role in a fast-growing, international company
   

  

 Opportunities for professional development and career growth
   

  

 A multicultural workplace, collaborating with colleagues worldwide
   

  

 Inspiring team members and a dynamic, forward-thinking culture
   

  

**A Range Of Employee Benefits, Including**
 Employee referral program
   

  

 Team-building activities and events
   

  

 Annual Christmas Party and more
   

  

 We foster career growth through internal mobility, embrace an Agile Working Model, and prioritise work-life balance. Committed to sustainability, we focus on creating positive impacts for employees, clients, and communities. Guided by our 5 Ways of Working, we value client satisfaction, collaboration, innovation, and shared success.
   

  

 Submit applications only through official Global Blue channels.We do not use any third-party services or platforms for recruitment.
   

  

 Always verify emails or LinkedIn messages.Ensure communications come from official @globalblue.com addresses or certified Global Blue recruiters/employees.
   

  

 We will never ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone requests this, it is a scam. Report it immediately.
   

  

 Feels like you? Explore further!

title: Head of Engineering
description:
SCRL is one of Sweden's most successful tech companies you've probably never heard of.
   

  

 We build creative tools used by 7 million monthly active creators around the world. By combining design, technology and a deep understanding of how people create content, we're shaping the future of social media design.
   

  

 We've done it without raising venture capital or chasing headlines. Instead, we've focused on creating products people genuinely love and building a company with ambitious, thoughtful people who care deeply about their craft.
   

  

 What started as a highly successful mobile app is evolving into a broader creative platform. We're expanding SCRL from a single product into a cross-platform editing suite that helps creators design, collaborate and create content seamlessly across devices. This evolution brings exciting technical and organizational challenges across mobile, web and backend systems — and as Head of Engineering, you'll help lead that journey.
   

  

 As we continue to scale our products and teams, we're looking for a Head of Engineering who can help raise the bar for execution, leadership and technical excellence.
   

  

 As the Head of Engineering, you will manage and lead the engineering team, today consisting of 3 teams (iOS, Android and web), driving our efforts to deliver best-in-class consumer apps at scale. Your leadership will align your team's work with our product strategy, ensuring rapid and efficient progress and results. You will also be responsible for expanding the engineering organization and helping shape our future across web, backend and Kotlin Multiplatform technologies.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Lead and manage multiple teams, creating a culture of accountability and collaboration.
* Set up hiring processes and lead recruitment of exceptional engineering talent across multiple domains.
* Collaborate closely with product managers and other stakeholders to deliver on growth strategies while aligning priorities and expectations.
* Ensure the scalability, reliability and security of our codebases, infrastructure and systems.
* Identify and mitigate risks, continuously improve workflows and help teams navigate complex challenges.
* Foster a culture of strong technical judgment, thoughtful system design and high-quality execution.
* Ensure teams have the resources, clarity and support needed to accomplish their goals.


 You should have
   

  

* Experience leading engineers, technical specialists and coaching development teams.
* Exceptional leadership skills and the ability to inspire excellence through collaboration and continuous change.
* A deep understanding of modern software engineering and product development practices.
* A successful track record of responsibility for business-critical products and initiatives.
* Experience hiring, developing and supporting engineers and leaders to maximize their growth and impact.


 This is a Stockholm-based role and we work together from our office near Slussen. We're builders at heart and believe great companies are created when talented people spend time together, challenge each other and move quickly towards ambitious goals.
   

  

 If you thrive in high-trust environments, enjoy a high bar for quality and want to help shape the next chapter of a profitable, product-led company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

title: Senior Design Engineer - Technical Lead
description:
**About the company**


SHL Medical is a world-leading provider in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced self-injection devices. With a global team of 6,000 employees, we partner with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies to deliver innovative autoinjectors, pen injectors, and other drug delivery systems that ensure effective treatment for patients. Headquartered in Switzerland since 2018, with key operations in Sweden, Taiwan, and the US, we are united by a commitment to innovation, impact, and growth. Together, we empower our people to develop solutions that make a meaningful difference in the lives of millions of patients while fostering a supportive, inclusive, and dynamic workplace for our colleagues.

**Job Overview**


At SHL Medical, we're shaping the future of self-injection solutions used by patients around the world. As a Senior Design Engineer - Technical Lead, you will play a key role in the evolution of one of our autoinjector platform technologies, driving technical excellence across both new development and lifecycle management activities.


In this role, you will lead complex mechanical design initiatives, guide engineering decisions, and mentor fellow engineers while ensuring our platform solutions remain robust, scalable, compliant, and competitive. Working closely with cross-functional experts across engineering, manufacturing, quality, regulatory affairs, and human factors, you will translate technical challenges into innovative solutions that enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and sustainability.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Lead the mechanical design and technical development of one of SHL Medical's autoinjector platforms, ensuring solutions meet performance, quality, manufacturability, sustainability, and cost requirements.
* Provide technical leadership across platform development and lifecycle management activities, guiding engineering decisions and driving design excellence.
* Mentor and support Design Engineers, fostering a collaborative engineering culture and enabling the delivery of robust, scalable platform solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating product, manufacturing, and market feedback to enhance device performance, reliability, safety, and competitiveness.
* Lead feasibility studies, engineering evaluations, simulations, and testing activities to assess new technologies and validate design concepts.
* Identify technical risks and opportunities, using data-driven analysis and sound engineering judgement to develop effective solutions and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and quality processes, including design controls, risk management, verification, validation, and change management activities.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Human Factors, Testing, and other engineering disciplines to deliver platform objectives.
* Act as a subject matter expert for the platform, influencing technical strategy and partnering with internal and customer-facing stakeholders to achieve successful product outcomes.
* Maintain platform design documentation and support root cause investigations, product updates, and lifecycle activities in a regulated environment.

 **Minimum Requirements**

* Senior Design Engineer for injection molding-based products with 5+ years’ relevant experience in medical industry or strongly regulated industry
* Excellent skills in CAD (Solidworks), simulation software, and statistical analysis.
* Strong DFx experience (Design for Testing, Manufacturing, Assembly, Quality, Cost, Sustainability) and willingness to drive the design for optimum solutions in consideration of all stakeholder needs
* Strong willingness to evaluate, apply and champion modern tools and methods for design excellence such as Six Sigma and Systems Engineering concepts
* Experienced to lead designers to realize complex design solutions
* Fluency in English

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with engineering design methodologies and tools, including 3D/2D CAD modelling, tolerance analysis, FEA simulations, and risk management techniques such as FMEA and FTA.
* Experience working within regulated product development environments and applying standards such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62366, and FDA combination product regulations.
* Knowledge of platform development, systems engineering principles, and their application to medical device design.
* Experience leading complex engineering projects and supporting multiple development activities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex technical challenges and develop pragmatic, data-driven solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical information into clear recommendations for diverse stakeholders.
* Experience driving continuous improvement initiatives focused on product performance, quality, manufacturability, sustainability, or cost optimisation.
* Knowledge of needle-based injection systems and ISO 11608-1 would be advantageous.

**We Offer**

* A company culture Focusing on our Customers, Operating with Ethics and Integrity, Driving Simplicity, Learning, Improving & Delivering Together.
* Challenging assignments in a fast growing and innovative industry.
* Various opportunities for personal and professional development within a global organization.
* Flexible hours and hybrid working policy.
* A modern working environment in Nacka Strand, Stockholm, with multicultural and motivated teams.


Interested in joining SHL Medical and in supporting us with your expertise and personality? Then we look forward to receiving your application including your CV, motivation letter, and all other relevant documents.


For more information on SHL Medical, please visit: **shl-medical.com**

**Please note: We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this role.**

title: Project Manager - Software Ecosystem Transformation
description:
Job Description:
**About the Role**


Digital Energy Software, within the Sustainability & Software (S&S) Division, is on an ambitious growth trajectory, targeting **more than €1B in revenue by 2030**. To support this growth, we are driving multiple strategic transformations to strengthen our position as a leading software player in the energy management industry.


We are seeking an experienced **Program Manager** to lead the development and execution of a strategic **Software Ecosystem Enablement Program**, designed to accelerate adoption of our platforms by system integrators, developers, customers, and operators worldwide.


This role is highly cross-functional and global in nature, requiring strong leadership, stakeholder management, and program execution skills. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Business Leaders, and external partners to deliver a unified ecosystem experience that enables users to discover, build, learn, connect, and grow on our software platforms.

 **Program Overview**


The Software Ecosystem Transformation Program focuses on building a comprehensive enablement environment that includes:

**Software Marketplace**


A centralized marketplace where customers and system integrators can:

* Discover certified applications and integrations
* Get access to software solutions and extensions
* Deploy ecosystem offerings seamlessly on our platforms

**Developer & Technical Enablement Hub**


A comprehensive technical portal providing:

* APIs and SDKs
* Developer documentation
* Reference architectures
* Sandbox environments
* Integration guidelines and tools

**Learning & Certification Platform**


A scalable training environment offering:

* Structured learning paths
* Technical certifications
* Hands-on training experiences
* Role-based curricula for integrators, developers, and operators

**Community Platform**


A vibrant peer-to-peer ecosystem enabling:

* Knowledge sharing
* Technical discussions
* Best-practice exchange
* Problem-solving among partners, developers, and operators

**Additional Ecosystem Services**


Support the exploration and implementation of additional capabilities that strengthen ecosystem adoption and partner engagement.

 **Key Responsibilities**


As Program Manager, you will be accountable for ensuring successful delivery and adoption of the Software Ecosystem program.

**Program Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with the Ecosystem Product Leader to execute the roadmap in alignment with business strategy and priorities.
* Drive program execution across multiple teams and stakeholders while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Build and maintain program plans, milestones, dependencies, and governance mechanisms.
* Support the League Leader in establishing and managing program budgets aligned with strategic objectives.
* Ensure successful delivery of commitments while balancing scope, schedule, quality, and value realization.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Engage and align business, product, engineering, and external stakeholders around the program vision.
* Facilitate decision-making and ensure stakeholder participation in key program events and governance forums.
* Build strong relationships across a global organization to drive collaboration and execution.
* Communicate progress, risks, and achievements to leadership and stakeholders at all levels.

**Dependency & Risk Management**

* Identify, manage, and track cross-team dependencies and critical path activities.
* Proactively escalate impediments and facilitate resolution of complex issues.
* Anticipate and mitigate risks that may impact delivery, quality, or adoption.
* Provide recommendations regarding resource allocation and prioritization to address bottlenecks.

**Agile Program Management**

* Maintain visibility over key milestones, deliveries, dependencies, and strategic initiatives beyond individual iterations and Program Increments.
* Track program performance using relevant metrics and reporting mechanisms.
* Support and facilitate PI Planning and other Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies when applicable.
* Ensure teams are positioned to meet internal and external commitments.

**Continuous Improvement & Coaching**

* Foster a culture of continuous improvement through Inspect & Adapt practices.
* Coach teams and leaders on Agile principles, collaboration models, and delivery excellence.
* Promote transparency, accountability, and servant leadership across the program.
* Drive improvements in governance, planning, execution, and stakeholder engagement.

 **Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, or Transformation leadership roles.
* Proven track record leading large-scale, complex software or digital transformation programs.
* Experience managing global and cross-functional teams across multiple geographies.
* Strong experience working in Agile environments and scaling Agile practices across organizations.
* Experience leading projects involving software platforms, developer ecosystems, marketplaces, or digital enablement solutions.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally when required.

 **Skills & Competencies**

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to align and motivate multiple teams toward a shared vision.
* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong ownership mindset and execution focus.

**Program Management**

* Expert in managing complex programs with multiple workstreams.
* Strong experience managing cross-team dependencies and risks.
* Ability to track, analyze, and communicate program metrics and performance.
* Strong planning, governance, and budget management capabilities.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build consensus.
* Advanced negotiation skills to balance engineering constraints and business priorities.

**Agile Expertise**

* Deep understanding of Agile principles and frameworks.
* Experience facilitating PI Planning, ART events, and large-scale Agile ceremonies.
* Knowledge of SAFe or equivalent Agile scaling frameworks is highly desirable.
* Ability to coach teams and leaders on Agile best practices.

**Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Proactive and data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Experience in identifying and resolving systemic delivery or organizational challenges.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Facilitation & Coaching**

* Skilled facilitator for workshops and large-scale meetings.
* Conflict resolution and stakeholder alignment expertise.
* Servant leadership mindset.
* Ability to coach teams and leaders toward higher performance.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Release Train Engineer (RTE), PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification.
* Experience in software ecosystems, developer platforms, SaaS businesses, or partner enablement programs.
* Experience working with system integrators and technology partners.
* Knowledge of the Energy Management, Digital Energy, or Industrial Software industries is an advantage.

 **Why Join Us?**


This is a unique opportunity to shape a strategic transformation that will be foundational to the future growth of Digital Energy Software. You will work at the intersection of product strategy, technology, ecosystem development, and business transformation, helping create a world-class enablement platform for our customers, partners, and developers worldwide.


Local Benefits (English):

At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.


Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits – it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.

**Grow Your Skills and Career.** We commit to helping you grow with ongoing performance and development conversations, global career opportunities, access to our Schneider Career Hub for new positions, projects, and mentors, and learning platforms to equip you with the skills for today and tomorrow.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.


We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.


Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!


€40 billion global revenue  

+9% organic growth  

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

  

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled. *Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*  

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*

It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.*

title: Digital Lifecycle Strategist i– Forma framtidens Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV)
description:
**Rollen och dina mål**


Bilindustrin genomgår sin största transformation i modern tid där hårdvara möter mjukvarudefinierad funktionalitet. Som Digital Lifecycle Strategist hos oss kliver du in i en nyckelroll där du översätter komplex mjukvarukapacitet till kommersiellt och strategiskt värde för fordonsflottor. Du kommer att arbeta nära våra kunders lednings- och utvecklingsteam på plats i Göteborg.


**Dina viktigaste mål under det första året:**


* Definiera och etablera hur Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV)-kapabiliteter konkret översätts till strategisk produktportföljstyring och framtida produktlinjer.
* Utveckla och implementera livscykel- och värdemodeller (Lifecycle Value Models) som säkrar kontinuerligt värdeskapande, mjukvaruuppdateringar och nya intäktsströmmar från ax till limpa.
* Agera bryggan mellan tekniska arkitektteam och affärsutveckling för att säkerställa att digitala tjänster och mjukvaruplattformar harmonierar med långsiktiga affärsmål.

  

För att lyckas och trivas i den här rollen ser vi att du kombinerar tung strategisk kompetens med en stark förståelse för mjukvarudrivna ekosystem.


**Skallkrav:**


* **Erfarenhet:** 10+ års erfarenhet från strategiska roller inom automotive OEM:er, techbolag eller närliggande/tillstötande industrier.
* Dokumenterad förståelse för mjukvarkitektur (Software defined vehicle/SDV), uppkopplade fordon och digitala affärsmodeller.
* **Språk:** Flytande engelska i både tal och skrift (koncern- och kundspråk).
* **Arbetstillstånd:** Giltigt arbetstillstånd inom EU.

**Personliga egenskaper & Mjuka kompetenser:**


* Du har en förmåga att navigera i komplexitet och översätta avancerad teknik till tydliga affärsstrategier.
* Du är skicklig på att skapa förtroende och samarbeta över avdelningsgränser – från ingenjörer till beslutsfattare på C-level.
* Du trivs i förändring, tar egna initiativ och är van vid att bana väg där tydliga kartor ännu saknas.


**Vad vi erbjuder**


* En unika möjlighet att bygga värdefull erfarenhet och ett starkt nätverk hos ledande aktörer inom fordons- och techsektorn.
* En ambitiös, öppen och innovativ miljö där vi stöttar varandra och har nära till beslut.
* Vi omfattas av Innovationsavtalet vilket garanterar marknadsmässiga villkor, tjänstepension, föräldraledighetstillägg samt schyssta arbetstids- och semestervillkor.
* **Plats:** Göteborg.

**Ansökan och kontakt**


Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, så vänta inte med din ansökan!

title: Senior Calibration Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods cost less for our customers, and less for the planet.



Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers.


We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Calibration Engineer for autonomous vehicles. The ideal candidate has strong software engineering skills and experience in developing and transitioning prototypes into final products.


### **You will:**


* Design, build, and own end-to-end sensor calibration pipelines (intrinsics and extrinsics) for the full vehicle sensor suite, including cameras, lidar, radar, IMU, and GNSS
* Develop and maintain factory calibration procedures and continuous calibration algorithms
* Define calibration accuracy requirements with relevant stakeholders
* Build automated tooling for calibration validation and monitoring across the fleet
* Scale calibration infrastructure to support new sensor configurations, vehicle platforms, and and growing fleet size
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership


### **We expect you to have:**


* Strong technical background: PhD or highly qualified MS in one of the following: Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field
* 5+ years of industry experience in sensor calibration, computer vision, robotics, or a closely related area
* Strong understanding of multi-sensor calibration techniques: camera intrinsics/extrinsics, camera–LiDAR, LiDAR–IMU, radar alignment, and hand–eye calibration.
* Proficiency in C++ and Python in a production software environment
* Experience with common robotics/vision libraries and tools (e.g., OpenCV, Ceres, GTSAM, Eigen, ROS)
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems from concept through deployment, including validation and monitoring in production
* Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across software, hardware, and operations teams



This is a full-time position based in Gothenburg or Stockholm. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.



Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.  



  

  

**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

Born autonomous. Born electric.



Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.



We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.
